He performs ERCP and GI stenting, and manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, gallstones, biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic cysts, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease with ulcerative colitis, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training was decorated at every stage. He read MBBS at Andhra University, where he was awarded six gold medals, took his MD in internal medicine at Osmania University with a further gold medal, and his DM in gastroenterology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences. He then took a fellowship in hepatology at King's College Hospital in London, and holds the FCGP awarded by the College of General Practitioners.

He has given four named memorial orations: the Dr. Srinivasan Memorial Oration at Kakinada, the Dr. Nagesh Memorial Oration at Eluru, the Dr. Bhaskar Kumar Memorial Oration at Vijayawada and the Dr. O.A. Sharma Endowment Oration at Hyderabad. He has published 13 papers in Indian and international journals and contributed an article to the textbook of Tropical Gastroenterology published by Elsevier.

His society roles span Indian and British bodies. He is Vice President of INASL AP&T and a member of the ISG chapter for AP&T, and was formerly a governing council member of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology. He also belongs to the British Society of Gastroenterology, the Indian Association for Study of Liver Diseases, the Endoscopy Society of India, the Society of Organ Transplantation and the Indo British Health Initiative.

dr-jayanthi-venkataraman.bio:
Dr. Jayanthi Venkataraman is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity in Chennai, with more than 36 years of experience. Her profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with surgical gastroenterology for liver transplant consultation and management.

The liver is the centre of her practice. She manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, refractory ascites, autoimmune liver diseases, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and chronic hepatitis B and C, and also treats gallstones and Crohn's disease and performs ERCP.

Her training spans four institutions and two decades. She read MBBS at Lady Harding Medical College in Delhi between 1971 and 1975, took her MD in general medicine at Madras Medical College between 1978 and 1980, and her DM in gastroenterology at Christian Medical College, Vellore between 1982 and 1984. She was elected a Member of the Academy of Medical Sciences in 1988 and a Fellow of the Indian College of Physicians in 1997, and held a NACC British Digestive Foundation fellowship at Leicester General Hospital in the United Kingdom between 1990 and 1991. She was made Emeritus Professor at Dr. MGR Medical University in Chennai in June 2015.

Most of her career before her present post was in government and teaching hospitals. She has worked at Government General Hospital in Chennai, Government Stanley Hospital, the Government Peripheral Hospital at Kilpauk Medical College and Hospital, Coimbatore Medical College Hospital and Sri Ramachandra Medical Centre, as well as Leicester General Hospital and Gleneagles Global Health City.

She is the author of more than 16 peer-reviewed publications in national and international journals, covering hepatic encephalopathy, liver cirrhosis, gallstone disease, Crohn's disease epidemiology, variceal bleeding and liver transplant immunology.

dr-k-s-somasekhar-rao.bio:
Dr. K. S. Somasekhar Rao is Clinical Director and Senior Consultant Medical Gastroenterologist and Hepatologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 19 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

The liver takes up most of his list. He manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, chronic hepatitis B and C and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Beyond the liver he manages inflammatory bowel disease with ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease, chronic pancreatitis, gallstones, recurrent GI bleeding and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is dated and moves across three states. He read MBBS at Andhra Medical College in Visakhapatnam in 2001, took his MD in general medicine through the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences in 2007 and his DM in gastroenterology at Sri Ramachandra University in Chennai in 2012.

His posts follow the same route. He has worked at Pinnamaneni Siddhartha Institute of Medical Sciences in Gannavaram, at Vydehi Medical College in Whitefield, Bangalore, at Sri Ramachandra Medical College and Apollo Hospitals on Greams Road in Chennai, and at Apollo Hospitals in Hyderabad from 2014 to 2023 before his present post.

His recognition comes largely from media and industry awards rather than academic bodies: a Best Doctor Award in gastroenterology at the 7th Hi9 Doctors Awards in 2019, an Indian Leadership Award the same year, a Service Excellence in Hepatology Award at Times Health Excellence Hyderabad for 2020–21, Indian Icon of the Year in 2021, a Most Trusted Medical Gastroenterologist Award in February 2022 and Ikon in Gastroenterology from Times Health in 2022.

He is a member of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology and the Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, and has published on gastric emptying by scintigraphy in non-ulcer dyspepsia.

dr-kaushal-madan.bio:
Dr. Kaushal Madan is Principal Director and Head of Clinical Hepatology at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

The liver is the centre of his practice. He manages chronic hepatitis B and C, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, liver cirrhosis, chronic liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases and portal hypertension. He also performs ERCP and therapeutic endoscopy, and manages acute and chronic pancreatitis and gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His first two qualifications were both taken at Maulana Azad Medical College at the University of Delhi: the MBBS and the MD in internal medicine. He then took the DNB in internal medicine through the National Board of Examinations and his DM in gastroenterology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences. In 2005 he held a Japanese Society of Gastroenterology research fellowship at Kinki University School of Medicine in Osaka.

He won the Sudhir Rehan Gold Medal in Medicine in 1997 and the Rakesh Tandon Book Prize as best outgoing DM gastroenterology student in 2003.

His society work is in transplant and liver medicine. He was Secretary General of the Indian National Association for the Study of the Liver from 2018 to 2021, and is a member of the American Association for the Study of Liver Disease, the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, the Liver Transplant Society of India and the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation. Two of those four are transplant bodies, which places his hepatology practice alongside the transplant programme rather than separate from it.

He practises across the Max hospitals at Saket and at Max Hospital in Gurgaon.

dr-naveen-polavarapu.bio:
Dr. Naveen Polavarapu is a Senior Consultant Gastroenterologist, Liver Specialist and Advanced Therapeutic Endoscopist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile also records surgical gastroenterology for liver transplant.

That three-part title maps onto his list. As an endoscopist he performs ERCP and treats bile duct stones, biliary strictures and pancreatic cysts. As a liver specialist he manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases and pediatric liver disease, and he works in liver transplant. He also manages chronic pancreatitis.

He read MBBS at NTR University of Health Sciences in Andhra Pradesh and took the rest of his training in the UK. He holds the MRCP and FRCP in gastroenterology through the Liverpool Deanery, the FRCP of Glasgow awarded in 2018, and a CCT in gastroenterology. His liver transplant fellowship was at Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Birmingham and his advanced endoscopy fellowship training in ERCP and endoscopic ultrasound at Aintree University Hospital, so both halves of his present practice rest on separate fellowships.

His student record is an unbroken run of distinctions: the gold medal for best outgoing student at the University of Health Sciences in 2001, gold medals in medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynaecology, anatomy and physiology, first class in 12 of the 13 MBBS subjects, and second prize in the All India National Paediatric Quiz in 2000.

Later recognition came from the press and from conferences. He was named a Rising Star in gastroenterology by the Times of India in 2018 and Best Hepatologist by the same paper in 2022, and won a best poster award at the BSG conference in 2010. He has also worked at Apollo Hospitals in Jubilee Hills.

dr-chetan-kalal.bio:
Dr. Chetan Kalal is Associate Director of Hepatology and Liver Transplant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with surgical gastroenterology for liver transplant.

His practice is entirely on the liver. He works in liver transplant and manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver diseases and refractory ascites.

He read MBBS through MUHS University at Dhule in the 2001 to 2006 batch and took his MD at Seth GS Medical College under MUHS in Mumbai. He holds a DM in hepatology and completed a post doctoral fellowship in transplant medicine.

His hospital record runs through several of the liver programmes in Mumbai and one outside it. Alongside Gleneagles Hospital in Parel he has been at Max Nanavati Hospital, Sir HN Reliance Hospital and Research Centre, Global Hospital and Seth GS Medical College, all in Mumbai, at the Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences in New Delhi, and at VKPIM in Ahmednagar.

His research record is international in reach. He received AASLD Foundation Young Investigator Travel Awards in 2016 for Boston and 2017 for Washington DC, and full bursaries for top ten percent abstracts in Slovenia and Barcelona in 2016 and Amsterdam in 2017. He became a member of the European Association for the Study of Liver Disease in April 2016.

He has published over 20 original research papers in leading national and international journals and has contributed to multiple global clinical trials on new drug development, which places him on the trial side of hepatology as well as the clinical one.

dr-g-r-srinivas-rao.bio:
Dr. G. R. Srinivas Rao is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 33 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His practice covers the liver, the pancreas and the gut. He performs ERCP and manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, chronic hepatitis B and C, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic pancreatitis, ulcerative colitis, recurrent GI bleeding and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

He holds a DM in gastroenterology and an MD in gastroenterology.

His research record is the most detailed part of his profile and divides into two kinds of work. His own studies are on the lipid profile in young male cigarette smokers, hepatitis A in cirrhotic patients, alpha fetoprotein in de-novo decompensated cirrhosis, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. He has also taken part in two phase III randomized multi-center multinational placebo controlled trials of 5-ASA in ulcerative colitis, one in mild to moderate disease and one in disease in remission. Both of those conditions appear on his clinical list, so the trial work sits directly on his own practice.

He is a member of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology and its AP chapter in Hyderabad, the Indian Association for Study of Liver, and the Indian Society of Enteral and Parental Nutrition.

His awards come from outside the specialty societies. He received the Vaidya Sri Award in 2005 and the Seva Ratna Award in 2011, and was given an award by the Vamsi Foundation for distinguished service at VIMS Hospital in Guntur.

dr-jagadish-polavarapu.bio:
Dr. Jagadish Polavarapu is a Consultant Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist and Bariatric Endoscopist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with endoscopic bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list follows that three-part title. He performs ERCP and manages chronic liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, portal hypertension, chronic pancreatitis, inflammatory bowel disease, recurrent GI bleeding, severe gastroesophageal reflux disease and achalasia, for which Heller myotomy appears on his list.

His training is dated year by year and all of it is recent. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad between 2008 and 2014, took his MD in general medicine at the same college between 2016 and 2019, and his DM in medical gastroenterology at Christian Medical College, Vellore between 2020 and 2023. He passed the European Specialty Examination in Gastroenterology and Hepatology in 2025.

Four further placements in 2025 explain the endoscopic and bariatric part of his title. He held observerships in third space endoscopy with Dr. Venkat N. Muddana at TriHealth Hospital in Cincinnati in June and with Dr. Madhusudhan Sanaka at the Cleveland Clinic in Ohio in July, trained in EUS with Dr. Shyam Varadarajulu at Orlando Health Care in Florida in July, and trained in endoluminal bariatric surgery at iRCAD India in October.

He is a life member of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology and the Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy of India. His publications include a systematic review of gut microbiota as a predictor of therapeutic response in adults with Crohn's disease, and a case series on dorsal genesis of pancreas in the Journal of MGR University in 2023.

dr-kiran-peddi.bio:
Dr. Kiran Peddi is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 30 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

Inflammatory bowel disease is the part of his practice with its own fellowship behind it. He manages IBD including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, and performs ERCP. On the liver he manages liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases, refractory ascites and chronic hepatitis B and C, and he also treats chronic pancreatitis and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

He read MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College in 1996 and took the rest of his qualifications abroad. He passed the MRCP in the UK in 2000, completed his CCT in gastroenterology and general internal medicine in 2008, and was elected FRCP of London in 2017. His fellowship in advanced endoscopy and IBD was taken in Australia, and it accounts for the two strongest strands of his present list.

His hospital record spans three countries. In the UK he was at Stepping Hill Hospital in Stockport and at the Manchester Royal, Hope and Blackburn hospitals, and in Australia at Fremantle Hospital in Western Australia. In India he has been at Global Hospitals in Lakdikapul, Medicity Hospital and Citizens Specialty Hospital in Nalagandla, Telangana, alongside his present post at Yashoda Hospitals in Somajiguda.

He is a member of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, the Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy of India and the European Crohn's and Colitis Organisation, the last of which matches the IBD half of his fellowship. He was named a Rising Star in Gastroenterology for the Telugu States by the Times of India in 2017.

dr-ameet-mandot.bio:
Dr. Ameet Mandot is Director and Clinical Lead for Adult Hepatology and Liver Transplant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 24 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with surgical gastroenterology for liver transplant.

His practice is built on the liver. He manages liver cirrhosis, chronic liver disease, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver diseases, portal hypertension and refractory ascites, and also treats celiac disease and performs ERCP.

He holds an MBBS and an MD, and took the DNB in gastroenterology as a national gold medalist for 2007 to 2008. His fellowship in hepatology and liver transplantation was taken at Hospital Beaujon in Clichy, Paris.

Most of his career has been spent inside the liver transplant programs of Mumbai. He has been liver transplant physician at Apollo Hospitals and at Wockhardt Hospitals, honorary consultant to the liver transplant program at Hinduja Hospital, and gastroenterologist and academic head at Bombay Hospital, before his present post at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel.

Two appointments stand outside the clinical work. He was made academic head of the DNB gastroenterology training program at Bombay Hospital in 2017, and honorary gastroenterologist to the Governor of Maharashtra in 2019.

He has published over 20 papers in indexed medical journals, including contributions to the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology, Gastrointestinal Endoscopy and Endoscopy. Between the Paris fellowship, the transplant program appointments and a training program headship, his record describes a hepatologist whose work sits as much in transplant medicine and teaching as in general liver practice.

dr-harshad-joshi.bio:
Dr. Harshad Joshi is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with inflammatory bowel disease as a specialization in its own right.

That second entry is where his practice is concentrated. He manages inflammatory bowel disease, including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, and also treats celiac disease, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease. On the liver he manages chronic liver disease, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases and chronic hepatitis B and C, and he also treats chronic pancreatitis.

He holds an MBBS and two national board qualifications, the DNB in internal medicine and the DNB in gastroenterology. His fellowship in advanced inflammatory bowel disease was taken in the Division of Gastroenterology at the Department of Medicine, University of Alberta, in Edmonton, Canada.

Two of his credentials are in techniques rather than in subjects. He has been an International Bowel Ultrasonography Group certified trainer since 2024, which places him on the teaching side of that technique, and he was certified as an Associate of Rome by The Rome Foundation in 2016, the body behind the criteria for the functional GI disorders on his list.

His travel fellowships in 2017 were from ECCO AOCC and IOIBD and took him to the Academic Medical Center in Amsterdam, and in 2016 he was selected for the 14th Intensive IBD Advanced Course at the ECCO Congress for Young Gastroenterologists.

Alongside Gleneagles Hospital in Parel he has been at Nanavati Max Superspeciality Hospital, Sir H N Reliance Foundation Hospital and P.D. Hinduja National Hospital and Research Centre in Mumbai, and at University of Alberta Hospital in Edmonton.

dr-randeep-rana.bio:
Dr. Randeep Rana is a Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is weighted towards endoscopic intervention. He performs ERCP and GI stenting, and manages recurrent GI bleeding, portal hypertension, liver cirrhosis, pancreatic cysts, inflammatory bowel disease with Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis, congenital GI disorders, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is recent and almost entirely in New Delhi. He read MBBS at Dayanand Medical College and Hospital in Ludhiana in 2012, took his MD in internal medicine at ABVIMS and Dr Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital in New Delhi in 2018, his DM in gastroenterology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in 2023, and a fellowship in advanced GI endoscopy at the same institute in 2024.

His examination record is unusually complete. He took first position and the gold medal in medicine in MBBS in 2012, All India Rank 69 and state rank 2 in NEET-PG for 2014–2015, All India Rank 2 in the AIIMS SS examination for DM gastroenterology in 2020, and All India Rank 1 in the fellowship entrance examination for advanced GI endoscopy at AIIMS in 2023.

His conference record has followed the same line. He won best oral presentation in the clinical category at the EASL Congress in Milan in 2024, the best abstract presentation prize at UEG Week in Berlin in 2025, a poster of distinction at Asian Pacific Digestive Week in Singapore in 2025, and third prize for best oral presentation at the Indian Pancreas Club meeting in New Delhi in 2022. He holds an EASL travel grant and an ICMR international travel grant, both from 2024.

dr-sanjiv-saigal.bio:
Dr. Sanjiv Saigal is Vice Chairman and Head of Hepatology and Liver Transplant Medicine at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 30 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His practice is entirely hepatological and includes the transplant end of it. He manages liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver diseases and chronic liver disease, and works in deceased donor liver transplant and liver retransplantation.

His qualifications were taken at six different institutions and run from 1989 to 2005. He read MBBS at Calcutta University in 1989 as a gold medalist, took his MD in medicine at PGI Chandigarh in 1994, the DNB in gastroenterology through the NBE in Delhi in 1996, and his DM in gastroenterology at GB Pant in Delhi in 1998. He then passed the MRCP of the Royal College of Physicians in Edinburgh in 1999 and completed his CCST in gastroenterology in the UK in 2005.

He was an INLAKS Foundation Scholar at King's College Hospital in London, which places a transplant centre at the start of a career he now spends leading a transplant programme.

His recognition runs from the Calcutta University gold medal through a National Pfizer Award to IMA Eminent Speaker in 2014 and a Human Care Award in 2018. He has over 125 indexed publications.

He practises at Max Super Speciality Hospital in Saket and at Max Hospital in Gurugram.

dr-gopi-srikanth.bio:
Dr. Gopi Srikanth is a Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with interventional endoscopy.

His list carries both. He performs ERCP and treats achalasia, for which Heller myotomy appears on his list, and manages recurrent GI bleeding and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease. On the liver and pancreas he manages chronic pancreatitis, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases and chronic hepatitis B and C.

His training is dated year by year and moves through three institutions. He read MBBS at Andhra Medical College in Visakhapatnam between 2006 and 2012, took his MD in internal medicine at PGIMER in Chandigarh between 2013 and 2015, and his DM in gastroenterology and hepatology at AIIMS in New Delhi between 2018 and 2020.

His two fellowships are what turned that into an interventional practice. He took a fellowship in pancreatology at AIIMS in 2021 and a fellowship in endoscopic ultrasound at the WEO International School of EUS run by the World Endoscopy Organisation in 2022, and he is a member of the World Endoscopy Organization as well as of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology and the Indian Pancreas Club.

He has authored over 25 research publications in peer-reviewed journals including the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Surgery, Pancreatology, the American Journal of Gastroenterology and the Journal of Clinical and Experimental Hepatology. He won first prize in the e-poster category at ENDOCON 2021 and second prize in the quiz at the national PGI Emergency Update conference in both 2018 and 2020.

dr-k-a-ramakrishna.bio:
Dr. K. A. Ramakrishna is a Consultant Medical Gastroenterologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

The biliary tree is the busiest part of his list. He performs ERCP and GI stenting, and treats bile duct stones, biliary strictures and gallstones. Beyond that he manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases, chronic pancreatitis, inflammatory bowel disease, congenital GI disorders, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is recorded to the month. He passed MBBS at S.V. Medical College in Tirupathi under the University of Health Sciences in Vijayawada in December 1992 and completed his internship there between February 1993 and February 1994. He took his MD in general medicine at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad, passing in July 1997, and his DM in gastroenterology at Osmania General Hospital between August 2001 and 2004.

His hospital record covers teaching and specialist institutions across several cities. He has been at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Deccan College of Medical Sciences, Basavatarakam Indo American Cancer Institute and Apollo Hospitals in Jubilee Hills, all in Hyderabad, at Osmania General Hospital, and at the Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Lucknow.

He won best hepatology paper at ISGCON 2005 in Vizag, is a life member of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, is the author of Questionnaire in Gastroenterology published by Paras Medical Publishing Co., and has published case reports in the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology.

dr-radhika-venugopal.bio:
Dr. Radhika Venugopal is a Consultant Hepatologist at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 24 years of experience. Her profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with the medical management side of liver transplantation.

Her list is built on the liver across all ages. She manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver diseases, portal hypertension and pediatric liver disease, and also performs ERCP and GI stenting and manages pancreatic cysts.

Her route into hepatology ran through paediatrics, which explains the paediatric liver work on that list. She read MBBS at Coimbatore Medical College in 2000, took her MD in paediatrics at the Institute of Child Health and Hospital for Children at Madras Medical College in 2007, then her DM in hepatology at the Institute of Hepato Biliary Sciences at the same college in 2018, and a fellowship in transplant hepatology at Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre in 2020.

She received the Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR Medical University Gold Medal for the highest marks in her DM in hepatology, and second prize for her award paper on sarcopenia and cirrhosis at ISGCON 2018.

Her published and presented work spans both halves of her career. She has published in the Journal of Hepatology, Best Practice & Research Clinical Gastroenterology and the Journal of Liver Disease & Transplantation among others, presented a poster at APASL 2018 on yellow phosphorus as rodenticide and the predictive factors of liver injury, and gave a free paper at PED GASTROCON 2005 on Wilson's Disease in children. She has also worked at the Institute of Social Paediatrics at Stanley Medical College in Chennai.

dr-randhir-sud.bio:
Dr. Randhir Sud is Chairman of Gastroenterology and Gastrosciences at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is almost entirely endoscopic. He performs ERCP, therapeutic endoscopy, endoscopic hemostasis, endoscopic dilatation and GI stenting, and manages biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis, chronic liver disease and gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His qualifications are the M.B.B.S., the M.D. in general medicine and the D.M. in gastroenterology, followed by a visiting fellowship in ERCP, which is the procedure at the head of his list. He is also a Fellow of the International Academy of Medical Specialities, awarded in 2000.

Two of his distinctions came from his own specialty society. The Indian Society of Gastroenterology conferred both a gold medal and the title Master in Endoscopy on him, and the second of those names the technical field his whole practice sits in.

His other recognition is academic and civic. He was conferred a visiting professorship at Harvard Medical School in 1999, received the Bharat Ratna Priyadarshini Award from Delhi University in 2004, and took first prize for standing first in the first professional M.B.B.S examination.

He practises at Medanta Gurugram as his primary site, and also at the Medanta MediClinic at Golf Course and the Medanta MediClinic at Defence Colony, so his week is divided between a tertiary hospital department and two smaller clinics.

dr-bharath-kumar-ayapati.bio:
Dr. Bharath Kumar Ayapati is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 18 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is weighted towards the bile duct and the pancreas. He performs ERCP and GI stenting and treats bile duct stones, biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts. He also manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic hepatitis B and C, celiac disease and recurrent GI bleeding.

He read MBBS at Sri Venkateswara Medical College and took his MD in internal medicine at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad. His DM in gastroenterology and hepatology and his FAGIE, a fellowship in advanced GI endoscopy, were both taken at Christian Medical College, Vellore, which is where the interventional half of his practice comes from.

His publications track the same interests. He described EUS guided gastro-jejunostomy with a NAGI stent for the relief of jejunal loop obstruction in Endoscopy in 2016, reported on image-enhanced endoscopy for the real-time differentiation of hyperplastic and fundic gland polyps in the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology in 2022, and published work in Tropical Gastroenterology showing that endoscopic ultrasonography reveals the occurrence of chronic pancreatitis in patients with idiopathic recurrent acute pancreatitis. He also reported a rare cause of acute liver failure in the Med E Journal of Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR University in 2014.

Three of those four papers are on endoscopic technique rather than on medical management, which matches a list headed by ERCP and stenting. Alongside KIMS Hospitals he has been at Apollo Hospital in Jubilee Hills, Yashoda Hospital in Malakpet, Christian Medical College in Vellore and AIIMS in New Delhi.

dr-k-n-chandan-kumar.bio:
Dr. K N Chandan Kumar is Director of Hepatology and Transplant Hepatology at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 16 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with surgical gastroenterology for liver transplant.

His clinical list is entirely hepatological. He manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases, portal hypertension and refractory ascites.

Both of his first degrees were taken at Manipal University: the MBBS and the MD in general medicine. He then took his DM in hepatology at the Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences in New Delhi, and his record notes that he was the first qualified DM in hepatology from that institute.

His two overseas placements correspond to the two halves of his present title. He trained in transplant hepatology in the Division of Liver Diseases at Mount Sinai Medical Center in New York, and in liver intensive care at the Institute of Liver Studies at Kings College Hospital in London. Between them they cover the transplant programme and the critically ill patient, which are the two ends of the service he now directs.

His memberships are unusually international for the length of his career. He belongs to the American College of Gastroenterology, the American Association for Study of the Liver Diseases, the Asia-Pacific Association for Study of Liver and the International Liver Transplant Society, alongside the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, the Indian National Association for Study of Liver and the Liver Transplant Society of India. Two of those seven are transplant societies, which matches the second half of his job title.

dr-prabha-sawant.bio:
Dr. Prabha Sawant is Professor and Head of the Department of Gastroenterology at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 46 years of experience in gastroenterology.

Her list covers the liver, the gut and the pancreas. She performs ERCP and manages portal hypertension, chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, autoimmune liver diseases, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease with ulcerative colitis, chronic pancreatitis, celiac disease, recurrent GI bleeding and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

She holds an MBBS and an MD.

Her standing in the specialty is recorded mainly through invited orations and an early research award. She received the Young Investigator Award for portal hypertension from the Indian Society of Gastroenterology in 1994, and has since given the Blumberg Oration for the Kalinga Foundation at Cuttack and the Prof. G.S. Sainani Oration at API Jaipur, both in 2010, the Dr. V. S. Prayag Memorial Oration at B.J. Medical College in 2012, and the Phanidar Oration at Baroda in 2017. Portal hypertension, the subject of that first award, still heads her clinical list.

Her published work is recent and collaborative. She was a co-author on a report of orbital hematoma as a new complication of esophagogastroduodenoscopy in the American Journal of Gastroenterology in 2019, on a study of anemia in patients with ulcerative colitis in remission from Western India in the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology in 2017, and on work on the role of capsule endoscopy in the etiological diagnosis and management of obscure gastrointestinal bleeding in Intest Res in 2016.

Alongside Gleneagles Hospital in Parel she has been at Lokmanya Tilak Municipal Medical College in Sion and at Sushrusha Citizen Co-operative Hospital in Dadar.

dr-m-a-mir.bio:
Dr. M.A. Mir is Head of Gastroenterology for Liver and Digestive Diseases, Unit III, at Artemis Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list is built on the endoscope. He performs ERCP, therapeutic endoscopy, advanced polypectomy, endoscopic hemostasis, endoscopic dilatation and GI stenting, and fits the gastric balloon for weight loss, which is the procedure behind the bariatric specialization on his profile. On the liver he manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, chronic hepatitis B and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and he also treats gastroesophageal reflux disease.

He holds an MBBS and took his MD in gastroenterology with honors, and is a Fellow of the American College of Gastroenterology.

His memberships reach beyond his own specialty. Alongside the American College of Gastroenterology and the Indian Society of Gastroenterology he belongs to the Association of Physicians of India and the Indian Medical Association, and also to the AIDS Society of India and the Tuberculosis Association of J&K. Those last two are infectious disease bodies rather than gastroenterological ones, and they sit beside a chronic hepatitis B practice on the clinical side of his record.

He practises at Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram, where he heads the third unit of the liver and digestive diseases service rather than the department as a whole.

dr-mahadevan-b.bio:
Dr. Mahadevan B is Head of Department and a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity in Chennai, with more than 21 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is a therapeutic endoscopy list. He performs ERCP and per oral endoscopic myotomy for achalasia, and treats bile duct stones, biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts. He also manages Crohn's disease and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His route into gastroenterology ran through paediatrics. He read MBBS at JIPMER in Pondicherry and took his MD in paediatrics at the same institute, before his DM in gastroenterology.

His conference work sits on the technical end of that practice. At ENDO 2017, the 1st World Congress of GI Endoscopy in February 2017, he presented a paper on the clearance of an impacted stone at a hepatico-jejunostomy site with the Spyglass cholangioscope DS and laser lithotripsy. In September 2019 he was an invited lecturer at a national conference in Chengdu, China, speaking on the EUS rendezvous technique. Both are problems of biliary access, the same territory as the ERCP and bile duct work on his list.

He has been a reviewer for the European Journal for Gastroenterology and Hepatology for over 5 years, and has 14 peer-reviewed publications in journals including the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology, Gastroenterology, Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, Clinical Gastroenterology and Hepatology, Clinical and Experimental Hepatology, Tropical Gastroenterology and the Journal of Digestive Endoscopy.

Alongside Gleneagles Health City he has been at Chettinad Medical College, SRM Medical College, Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute, and JIPMER.

dr-manoj-yadav.bio:
Dr. Manoj Yadav is a Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital in Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list covers the liver, the biliary tree and the bowel. He manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, treats gallstones and biliary strictures, and manages inflammatory bowel disease including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, along with chronic pancreatitis and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

Both of his first degrees were taken at Pt. B.D.S PGIMS in Rohtak: the MBBS and the MD in internal medicine. He then took his DM in medical gastroenterology at SMS Hospital in Jaipur, where he was gold medalist in the final examination.

His publications are unusually wide for a gastroenterologist and reach well outside the specialty. Within it he has published on acute kidney injury in chronic liver disease in northwest India in the Indian Journal of Nephrology in 2023, and on gender specific risk factors, clinical presentation and outcome of amoebic liver abscess in a tertiary care centre in the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology the same year. He also wrote a chapter on fecal incontinence for India Point of Care, published by Elsevier in 2022.

Beyond the liver and gut he has published on pregnancy related acute kidney injury as a cause of chronic kidney disease in developing countries in The Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of India in 2023, on the spectrum of macrocytic anemia in the adult population in 2018, on isolated hypoglossal nerve palsy as a rare paraneoplastic neurological syndrome in non-small cell lung carcinoma in 2017, and on cerebral venous sinus thrombosis presenting as cortical blindness in the Turkish Journal of Neurology in 2018.

dr-ramesh-uddarraju.bio:
Dr. Ramesh Uddarraju is a Junior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 8 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list runs from the bowel to the bile duct. He manages inflammatory bowel disease including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease, and on the liver chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. He performs ERCP and GI stenting and treats biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis and recurrent GI bleeding.

His training moved across three states. He read MBBS at ASRAM Medical College in Eluru, took his MD in internal medicine at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal in 2018, and his DM in medical gastroenterology at IMS and SUM Hospital in Bhubaneswar in 2022. He also holds the MRCP specialty certificate in gastroenterology and hepatology from the UK.

His presented work matches the two halves of his list. He presented a paper on platelet indices in assessing disease severity in ulcerative colitis at the National IBD Conference in Vizag in 2024, and a case of EUS-guided biliary drainage in altered anatomy at ISGCON the same year. He also presented a poster on the neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio as a mortality predictor in ACLF at INASL in 2023, and a case of a rare complication of viral Hepatitis A at the GUT Club in Bhubaneswar.

He was runner-up in the infectious disease quiz at the MAC-ID national conference in Manipal in 2019. Alongside KIMS Hospital he has been at ASRAM Medical College and at Kasturba Medical College under MAHE.

dr-sriram-srikakulapu.bio:
Dr. Sriram Srikakulapu is a Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 14 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is built around endoscopic work on the bile duct. He performs ERCP and GI stenting and treats biliary strictures and bile duct stones, alongside chronic pancreatitis, chronic liver disease, portal hypertension, recurrent GI bleeding and severe functional GI disorders.

His training is recorded by period. He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College between 2006 and 2012, took his MD in general medicine between 2014 and 2017, and his DM in medical gastroenterology between 2017 and 2020.

His research record begins before his specialty training and tracks it closely. He conducted a short term research program for the ICMR in 2008 on stress levels and job satisfaction in doctors, presented a case series on congenital airway malformation at APICON in Tirupathi in 2015, and wrote his postgraduate thesis on the medical management of acute kidney injury in the medical intensive care unit, a study of 350 patients.

His gastroenterology work followed. His DM thesis was on achalasia cardia, its clinical features and post pneumatic dilatation follow up. He presented a paper on ten years' experience in the endoscopic management of biliary strictures at ISGCON in Kochi in 2018, the same subject as the busiest part of his present list, and a poster on portal vein thrombosis at ISGCON in Kolkata in 2019.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals he has been at Medilife Hospitals in Mancherial and Medicover Hospital on Secretariat Road in Hyderabad.

dr-vaibhav-patil.bio:
Dr. Vaibhav Patil is Director of Hepatology at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with liver transplant medicine.

The liver is the centre of his list. He manages liver cirrhosis, chronic liver disease, chronic hepatitis B and C, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases, portal hypertension and refractory ascites. He also performs ERCP and GI stenting and manages chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic cysts and congenital GI disorders.

His route into hepatology is unusual in starting with surgery. He read MBBS at Topiwala National Medical College and Nair Hospital in Mumbai in 2005 and took a diploma in diabetology at the same institution in 2009, then the DNB in general surgery through the National Board of Examinations in 2012 and the DNB in medical gastroenterology through the same board in 2017. His fellowship in transplant hepatology was at Gleneagles Global Hospital in Chennai, running from Jan to Sept 2018.

His hospital record is the most international part of his profile. Alongside Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre and the Institute of Liver Disease and Transplantation at Global Hospitals, both in Chennai, he has been at the University Hospitals of Coventry and Warwickshire, at the South West Liver Unit at Derriford Hospital in Plymouth, at Queen Elizabeth Hospital and the Institute of Biomedical Research at the University of Birmingham, and at Princess Alexandra Hospital in Brisbane.

Several of those overseas posts are at liver units or transplant centres, which places most of his post-qualification career inside the field his present directorship covers.

dr-air-commodore-bhaskar-nandi.bio:
Dr. Air Commodore Bhaskar Nandi is Director and Head of Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Endoscopy at Sarvodaya Hospital in Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 37 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with transplant hepatology.

His list covers the liver and the gut. He performs ERCP and manages chronic hepatitis B and C, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, liver cirrhosis, chronic liver disease and autoimmune liver diseases, alongside inflammatory bowel disease with ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, chronic pancreatitis, recurrent GI bleeding and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in medicine and a DM in gastroenterology.

Most of his career was in the armed forces, and his record names the posts. He was Professor and Head of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Army Hospital (Research and Referral) in New Delhi, and Commandant of the Air Force Central Medical Establishment, also in New Delhi. He was awarded the Vishisht Seva Medal by the President of India for meritorious service in the Armed Forces as a doctor and gastroenterologist.

After the service he was Head of the Department of Clinical and Transplant Hepatology at Amrita Hospital in Faridabad, before his present post at Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8.

His academic record follows the same split. He has been principal investigator or principal worker on 8 Armed Forces Medical Research Committee research projects, has numerous publications in journals and chapters in books, and has contributed to national consensus and guideline work on liver diseases through expert task forces and professional bodies.

dr-anupam-sibal.bio:
Dr. Anupam Sibal is Group Medical Director and Senior Consultant in Pediatric Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with pediatric liver transplant expertise.

Liver disease in children is the centre of his practice. He manages pediatric liver diseases and pediatric liver transplant, pediatric malabsorption syndromes, chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, autoimmune liver diseases, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and chronic hepatitis B and C, and also treats Crohn's disease and acute pancreatitis.

He holds an MBBS and an MD in paediatrics, and took the rest of his training in the United Kingdom, where he was elected a Member of the Royal College of Physicians and a Fellow of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health. He also completed a fellowship in pediatric gastroenterology and hepatology.

His record is built around two firsts in the Indian private sector. He was the first in the private sector to initiate a pediatric liver transplant program in India, and he established India's first dedicated pediatric gastroenterology, hepatology and nutrition division in the private sector. Both are institutional achievements rather than personal honours, which is consistent with a clinical role held alongside a group-level medical directorship.

He has been awarded by several national and international bodies for his contributions to child healthcare, including recognition at the World Congress of Pediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition, has global recognition for advancing pediatric liver transplantation in India, and has received multiple institutional and academic awards for excellence in clinical practice and medical research.

dr-shaik-riyaz.bio:
Dr. Shaik Riyaz is a Consultant Hepatologist and Liver Transplant Physician at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 12 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list divides between the liver and the bile duct. He manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and autoimmune liver diseases, performs ERCP and treats bile duct stones and biliary strictures, and also manages inflammatory bowel disease, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is recent and moves across three states. He read MBBS at Andhra Medical College in Visakhapatnam between 2011 and 2017, took his MD in internal medicine at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal between 2018 and 2021, and his DM in hepatology at Christian Medical College, Vellore between 2022 and 2025.

His two presented papers bracket that training. He took second place for platform presentation at KAPICON 2020 for research on bend apnoea as a novel marker in heart failure, work from his internal medicine years, and a poster of distinction at INASL 2025 for a comparison of conventional coagulation markers and ROTEM in alcohol related ACLF and chronic liver disease, which sits in the field he now practises in.

He is a life member of four bodies: the Indian National Association for Study of Liver Disease, the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, the Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy of India and the ISG Tamil Nadu chapter. Alongside KIMS Hospital his record lists Christian Medical College, Vellore, where his DM was taken.

dr-arpit-shastri.bio:
Dr. Arpit Shastri is an Associate Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 9 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine alongside hepatology and therapeutic endoscopy.

Those three headings describe his list. On the liver he manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, autoimmune liver diseases, chronic hepatitis B and C and portal hypertension. On the endoscopic side he performs ERCP and treats bile duct stones, biliary strictures, pancreatic cysts, chronic pancreatitis and recurrent GI bleeding. He also manages severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is entirely recent and was taken in New Delhi and Chandigarh. He read MBBS at Vardhman Mahavir Medical College and Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi in 2017, took his MD in medicine at ABVIMS and Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital in 2021, and his DM in hepatology at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research in Chandigarh in 2025.

His conference record is dense for the length of his career and is almost entirely endoscopic. He won first prize for the presidential abstract at ENDOCON in Delhi in 2024, second prize for case presentation at ENDOCON in Jaipur in 2025, second prize in the endoscopy clinic session at ISGCON in Amritsar in 2025, second prize for video presentation at ISGCON in Bengaluru in 2023, and third prize for video presentation at the EUS Summit held by the Asian Institute of Gastroenterology in Hyderabad in 2023.

Five prizes in three years, four of them for video or case presentation, describe academic output in demonstrated technique rather than in written papers.

dr-b-ravi-shankar.bio:
Dr. B. Ravi Shankar is Director of Medical Gastroenterology and Chief of Academics in the Department of Gastroenterology at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with interventional gastroenterology.

His list is short and concentrated on the bile duct and the liver. He performs ERCP and treats biliary strictures and bile duct stones, and manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension and severe GERD.

His qualifications are dated and were taken over a decade. He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College in Hyderabad in 1986, took both his MD in internal medicine and the DNB in internal medicine at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal in 1991, and his DM in gastroenterology at the Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Lucknow in 1996.

Holding both an MD and a DNB in the same subject from the same year is unusual, and it means he qualified through two separate examination systems before moving into the specialty.

He is a national member of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology and of the Indian National Association for the Study of the Liver, and was named Legend of the Year in Gastroenterology and GI Surgery at the Times Health Care Achievers awards in 2017.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad he has been at Sunshine Hospitals in Secunderabad and Kamineni Hospitals in Hyderabad. The academic half of his present title sits alongside a clinical practice built on ERCP and interventional work.

dr-d-k-bhargava.bio:
Dr. D K Bhargava is Senior Professor of Gastroenterology at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 45 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list covers the upper gut, the bowel, the liver and the pancreas. He manages gastroesophageal reflux disease and peptic ulcer disease, Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and chronic pancreatitis, and performs advanced polypectomy.

His qualifications are drawn from Indian, Royal College and American bodies. He holds the MD and the DNB, is a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences, a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians, a Fellow of the American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy and a Member of the World Gastroenterology Organisation.

Two of those sit directly on the shape of his practice. Fellowship of the American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy corresponds to the advanced polypectomy work on his list, and membership of the World Gastroenterology Organisation places him inside the global body of the specialty rather than only its Indian one.

His two national honours were both conferred by the President of India: the Padma Shri and the Dr. B.C. Roy National Award.

He is the author of the book Mayo Liver, and his record notes numerous further contributions to the field of gastroenterology through clinical research and publications.

He practises at Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals in Sarita Vihar on the Delhi Mathura Road. A career of more than 45 years, six postgraduate qualifications and two presidential awards describe a gastroenterologist whose standing is recorded largely in honours and in teaching rank.

dr-koushik-chavalla.bio:
Dr. Koushik Chavalla is a Junior Consultant Gastroenterologist and Hepatologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 12 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is built around the bile duct and the liver. He performs ERCP and GI stenting and treats biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts. On the liver he manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and refractory ascites, and he also manages inflammatory bowel disease, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training took an unusual route. He read MBBS between 2008 and 2014, then took a diploma in emergency medicine between 2015 and 2016 before his MD in internal medicine between 2016 and 2019. His DM in medical gastroenterology at Bharati Vidyapeeth University ran from 2022 to 2025, and he placed Rank 1 in it.

His most recent training is in the two techniques at the head of his list. He holds an advanced endoscopy fellowship in endoscopic ultrasound and ERCP at Yashoda Hospital, running from October 2025 to March 2026. He has also completed a certificate course in the prevention and management of diabetic and cardiovascular diseases at the Chellaram Diabetes Institute.

His earlier posts were in internal medicine rather than gastroenterology. He was Senior Resident in internal medicine at D.Y. Patil Hospital and Assistant Professor in internal medicine at Mallareddy Hospital, so the emergency medicine diploma and those two appointments give him a general medical background beneath a subspecialty practice.

dr-pawan-rawal.bio:
Dr. Pawan Rawal is a Senior Director at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

ERCP is the procedure his record puts first, and it notes over 15 years of experience with it in adult and paediatric settings. Alongside it he performs therapeutic endoscopy across the GI tract, endoscopic hemostasis for GI bleeding, and GI stenting including third space endoscopy techniques, and manages biliary strictures endoscopically.

His medical list runs from the pancreas to the liver. He manages acute and chronic pancreatitis and complex pancreaticobiliary disorders, chronic liver disease including cirrhosis and its complications, and chronic hepatitis B and C. His record notes clinical trial leadership in hepatitis C, including the Sofosbuvir launch trial in India.

Paediatric work runs through his profile rather than sitting beside it. He manages pediatric liver diseases and pediatric malabsorption syndromes, and the paediatric setting is named again in the ERCP entry, which is unusual in an adult gastroenterology practice.

He read MBBS at Pt. BD Sharma PGIMS in Rohtak, took his MD at GSVM Medical College in Kanpur and his DM in gastroenterology at PGIMER in Chandigarh.

His awards date from two consecutive years. He received a travel fellowship to the World Congress of Gastroenterology in London in 2009, and the best paper award at the National Conference of Paediatric Gastroenterology in Mumbai in 2008, along with multiple national awards for scientific papers and academic excellence that year. He is invited faculty at several international gastroenterology forums and an active member of key gastroenterology societies.

dr-shankar-zanwar.bio:
Dr. Shankar Zanwar is a Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 16 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with the endoscopic therapeutic side of surgical gastroenterology.

His list is concentrated on the bile duct and the pancreas. He performs ERCP and treats bile duct stones, biliary strictures, gallstones, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts. Alongside that he manages chronic liver disease, recurrent GI bleeding and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

He holds an MBBS, an MD and the DNB.

His hospital record is the most detailed part of his profile and runs from a government medical college through a national referral centre into the Mumbai private sector. It lists Shri M P Shah Medical Government College in Jamnagar and Christian Medical College, Vellore, then Care Hospital in Nagpur, and in Mumbai the Wockhardt Hospital at Mumbai Central, Max Nanavati Super Specialty Hospital and H N Reliance Hospital, before his present post at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel.

Six hospitals across four cities, with the endoscopic half of his profile recorded as a specialization in its own right, describe a career built on therapeutic endoscopy rather than on general clinic work. Bile duct stones, biliary strictures and pancreatic cysts, the three conditions his list names most specifically, are all approached through the endoscope rather than medically, and they sit directly beneath the ERCP entry that heads his procedure list.

dr-varun-addagarla.bio:
Dr. Varun Addagarla is a Consultant Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist and Therapeutic Endoscopist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 5 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list follows that three-part title. He performs ERCP and treats biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts, manages chronic liver disease and chronic hepatitis B and C, and handles inflammatory bowel disease including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, alongside recurrent GI bleeding and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training was taken entirely in Telangana and is dated year by year. He read MBBS at Mamata Medical College in Khammam between 2007 and 2013, took the DNB in internal medicine at Yashoda Hospital in Malakpet, Hyderabad, between 2016 and 2019, and his DM in gastroenterology and hepatology at Gandhi Medical College in Hyderabad between 2020 and 2023.

His research is on the pancreas, the organ his endoscopic list is built around. He has published on the profile and outcomes of symptomatic pancreatic fluid collections at a tertiary care hospital, which is the drainage problem behind the pancreatic cyst and chronic pancreatitis entries on his list.

His posts have all been in and around Hyderabad. Alongside Yashoda Hospitals in Hitec City he has been at Care Hospital in Musheerabad, Osmania Hospital, Shri Sigma Hospitals in Madhapur, Maheshwara Medical College in Patancheru and Yashoda Hospital in Malakpet, where he took his DNB.

dr-yogesh-batra.bio:
Dr. Yogesh Batra is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is built on the endoscope. He performs ERCP, therapeutic endoscopy, advanced polypectomy, endoscopic hemostasis, endoscopic dilatation and GI stenting. On the medical side he manages chronic liver disease, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic pancreatitis, gastroesophageal reflux disease, and inflammatory bowel disease in the form of Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.

Both of his first degrees were taken at GSVM Medical College in Kanpur: the MBBS and the MD in medicine. He then took his DM in gastroenterology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi.

Publication is the largest part of his record. He has more than 50 ISI publications and 80 publications in PubMed, has organized numerous conferences, and has been selected as an evaluator for national-level conferences and journals. He has also travelled to institutions in Hong Kong and Germany, and his record notes a national chapter role in events.

An output on that scale, alongside an evaluator role for journals and conferences, places the academic half of his work at about the same weight as the clinical half. The procedures at the head of his list, from advanced polypectomy through endoscopic hemostasis to stenting, are all interventional rather than diagnostic, so both sides of his record describe a practice at the therapeutic end of the specialty.

dr-adi-rakesh-kumar.bio:
Dr. Adi Rakesh Kumar is a Consultant Gastroenterologist, Therapeutic Endoscopist and Endosonologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 23 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is short and specific. He performs ERCP and treats biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts, and manages chronic liver disease, portal hypertension and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is dated by year and was taken in two cities. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College under NTR University of Health Sciences in Hyderabad between 1997 and 2003, took his MD in general medicine at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal between 2004 and 2007, and returned to Osmania Medical College for his DM in gastroenterology between 2008 and 2011.

The entry after that sequence is what gives him the third title on his profile. In 2012 he completed a fellowship in advanced endoscopy in ERCP and EUS at the Institute of Advanced Endoscopy in Mumbai, and endosonology is named in his designation alongside therapeutic endoscopy.

His posts have all been in Hyderabad. He has been at Osmania General Hospital, Narayana Hrudayalaya Hospital, Apollo Hospitals and Gleneagles Global Hospital before his present post at Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad, so his whole career has been spent in the city he trained in, moving from the government teaching hospital into the private tertiary sector.

dr-amitabha-dutta.bio:
Dr. Amitabha Dutta is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 33 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is weighted towards endoscopic intervention. He performs ERCP for biliary and pancreatic conditions, therapeutic endoscopy across a range of GI disorders, endoscopic hemostasis for gastrointestinal bleeding, endoscopic dilatation for strictures of the GI tract, and advanced polypectomy for complex polyps.

His medical list covers the upper gut, the bowel and the liver. He manages gastroesophageal reflux disease and peptic ulcer disease, treats Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, and manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis and its complications, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.

His qualifications after the MBBS were all taken through the Royal College of Physicians and the national academy. He holds the MRCP of the UK, is a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of London and a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh, and holds the MNAMS. Holding both the London and the Edinburgh fellowship is unusual, and it means his physicianly credentials were examined twice over.

His memberships span three bodies and two countries. He belongs to the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, the Indian Association for Study of the Liver and the American Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, the last of which matches the interventional half of his list.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals in South Delhi, at Sector 26, Sarita Vihar, on the Mathura Road.

dr-archish-kataria.bio:
Dr. Archish Kataria is a Senior Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 13 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with the endoscopic side of surgical gastroenterology.

His list is a pancreaticobiliary one. He performs ERCP and GI stenting and treats bile duct stones, biliary strictures, gallstones, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts, and also manages inflammatory bowel disease and severe functional GI disorders.

Most of his postgraduate training was taken in the USA. He read MBBS at Calcutta National Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata in 2013, then completed an internal medicine residency at University of Texas Health in San Antonio between Jul 2015 and Jun 2018, and a gastroenterology fellowship at the same institution between Jul 2018 and Jun 2021. He was certified as a Diplomate of the American Board of Internal Medicine in 2018, and holds a further pancreas-biliary fellowship from the University of New Mexico in Albuquerque taken in 2025.

That last fellowship is the one his clinical list is built on, and it is the second subspecialty fellowship in his record rather than the first.

He held two teaching roles during his American training, as gastroenterology chief fellow and as internal medicine teaching resident at University of Texas Health. As a student he received a certificate of honour in preventive and social medicine, pharmacology and ophthalmology from the West Bengal University of Health Sciences in Kolkata.

dr-deepak-goyal.bio:
Dr. Deepak Goyal is Additional Director of Gastroenterology at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in the Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is a paediatric one. He manages pediatric liver diseases, pediatric malabsorption syndromes, pediatric liver transplant and congenital GI disorders, alongside malabsorption syndromes, autoimmune liver diseases and chronic liver disease. In the bowel he manages Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, and he also performs therapeutic endoscopy and manages gastroesophageal reflux disease and severe functional GI disorders.

His training explains that weighting. Both of his first degrees were taken at SMS Medical College under the University of Rajasthan, the MBBS and the MD in paediatrics, and his subspecialty training was a post doctoral certificate course at SGPGI in Lucknow. He came into gastroenterology as a paediatrician rather than as a physician, which is why paediatric liver disease and malabsorption head his list rather than adult hepatology.

His society work is in the same field. He was an executive member of the Indian Society of Pediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition for 2018 to 2019.

He is invited faculty at various national and international conferences, has multiple publications in indexed medical journals and has presented at national and international forums.

Alongside Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurgaon he practises at Fortis Hospital in Noida, so his week covers two sites within the NCR.

dr-dinesh-jothimani.bio:
Dr. Dinesh Jothimani is Director of Hepatology at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 19 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with transplant hepatology.

His list is almost entirely hepatological. He manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, chronic hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver diseases and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and also performs ERCP.

He read MBBS at Madras Medical College and Government General Hospital under Dr. MGR Medical University in Chennai in 2000, then took his specialist training in the United Kingdom. He passed the MRCP in 2004 and completed his CCT in hepatology, gastroenterology and general medicine through the West Midlands Deanery between 2004 and 2010, and was elected FRCP of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow in 2018.

His career is recorded post by post with dates, and it moves through the hospitals of three countries. He was Specialist Registrar in hepatology at Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Birmingham from 2004 to 2005, a hepatology research fellow at Princess Alexandra Hospital in Brisbane from 2008 to 2009, and locum Consultant Hepatologist at the University Hospitals of Coventry and Warwickshire from 2010 to 2011. He returned to Chennai as consultant and liver transplant physician at Global Hospitals from 2012 to 2018, and has been Director of Hepatology at Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre since 2018.

Every post in that sequence is in hepatology or liver transplant work, so the transplant half of his profile rests on a run of dedicated appointments rather than on a single fellowship.

dr-srinivas-m-1.bio:
Dr. Srinivas M is a Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity in Chennai, with more than 25 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list covers the bowel, the oesophagus and the pancreas. He manages inflammatory bowel disease including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, treats achalasia, for which Heller myotomy appears on his list, and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease, and performs ERCP while managing chronic pancreatitis and chronic liver disease.

He read MBBS at Stanley Medical College in Chennai, then took his higher qualifications through the Royal College of Physicians in the United Kingdom, passing the MRCP and later being elected a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians in London.

His record is unusual in how much of it is editorial rather than clinical. He is a past Editor-in-Chief of Clinical Medicine Insights: Gastroenterology, an e-journal, and sits on the editorial board of the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology. He is also an honorary clinical lecturer at the University of Sheffield, which keeps a UK academic appointment alongside his Chennai practice.

He has presented abstracts at the annual conferences of the British, American and Indian societies of gastroenterology, several of them recognized with prizes, so his work has been put before all three of the bodies his training and practice span.

Within his own hospital he is clinical lead of the institutional ethics committee at Gleneagles Global Health City, a governance role that sits outside the clinical list and is not common on a consultant's record.

dr-anilkumar-mannava.bio:
Dr. Anilkumar Mannava is a Consultant Gastroenterologist and Hepatologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 16 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is built around the bile duct and the pancreas. He performs ERCP and GI stenting and treats biliary strictures, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts. On the liver he manages chronic liver disease and chronic hepatitis B and C, and he also treats severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is dated and moves across three states. He read MBBS at Dr. Pinnamaneni Siddhartha Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Foundation in Gannavaram, Vijayawada, under NTR University of Health Sciences in 2010, took his MD in general medicine at Sri Devaraj Urs Medical College in Kolar, Karnataka, in 2014, and the DNB in gastroenterology at Global Hospital in Lakdikapul, Hyderabad, in 2018.

Taking the specialty qualification through the DNB route at a tertiary care hospital rather than through a university DM is the distinguishing feature of that sequence, and Global Hospital remains on his list of affiliations.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad and Global Hospital in Lakdikapul, his record lists KMC in Mangalore, KMC Manipal and Sri Devaraj Urs Medical College in Kolar, where his MD was taken. Five affiliations across three states describe a career that moved south for its postgraduate years before settling in Hyderabad.

dr-brajendra-prasad-singh.bio:
Dr. Brajendra Prasad Singh is Director of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine alongside therapeutic endoscopy and core gastroenterology and hepatology.

His list covers the biliary tree, the pancreas, the liver and the bowel. He performs ERCP and treats bile duct stones, gallstones, chronic pancreatitis and pancreatic cysts. On the liver he manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, chronic hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver diseases and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and he also manages inflammatory bowel disease and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in medicine and the DNB in gastroenterology.

His career is recorded with dates and has been spent in three New Delhi hospitals. He was at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital from October 2005 to September 2010, at Rockland Hospital from September 2010 to August 2013, and has been at Saket City Hospital, now Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, since August 2013. More than a decade in his present post, after two appointments of about five and three years, describes a settled rather than a mobile career.

His recognition comes from patients rather than from professional bodies. He has won awards multiple times based on patient feedback at Saket City Hospital and Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, and was voted for by patients at Max Smart in 2016.

dr-deepak-kumar-gupta.bio:
Dr. Deepak Kumar Gupta is a Consultant at Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai, with more than 17 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is an interventional endoscopy list. He performs ERCP, therapeutic endoscopy, advanced polypectomy, endoscopic hemostasis, endoscopic dilatation and GI stenting. On the medical side he manages peptic ulcer disease, gastroesophageal reflux disease, chronic liver disease, chronic pancreatitis, and inflammatory bowel disease as Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in internal medicine, the DNB in gastroenterology and the FNB, and took his DM in gastroenterology at Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital in Mumbai between 2013 and 2016. Holding both the DM and the DNB in the same specialty means he qualified through two separate examination systems.

Two shorter courses sit earlier in his record, both from May 2008. He enrolled in the PGDL course and completed an ICU course for DM awarded by DMH, so critical care training preceded his specialty years.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai, at CBD Belapur opposite Nerul Wonders Park. With six interventional procedures at the head of his list and five qualifications behind them, his record describes a gastroenterologist whose practice is concentrated on endoscopic treatment rather than on diagnostic work alone.

dr-kapil-dev-jamwal.bio:
Dr. Kapil Dev Jamwal is Chief of Innovation and GI Interventions and a department head at Artemis Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience in gastroenterology.

His title names intervention before anything else, and his list matches it. He performs ERCP, therapeutic endoscopy, advanced polypectomy, endoscopic dilatation, endoscopic hemostasis and GI stenting. Six of the twelve entries on his list are procedures rather than conditions, which is unusual even among therapeutic endoscopists.

On the medical side he manages acute and chronic pancreatitis, biliary strictures, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, gastroesophageal reflux disease and severe functional GI disorders. The pancreas and the bile duct account for three of those, which is the territory ERCP and stenting are used in.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in general medicine and a DM in gastroenterology and hepatology, and completed a fellowship in advanced GI endoscopy, the FAGIE after his name. His education record also lists Japan, the USA and South Korea.

He practises at Artemis Hospitals in Gurgaon. The innovation half of his title has no separate entry in his record, but the shape of the rest of it, a procedure-led list, a dedicated advanced endoscopy fellowship and education recorded in three countries, describes a practice organised around technique rather than around a single organ.

dr-ramesh-garg.bio:
Dr. Ramesh Garg is a Senior Consultant at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatology.

His list is led by endoscopic procedures. He performs ERCP, therapeutic endoscopy, GI stenting, endoscopic hemostasis and advanced polypectomy, and manages biliary strictures and choledocholithiasis endoscopically. Beyond the endoscope he manages acute and chronic pancreatitis, chronic liver disease, malabsorption syndromes, and inflammatory bowel disease as Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
