His training was taken in Delhi at two institutions. He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College, associated with Lok Nayak Hospital, and took his MD in medicine at the same college, then his DM in gastroenterology at G B Pant Hospital.

His hospital record has stayed in the same city. He has been at Jaipur Golden Hospital and Saroj Hospital before his present post at Fortis Hospital in Shalimar Bagh, so the whole of his training and practice has been in Delhi.

He is a member of the Indian Association of Gastroenterology and of the Indian Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy. The second of those matches the half of his list that is procedural: with five endoscopic procedures named separately, and choledocholithiasis listed specifically as endoscopic management, his own record describes an interventional practice rather than a purely medical one.

dr-s-babu-kumar.bio:
Dr. S. Babu Kumar is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity in Chennai, with more than 19 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine alongside medical gastroenterology and interventional endoscopy.

His list carries both of those last two headings. On the interventional side he performs ERCP and treats biliary strictures and bile duct stones. Medically he manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, chronic hepatitis B, chronic pancreatitis, inflammatory bowel disease, severe functional GI disorders and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease.

His training is dated and moves between two cities. He read MBBS at Coimbatore Medical College in 2000 and took his MD in general medicine at the same college in 2005, then his DM in gastroenterology at Kilpauk Medical College in Chennai in 2011.

Between the MD and the DM he ranked 1st in Tamil Nadu in the DM entrance examinations of 2008, which is the most specific achievement in his record.

His academic work is recorded in three forms. He has presented various topics in scientific forums, authored numerous original articles and case reports in peer-reviewed journals, and guided Ph.D. students as an expert advisor for their theses. The last of those is a supervisory role rather than a publishing one, and it is uncommon on a consultant gastroenterologist's record.

He practises at Gleneagles Global Hospital in Chennai.

dr-vishal-garg.bio:
Dr. Vishal Garg is a Consultant Gastroenterologist at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 16 years of experience in gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

The liver takes up most of his list. He manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, portal hypertension, chronic hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver diseases and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Beyond the liver he performs ERCP and therapeutic endoscopy and manages peptic ulcer disease, inflammatory bowel disease and gastroesophageal reflux disease.

He holds an MBBS, took his MD in medicine at Maulana Azad Medical College in New Delhi, and his DM in gastroenterology at G.B. Pant Hospital, also in New Delhi.

His student record carries two silver medals, both for second place in a professional examination: microbiology in the second professional examination in 1999, and ophthalmology in the final professional examination in 2000. Neither subject is gastroenterological, which places those distinctions in his general medical years rather than in the specialty he went on to.

His one recorded presentation is at the top of his field. He gave an oral presentation at the annual meeting of the American Association for the Study of the Liver in Boston in 2010, which sits on the hepatology half of his practice, the half his clinical list is weighted towards.

He practises at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in New Delhi and at Apollo Hospitals in Noida.

dr-mohammed-abdun-nayeem.bio:
Dr. Mohammed Abdun Nayeem is Clinical Director and Head of the Department of Liver Transplantation, HPB and GI Surgery at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

Transplantation heads his list. He performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, and his record specifies transplants for babies weighing less than 5 kg. Alongside that he performs liver tumor surgery, the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy and gastrectomy.

His qualifications were taken between 1997 and 2020 and in two countries. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College under NTR University in Hyderabad in 1997, took his M.S. in surgery at PGIMER in Chandigarh in 2004, the MRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons in England in 2007 and the M.Ch in GI surgery at Delhi University in 2010, followed by a post doctoral fellowship in liver transplant at the Medanta Institute Liver Transplant in Delhi in 2011. He was elected a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons in 2020.

His examination and conference record is a run of placings. He ranked first in the All India MCh surgical gastroenterology entrance examination at Delhi University in 2007 and took second prize in the quiz at the IASG conference at AIIMS the same year, with a best poster award at the IHPBA conference in Bangalore in 2009.

He is a life member of the Liver Transplant Society of India, the Association of Surgeons of India, IASG and IHPBA, and a member of ILTS, IASGO and the Royal and American colleges of surgeons.

dr-vijaykumar-c-bada.bio:
Dr. Vijaykumar C Bada is Senior Consultant and Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list covers the pancreas, the liver and the upper gut. He performs the Whipple procedure and pancreatectomy, liver tumor surgery, gastrectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

His qualifications are unusually numerous. Alongside the MBBS, the MS in surgery and the DNB in surgical gastroenterology he holds four fellowships: the FMAS in minimal access surgery, the FAIS of the Association of Indian Surgeons, the FIAGES of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endosurgeons and the FACRS of the Association of Colon and Rectal Surgeons. Three of those four are in minimally invasive or endoscopic surgery.

His record names a specific first. He performed the first total laparoscopic Whipple procedure in AP and Telangana, which is the most technically demanding operation on his list done by the least invasive route. His record also notes a high volume robotic hernia practice and a live operative robotics workshop.

He received a Young Investigator Award from the International Association of Pancreatologists, a best paper award at ASICON South, and was named Best Gastroenterologist in AP and Telangana by Times in 2019. He has multiple publications in the World Journal of Laparoscopic Surgery, five in the International Journal of Surgery, and further work in the Indian Journal of Surgery.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals he has been at KIMS Kondapur, Global Hospitals and Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences.

dr-kumar-palaniappan.bio:
Dr. Kumar Palaniappan is Clinical Lead for Laparoscopy Liver Surgery at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

Transplantation runs through his list. He performs liver transplant, pancreas transplant and simultaneous pancreas-kidney transplant, alongside liver tumor surgery, the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy and gastrectomy.

His training is dated and moves from Bangalore through Madurai to Gurgaon. He read MBBS at Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences in Bangalore in 1999, took the DNB in general surgery in 2004 and the DNB in surgical gastroenterology in 2009, both at Meenakshi Mission Hospital and Research Centre in Madurai, and a fellowship in liver transplantation and HPB surgery at Medanta in Gurgaon in 2012.

Three further placements are all in minimally invasive technique, and they explain the laparoscopic half of his job title. He took robotic HPB surgery training at the Vattikutti Institute of Robotic Surgery, advanced training in HPB and liver transplant surgery at Asan Medical Center in Seoul, and laparoscopic liver surgery training at Iwate Medical University in Japan.

His conference record is heavily Japanese. He won a best paper award and travel grant at the Japanese HPB Society consensus conference on laparoscopic liver resection in Morioka in 2014, and again at the 27th meeting of the same society in Tokyo in June 2015, along with a best paper award at the IASGO conference in Tokyo that month. He also holds a best video award from IHPBA 2012 in Mumbai for auxiliary partial liver transplantation for propionic acidemia, and a best poster award from IHPBA in Ahmedabad in 2016.

dr-p-siva-charan-reddy.bio:
Dr. P. Siva Charan Reddy is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list is built on the liver and the pancreas. He performs liver transplant and liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy and the Whipple procedure, and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

His training is dated and was taken at three institutions. He read MBBS at Annamalai University in 2006 and took his MS in general surgery there in 2009, then the MCh in surgical gastroenterology at Narayana Medical College in Nellore in 2013. He also holds three fellowships: the FMAS in minimal access surgery, the FIAGES of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo-Surgeons and the FICRS of the Indian College of Robotic Surgery, so the minimally invasive and robotic sides of his practice are separately credentialled.

The most specific entry in his record is a transplant first. He was part of the team that performed the first cadaver liver transplant at the Government Institute in Telangana, and he has received Jeevandan appreciation from the Government of Telangana for liver transplant surgeries.

His other awards are professional recognitions: the Best Surgical Gastroenterologist Award from HI9 in 2015, the Abdul Kalam Award for best surgical gastroenterologist in 2018, and the Prathiba Puraskar Award in 2021.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals he has been at Apollo Hospitals in Jubilee Hills, Care Hospital and Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad, and at Narayana Medical College and Shadan Medical College.

dr-mizelle-dsilva.bio:
Dr. Mizelle Dsilva is a Consultant Surgical Oncologist at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience. The profile records surgical oncology alongside surgical gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

The operating list sits at the intersection of those three. It covers liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy and the Whipple procedure, which are the major resections of the liver and pancreas rather than the wider range of general GI surgery.

Four fellowships follow an MBBS and the DNB in general surgery, and each adds one layer to that list. A fellowship in minimal access surgery was taken at Saifee Hospital in Mumbai, followed by one in minimal access HPB surgery, then GI and HPB oncology at Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai, and hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery at Seoul National University Bundang Hospital in South Korea. The record also lists a current fellowship in hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery at Tata Memorial Hospital.

The academic record is substantial for the length of the career. It includes over 50 publications in peer-reviewed national and international journals, contributing authorship of the Atlas of Laparoscopic Liver Resection in 2021, and membership of the research committee of the International Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary Association for 2024 to 2026. A Young Investigator Award came from the EASL Liver Cancer Summit in Prague in 2020, and a best oral paper presentation in the liver category from IHPBA India in March 2025.

Hospitals on the record include Jaslok, Holy Family, Seven Hills, Elizabeth, K.B. Bhabha in Bandra and Saifee, all in Mumbai.

dr-narasimhaiah-srinivasaiah.bio:
Dr. Narasimhaiah Srinivasaiah is a Consultant Surgical Gastroenterologist and Bariatric Surgeon at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 20 years of experience in surgical gastro, HPB and transplant work.

His list is the broadest in this specialty. Colorectal work covers colorectal resection and operable colorectal cancer. Laparoscopic general surgery covers cholecystectomy and hernia repair, including incisional and inguinal hernia. Bariatric work covers sleeve gastrectomy and minimally invasive bariatric surgery. He also performs liver resection, and on the breast, breast-conserving surgery, sentinel lymph node biopsy and the management of fibroadenoma.

His qualifications are drawn from four systems. Alongside the MBBS, the MS in general surgery and the MCh in surgical gastroenterology from RGUHS in Bangalore, he holds an MD from the UK, the MRCS of Edinburgh, the FRCS of the UK, the FACS of the American College of Surgeons, the FICS of the International College of Surgeons, European Board of Surgery certification and fellowship of the Inter-Collegiate Board of Surgeons in the UK. His record notes fellowship recognition from the Royal College of Surgeons in England, Edinburgh, Glasgow and Dublin.

Two entries sit outside surgery altogether. He passed the National Board entrance test in 2017 for a postgraduate diploma course in respiratory medicine in India and completed that course, and he was awarded a gold medal by the Association of Pharmacology of Tamilnadu in 2014.

He has additional training and fellowships at Apollo Hospitals in Chennai, King's College Hospital and the University of London, reviews for surgical journals and sits on their editorial boards, and has written chapters in Recent Advances in Surgery and Ultrasound of the Breast.

dr-prithiviraj-nabi.bio:
Dr. Prithiviraj Nabi is an Associate Consultant at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list covers transplantation and major resection. He performs liver transplant and pancreas transplant, liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy, the Whipple procedure, gastrectomy and cholecystectomy.

His training is dated and moves through four institutions. He read MBBS at Madurai Medical College in 2008, took his MS in general surgery at PGIMER in Chandigarh in 2012, the MCh in surgical gastroenterology at GB Pant Hospital in New Delhi in 2017 and the DNB in the same subject through the NBE board in 2018. He also holds the FMAS in minimal access surgery, the FALS in advanced laparoscopic oncology and fellowship of the American College of Surgeons.

His record carries three academic firsts across those years. He took the first order medal in his MS general surgery examination in May 2012, was best outgoing student in the MCh GI surgery exit examination in 2017, and won the best orator award in a national-level debate in GI surgery as a Torrentz Young Scholar in 2016.

Later recognition came from outside the examination hall. He won best e-poster at the IASG virtual annual conference at AIIMS Bhubaneshwar in 2021 for work on radiation induced liver injury mimicking metastasis, and a Vocational Excellence Award from Rotary West in 2020 for work in gastroenterology and organ donation awareness.

His posts include Paul Brousse Hospital in Paris, KIMS in Trivandrum and Vadamalayan Hospital in Madurai.

dr-sudheer-moodadla.bio:
Dr. Sudheer Moodadla is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list is short and concentrated on the upper abdomen. He performs the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

His training is recorded to the month. He read MBBS at Mamata Medical College in Khammam between Dec 2000 and Oct 2005, took his MS in general surgery at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal between May 2009 and May 2012, and the DrNB in surgical gastroenterology at Yashoda Hospitals in Hyderabad between Feb 2016 and Dec 2018. His FMAS in minimal access surgery was taken at Kim's Hospital in Secunderabad.

Two later certifications bracket his practice at either end of its technical range. He was certified in national basic life support at Yashoda Hospitals in Oct 2018, and took robotic surgery console certification with Intuitive Surgical in Mar 2025.

Teaching is recorded through three faculty certificates of appreciation, from the Hyderabad AWR Update run by Pace Hospitals and from Medtronic and BARD workshops. He also received the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Health and Medical Excellence Award from ACT NOW in 2021 and the Vaidyasree Award from Mega City Nava Kala Vedika in 2023.

He belongs to the Association of Surgeons of India, AMASI and IASG, and has also worked at KIMS Hospitals in Secunderabad, Apollo Hospitals in Hyderabad and Yashoda Hospitals in Somajiguda.

dr-arvinder-singh-soin.bio:
Dr. Arvinder Singh Soin is Chairman of Liver Transplant at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastro, HPB and transplant work together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine.

His list is one of the most specialised in the specialty and stays entirely within the liver and biliary tree. He performs deceased donor liver transplant, pediatric liver transplant and liver retransplantation, liver resection, complex HPB tumor surgery, gallbladder cancer surgery, biliary tract tumor resection, biliary reconstruction and hepaticojejunostomy, and manages operable and benign liver tumors and pediatric liver disease.

He holds an MBBS, an MS taken with a thesis, the primary FRCS and the FRCS in general surgery.

Three of his awards are international and all predate his present post. He was awarded a visiting fellowship at the Kyoto Liver Transplant Unit, a British Transplantation Society Bursary in 1994, and a research grant from the Royal College of Surgeons in Edinburgh in 1996. Kyoto and a transplantation society bursary between them place his early training in the same field his career has stayed in.

His later recognition is Indian. He received a DMA Award in 2010, and the Swastha Bharat Samman and an E-Medinews Award in 2011, and his achievements are listed in the Limca Book of Records for 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010.

He practises at Medanta in Gurugram, at Medanta Lucknow and at the Medanta MediClinic in Defence Colony.

dr-prashanth-rao.bio:
Dr. Prashanth Rao is Director and a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 34 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology alongside general surgery, bariatric and metabolic surgery, and GI-related surgical oncology.

His list covers the upper gut, the pancreas and the liver. He performs anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication, gastrectomy, the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy and liver tumor surgery.

His qualifications run to nine entries and are weighted towards laparoscopy. He read MBBS and took his MS in general surgery with 1st rank at Mumbai University, then the FRCS of Edinburgh, the DNB and the MNAMS. His laparoscopic credentials are a diploma in laparoscopic surgery taken in France, the FMAS in minimal access surgery, the FIAGES, and an honorary FALS in advanced laparoscopy.

His awards follow the same line. He holds a best video laparoscopy CD award from MASICON and a best video award for single port cholecystectomy at the ELSA and IAGES Asia Pacific Conference in Hyderabad, and was named Best Laparoscopic Surgeon in Maharashtra at the International Health Summit Award in 2017. Earlier he took 1st rank in his MS and the Dr. AV Baliga Memorial Prize.

He has more than 40 peer-reviewed publications in reputed journals and has written three or more book chapters on laparoscopic surgery, so the technique that shapes his fellowships and his awards also shapes his writing.

He practises at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel.

dr-y-srimannarayana.bio:
Dr. Y. Srimannarayana is a Consultant Surgical Gastroenterologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 19 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with general surgery.

His list is short and sits in the upper abdomen. He performs the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy, gastrectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

His training is dated and was taken across three institutions. He read MBBS at Guntur Medical College between 2002 and 2007, took his MS in general surgery at Rangaraya Medical College in Kakinada between 2009 and 2012, and the DNB in surgical gastroenterology at Yashoda Hospitals between 2015 and 2018.

His four fellowships are all in minimally invasive technique, two of them robotic. He holds the FALS in advanced laparoscopic surgery and the FICRS in robotic surgery, both recorded as robotic, along with the FIAGES of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo Surgeons and the FMAS of the Association of Minimal Access Surgeons.

His posts are recorded with dates and describe a steady move towards the centre of Hyderabad. He was at KIMS Narketpally in Nalgonda from 2012 to 2015, Century Hospital in Banjara Hills from 2018 to 2020, Renowa Hospitals from 2020 to 2022 and Medicover Hospitals from 2022 to 2025, before his present post at Yashoda Hospitals in Somajiguda.

He belongs to the Association of Surgeons of India, IAGES, AMASI, IASG and the Indian chapter of the Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary Association.

dr-krishna-chowdary-amirineni.bio:
Dr. Krishna Chowdary Amirineni is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 13 years of experience. His profile records general surgery alongside surgical gastroenterology and bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list runs from routine to major abdominal surgery. He performs cholecystectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication at one end, and liver resection and the Whipple procedure at the other.

His training is dated and was taken in two states. He read MBBS under NTR University of Health Sciences in Andhra Pradesh between 2006 and 2011, taking distinction in 7 subjects, and his MS in general surgery at Kamineni Institute of Medical Sciences and Kamineni Hospitals in Hyderabad between 2012 and 2015, where he won the university silver medal in general surgery, placing second among 3,000 students.

His registrations cover three councils and two countries. He is registered with the General Medical Council in the UK and with the Andhra Pradesh and Tamilnadu medical councils, and he has worked at Scarborough General Hospital and York Teaching Hospital NHS Trust in the United Kingdom.

His other posts have been in Hyderabad and Andhra Pradesh: Kamineni Hospitals, Renova NIGL Hospitals and Medisys Hospitals in Hyderabad, and Liberty Hospitals in Vijayawada.

He led the research wing for postgraduate students at Kamineni Hospital, and was named Emerging GI Surgeon of the Year at the Times Health Awards in 2022.

dr-prasad-behera.bio:
Dr. Prasad Behera is a Consultant Surgical Gastroenterologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 27 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology alongside general surgery and gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

His procedure list spans transplantation and resection. He performs liver transplant and pancreas transplant, and on the resection side the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy, gastrectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

He took both his undergraduate and his postgraduate surgical training at MKCG Medical College in Berhampur, Odisha. His post-qualification letters come from two bodies: he is a Fellow of the Association of Indian Surgeons, awarded by the Association of Surgeons of India in Chennai, and a Fellow of the Academy of General Education at MAHE Manipal in Karnataka.

Society membership is the most detailed part of his record and much of it is for life. He is a life member of the Association of Minimal Access Surgery, the Indian Hernia Society, the Society for Endoscopy and Laparoscopic Surgeons of India, the Association of Surgeons of India, the Association of Medical Science and the Hyderabad Surgical Society, and a member of the Indian Medical Association. The spread across hernia, endoscopy and minimal access bodies tracks the laparoscopic side of his practice.

His hospital history is long and largely set in Hyderabad. Besides KIMS Hospital in Secunderabad he has been associated with Poulomi Hospitals at ECIL X Roads in Rukminipuri and Kamineni Hospitals, both in Hyderabad, and with Durgabai Deshmukh Hospital and Research Centre. Earlier attachments took him to Tata Memorial Hospital in Bombay and the Cancer Hospital and Research Institute in Gwalior.

dr-joy-varghese.bio:
Dr. Joy Varghese is Director of Hepatology and Transplant Hepatology at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records gastroenterology and hepatobiliary medicine together with the liver transplant side of surgical gastroenterology.

His clinical work is liver medicine rather than operating. He manages chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and autoimmune liver diseases, which together cover the range of patients a transplant hepatology service assesses before and after surgery.

His qualifications run from MBBS through MD to a DM in gastroenterology, and he holds a PhD. His transplant training was taken abroad, on a fellowship in liver transplantation at University Hospital in Essen, Germany.

Professional body membership is the broadest part of his record and it is split between Indian and international organisations. In India he belongs to the Association of Physician of India, the Indian Society of Gastroenterology and the Indian National Association for Study of Liver Disease. Internationally he is a member of the International Club of Ascites, the European Association for the Study of Liver Disease, the Liver Transplantation Society of India and the International Liver Transplantation Society. The ascites and hepatology bodies sit directly alongside the cirrhosis work in his procedure list.

He also holds office in two of them. He is a Governing Council Member and Treasurer of the Tamilnadu chapter of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, and Joint Secretary of the Liver Transplant Society of India. His hospital affiliation is Gleneagles Health City in Chennai.

dr-amol-r-jadhav.bio:
Dr. Amol R. Jadhav is Chief Liver Transplant Surgeon and Program Director at Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, surgical oncology, general surgery and hepatobiliary work.

Transplantation leads his list. He performs liver transplant, pediatric liver transplant and multivisceral transplant. The cancer half of his practice covers liver cancer, pancreatic cancer surgery, gallbladder cancer surgery, bile duct cancer surgery and colorectal cancer surgery, with liver tumor surgery, the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy and gastrectomy as the operations behind them.

His training moved from Pune to Surat and then to Delhi. He read MBBS at B.J. Medical College in Pune and took his MS in general surgery at GMC Surat. A fellowship in minimal access surgery followed with AMASI in Chennai, then a post-doctoral fellowship in HPB surgery under MUHS at Jaslok Hospital in Mumbai, and a post-doctoral fellowship in liver transplantation and advanced HPB surgery at Medanta – The Medicity in Delhi NCR. He also holds FHPB and FLT, a minimal access surgery certification from AMASI in Chennai, and certification in basic and advanced endoscopy from the Dr. Nageshwar Reddy Foundation.

He received an LTSI bursary award for the Oxford multi-visceral cadaveric organ retrieval workshop in 2019, and a further bursary from the Liver Transplant Society of India. He is an active member of LTSI, the International Liver Transplantation Society, the Maharashtra Medical Council and AMASI, has presented research papers and posters nationally and internationally, and trains surgical residents and fellows. He also practises at Jupiter Hospital in Pune.

dr-r-a-sastry.bio:
Dr. R. A. Sastry is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 52 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with hepatobiliary and general surgery.

His operating list is concentrated on the upper abdomen. He performs liver tumor surgery, the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy, gastrectomy, anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication and pancreas transplant.

His qualifications are dated across five decades. He read MBBS at JIPMER in Pondicherry in 1974 and took his M.S. in surgery at PGIMER in Chandigarh in 1978. Advanced laparoscopy training followed at Singapore General Hospital in July 1994, and liver transplantation training at the Pittsburgh Transplant Institute, University of Pittsburgh Medical Center, in the USA from March to June 1996. The Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow conferred his FRCS in 2006.

Much of his record is examining and office rather than awards. He is an examiner in M.Ch GI surgery at all centres offering the course and a National Board examiner for the DNB in surgical gastroenterology, and has served as President of the Indian Association of Surgical Gastroenterology and President of the International Hepato Pancreato-Biliary Association in India. He holds the title of Professor of Gastroenterology.

His speaking and publishing record is set out in numbers: nine orations and 140 invited talks delivered, 42 publications in indexed journals and 17 chapters in textbooks. Besides KIMS Hospital in Secunderabad he has been associated with Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad.

dr-anurag-shrimal.bio:
Dr. Anurag Shrimal is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with surgical oncology.

His list is built around abdominal transplantation. He performs liver transplant, pediatric liver transplant, pancreas transplant and multivisceral transplant, with liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy and the Whipple procedure on the resection side.

His qualifications run from MBBS through an MS and DNB in general surgery to MNAMS. His transplant training was taken in the United States: he holds the FASTS in multi-organ abdominal transplant surgery from Duke University and completed the Del Stickel abdominal transplant surgery fellowship at DUMC. He has also had surgical oncology training, which matches the second specialty on his profile.

Several firsts are recorded against his name. His profile credits him with the world's first successful composite vascularised liver and posterior rectus sheath transplant in an adult, and with the first living donor hepatectomy performed after sleeve gastrectomy for morbid obesity. It also records the youngest neonatal cadaveric donor liver transplant, from a five-day-old donor, and the largest series of liver transplants performed for hepatoblastoma in India, which is the paediatric strand of his practice.

Volume is recorded alongside those cases: more than 1,200 liver transplant surgeries with consistently high success rates. Besides Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai he has been associated with Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital and Tata Memorial Hospital, both in the same city.

dr-arul-kumar-s.bio:
Dr. Arul Kumar S is an Associate Consultant at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

His list covers transplantation and upper abdominal resection. He performs liver transplant and simultaneous pancreas-kidney transplant, and also liver tumor surgery, the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy, gastrectomy and surgery for gallstones.

His training is recorded to the month and was taken entirely in the south. He read MBBS at Madras Medical College in Chennai under Dr. M.G.R Medical University between July 2002 and March 2008, and took his M.S. in general surgery at Govt. Stanley Medical College in Chennai between April 2008 and May 2011. A fellowship in HPB surgery at Christian Medical College in Vellore followed from July 2014 to July 2016, and a fellowship in liver transplantation at Gleneagles Global Hospital in Chennai under Prof. Rela from August 2017 to August 2018.

He collected gold medals at both stages of his education. As a postgraduate he won the Dr. Ashok Kumar Inter College Gold Medal in surgical gastroenterology for M.S. postgraduates at Govt. Stanley Medical College, and as an undergraduate the Inter College Gold Medal in rheumatology conducted by the Department of Rheumatology at Madras Medical College. He also took best poster presentation at the Tamilnadu and Pondicherry chapter of the ASI conference in Chennai in 2008 and at the Salem ASI chapter meet in 2009.

Besides Rela Hospital he has worked at Gleneagles Global Hospital, Christian Medical College in Vellore, GEM Hospital and Research Institute in Coimbatore and Sacred Heart Mission Hospital in Irinjalakuda, Thrissur.

dr-gomathy-narasimhan.bio:
Dr. Gomathy Narasimhan is Senior Consultant in Liver and Renal Transplant Surgery at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience. Her profile records surgical gastroenterology together with kidney transplantation.

Transplantation is the whole of her list. She performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, living donor kidney transplant, multivisceral transplant, pancreas transplant and simultaneous pancreas–kidney transplant, with liver tumor surgery alongside them.

Her qualifications are dated. She read MBBS at Kilpauk Medical College in Chennai in 1996 and took her MS in general surgery at Madras Medical College in 2001. Her transplant training was taken in the United States, on an ASTS fellowship in transplant surgery at Baylor University Medical Center in Dallas, Texas, in 2006. She added a GMHE in general management in healthcare at the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore, in 2019.

Her awards run across two decades and three organisations in their first phase. She took the Young Investigator Award of the Association of Surgeons of India in 2001, the CAST Young Investigator Award in 2003 and the International Liver Transplantation Society Young Investigator Award in 2016. Later recognition came from The Transplantation Society, which named her a Woman Leader in Transplantation in 2022, from Rotary International with a Vocational Excellence Award the same year, and from the La Renon Tanker Foundation with its "For the Sake of Honor" award in 2023.

Her academic record comprises eight textbook chapters in national and international medical publications and over 70 peer-reviewed publications, and she is a regular invited speaker at conferences and CME lectures.

dr-b-jagan-mohan-reddy.bio:
Dr. B. Jagan Mohan Reddy is Senior Consultant Surgical Gastroenterologist and Robotic Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with hepatobiliary work.

His list is short and concentrated on the upper abdomen. He performs the Whipple procedure, liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

His training was taken across three medical colleges. He read MBBS at Kurnool Medical College under NTRUHS, took his MS in general surgery between 2008 and 2011, and completed the MCh in surgical gastroenterology at Narayana Medical College in Nellore, also under NTRUHS, between 2012 and 2015.

He collected prizes at every stage. During MBBS he was awarded gold medals in anatomy, biochemistry and forensic medicine. He was named best outgoing student during his MS postgraduation at Osmania Medical College, and took first prize in the quiz conducted by ASI at Vijayawada during his general surgery postgraduation in 2019. He also received a bursary grant for the IASG conference.

His published work has appeared in the International Journal of Surgery, and he has presented at international forums including IDDF in Hong Kong in 2014 and IHPBA in Geneva in 2018. He is a member of the Association of Surgeons of India and of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endosurgeons, the second of which matches the endoscopic and robotic side of his title.

Before Yashoda Hospitals he worked at Apollo Hospitals and Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad, and at Eli Super Speciality Hospital.

dr-mukesh-kumar-1.bio:
Dr. Mukesh Kumar is a Consultant in the Centre for Liver and Biliary Sciences at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with hepatobiliary work.

The liver dominates his list. He performs liver transplant, pediatric liver transplant, liver resection or hepatectomy, liver tumor surgery and liver cancer surgery, and beyond the liver the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy, gallbladder cancer surgery, pancreatic cancer surgery and colorectal cancer surgery. Pediatric GI surgery is listed separately.

His training is dated year by year. He read MBBS at BJ Medical College in Ahmedabad in 2013 and took his MS in general surgery at Civil Hospital in the same city in 2016, followed by the DrNB super speciality in surgical gastroenterology at Jagjivan Ram Hospital in Mumbai in 2020. He then completed a fellowship in HPB and liver transplant surgery at Max Hospital, Saket, in 2021, and a further fellowship in laparoscopic and robotic donor, HPB and liver transplant surgery at Seoul National University Hospital in South Korea in 2022, which is the minimally invasive strand of his training.

His recent academic record is built on that Seoul connection. He had a paper presentation at LT Updates in Seoul in 2024 and a paper accepted at ATW in Seoul the same year, and presented at CAST in Hong Kong in 2023. He has more than 15 publications in national and international journals.

His affiliations are Max Healthcare and Max Super Speciality Hospital in New Delhi, alongside Seoul National University Hospital, Jagjivan Ram Hospital and Civil Hospital in Ahmedabad.

dr-s-r-shyam-sundar.bio:
Dr. S. R. Shyam Sundar is a Consultant in Surgical Gastroenterology and Robotic GI Surgery at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with general surgery, and his listed procedures are gastrectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

His training is unusually weighted towards fellowships in minimal access technique. He read MBBS at Madras Medical College in Chennai between 2006 and 2012 and took his M.S. in general surgery at Madurai Medical College under the Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University between 2014 and 2017. The F.M.AAS in minimal access and abdominal surgery followed at Madras Medical College between 2017 and 2019, alongside a fellowship in advanced laparoscopy at World Laparoscopy Hospital in New Delhi in 2017 and a second advanced laparoscopy fellowship at SUT Puttom Hospital in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, in 2020 and 2021. His robotic training was taken at Samsung Medical Center in Seoul, South Korea, in 2023.

His presentations have been prize-winning. He took first prize at AIIMS EndoSurge in New Delhi in 2019 for work on laparoscopic cholecystectomy in empyema gall bladder, and first prize at Surgicon in Delhi the same year for laparoscopic management of huge ovarian cyst. He also presented a preaortic fascia first approach for laparoscopic posterior fundoplication at F.O.R.S. in Incheon, South Korea, and TIIPOM PLUS, a novel technique in laparoscopic ventral hernia repair, at the World Congress of Abdominal Wall Hernia Surgery in Singapore.

His further work covers Seprafilm as an adhesion barrier in abdominopelvic surgeries and meandering pancreatic duct as a cause of acute idiopathic pancreatitis.

dr-amanjeet-singh.bio:
Dr. Amanjeet Singh is Senior Director and Head of the Division of GI Surgery, GI Oncology and Bariatric Surgery at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, HPB and transplant work alongside general surgery.

His list falls into two halves. On the colorectal side he performs colorectal cancer surgery, colorectal resection, total mesorectal excision, abdominoperineal resection and low anterior resection. On the bariatric side he performs gastric sleeve surgery, minimally invasive bariatric surgery and robotic bariatric surgery, which together account for the third arm of his departmental title.

His qualifications run from MBBS through an M.S. in general surgery and a D.N.B. in surgical gastroenterology to MNAMS. His later training is a sequence of overseas courses in exactly the techniques he uses: a fellowship in laparoscopic colorectal surgery at SMC Korea, robotic training at IRCAD in Strasbourg in 2011, laparoscopic gastric surgery training at IRCAD in Taiwan in 2012, and robotic colorectal training at AETF in Japan in 2013.

His awards begin with the Ravi K Jerath Award as best DNB student of the year at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital and continue with recognition as Best Colorectal Surgeon in India in 2017 and a Primetime Global Excellence Healthcare Award. His profile also credits him with the Medanta Handport Technique, presented at the annual conference of the American Society of Colorectal Surgeons in Florida.

He practises at Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram.

dr-ramkiran-reddy-cherukuru.bio:
Dr. Ramkiran Reddy Cherukuru is a Consultant at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with general surgery, and his operating list covers liver transplant, liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy, the Whipple procedure and gastrectomy.

His qualifications are dated at two-year intervals. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad in 2007 and took his MS in general surgery at the same college in 2011, followed by the MRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in 2013. His DNB in GI surgery was taken at Global Hospitals, Lakdikapul, in Hyderabad in 2015, and a post-doctoral fellowship in liver transplantation at Gleneagles Global Health City in Chennai in 2017.

His research follows the transplant thread through his training. He has published in Liver Transplantation on the feasibility and safety of split liver transplantation in the Indian context, and in Annals of Hepato-Biliary-Pancreatic Surgery on vein resection in patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma involving the porto mesenteric venous axis, the latter matching the pancreatic half of his procedure list.

His conference record runs alongside it. He presented on splenorenal shunt surgeries at the APASICON state conference in 2011, and took posters to two International Liver Transplant Society meetings: acute liver failure management in London in 2014 and split liver transplantation in Prague in 2017.

Both of his theses are recorded. His MS thesis of 2011 examined subfascial ligation of perforator veins, and his DNB thesis of 2015 examined donor outcomes after living donor liver transplantation.

dr-rohan-chaudhary.bio:
Dr. Rohan Chaudhary is Associate Director at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

His list is liver transplantation and the operations around it. He performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, liver tumor surgery and the Kasai procedure, the last of these a paediatric biliary operation that sits with the transplant side of his practice.

His qualifications are MBBS and an MS in general surgery, followed by a fellowship in liver transplantation. He is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons.

His record is unusually specific about the transplants themselves. It credits him with the first successful triple SWAP liver transplant in India in 2022, with more than 100 pediatric liver transplants including a smallest recipient of 4 kg, and with more than 50 complex procedures. Those complex cases are listed by type: SWAP LDLT, ABO-incompatible LDLT, simultaneous liver-kidney transplant, domino LT, split DDLT and reduced DDLT. Taken together they describe a practice built on the variants used when a straightforward matched donor is not available.

His hospital attachments run across several cities. Alongside Gleneagles Hospital at Parel in Mumbai he has been associated with Nanavati Max Superspeciality Hospital and HN Reliance Hospital in the same city, with Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Nasik, and with the Medanta Liver Institute in Gurgaon and Medanta Lucknow.

dr-thiagarajan-srinivasan.bio:
Dr. Thiagarajan Srinivasan is Senior Consultant and Director of the Institute of Liver Diseases, Transplant and HPB Surgery at MGM Healthcare, Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

Transplantation heads his list. He performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, and alongside them liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy, the Whipple procedure and gastrectomy.

His training moved north and then back. He read MBBS at Thanjavur Medical College in Tamil Nadu in 2001 and took his MS in general surgery at PGIMER in Chandigarh in 2006. His DNB in surgical gastroenterology and liver transplantation was taken at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi, also in 2006, and he completed a senior liver transplant fellowship at Medanta – The Medicity in 2013.

Four prizes trace the subjects he has worked on. He took a best paper award from the Indian Association of Surgical Gastroenterology in Chennai in 2008 for work on C reactive protein and thrombocytosis in esophageal carcinoma. In 2010 at Hyderabad he received a best special mention for a poster on Clavien's grading in gastrointestinal surgery and a best poster award for hepatobiliary tuberculosis as a diagnostic dilemma. The following year he won the Young Investigator Award in the plenary session of the International Liver Transplant Society World Congress in Valencia, Spain, for work on infective complications in living donor liver transplantation.

His affiliations are MGM Healthcare and its Institute of Liver Diseases, Transplant and HPB Surgery, with earlier attachments at Medanta – The Medicity and Sir Ganga Ram Hospital.

dr-sreedhara-v.bio:
Dr. Sreedhara V is Director of the Department of Minimal Access and Robotic Surgery at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 19 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, HPB and transplant work.

His list is broad and almost entirely minimally invasive. On the bariatric side he performs robotic bariatric surgery, minimally invasive bariatric surgery and gastric sleeve surgery. Hernia work covers laparoscopic hernia repair for incisional and inguinal hernia, and he also performs laparoscopic cholecystectomy. The larger resections include liver resection or hepatectomy, colorectal resection, low anterior resection and the Whipple procedure, and robotic hysterectomy is listed alongside them.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery, the FRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons, an MCh superspecialty degree in surgical gastroenterology and the FMAS fellowship in minimal access surgery.

His record is written almost entirely in counts and elapsed time, which suits a robotic practice measured by throughput. It notes 100 robotic surgeries completed in his first 90 days, the second fastest in the Asia-Pacific region, and his fastest 500 robotic surgeries completed in 746 days. He also contributed to the fastest first 500 robotic surgeries in 615 days at Koramangala Hospital. Two further entries are records: the highest number of robotic surgeries performed in a single day at Apollo Hospital, at 12, and the highest number of different robotic procedures performed by a surgeon in India, at 54. His career highlights have been recognised at National Records.

dr-g-r-mallikarjuna.bio:
Dr. G. R. Mallikarjuna is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 16 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, general surgery, surgical oncology and hepatobiliary work.

His list is concentrated on the liver and pancreas. He performs pancreatectomy and the Whipple procedure, liver tumor surgery and liver resection or hepatectomy, and also gastrectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication.

His degrees are dated across a decade. He read MBBS at Kurnool Medical College in 2004 and took his MS in general surgery at the same college in 2010, then the MCh in surgical gastroenterology at Narayana Medical College in Nellore in 2014. He is a Fellow of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo-Surgeons, which is the endoscopic strand of his training.

His attachments are the most detailed part of his record and they run from teaching hospitals to large private centres. Besides Yashoda Hospitals at Hitec City he has been associated with Apollo Health City at Jubilee Hills in Hyderabad, Medanta Medicity in Gurgaon, Narayana Medical College in Nellore, SVIMS in Tirupati, Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad and SRMC in Chennai. One attachment is outside India, at Macquarie University Hospital in Sydney, Australia.

The combination of surgical oncology and hepatobiliary work on his profile matches an operating list in which tumour resections of the liver, stomach and pancreas sit alongside the functional oesophageal work.

dr-balbir-singh-1.bio:
Dr. Balbir Singh is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 28 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology as his specialty.

Transplantation leads his list. He performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, and alongside them liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy, the Whipple procedure and anti-reflux surgery.

His two university degrees were taken at Agra University, MBBS in 1985 and an MS in general surgery in 1990. Three fellowships follow: he is a Fellow of the Association of Surgeons of India, of the International College of Surgeons and of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endosurgeons. His transplant training was taken abroad, on a fellowship in liver transplantation at the Asan Medical Centre in Seoul, South Korea, between April and May 2009.

His hospital history spans three countries and matches the range of that training. In India he has been associated with Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad and Global Hospitals at Lakdikapul in Hyderabad. In the United Kingdom he worked at University College London Hospitals and at North Middlesex University Hospital, both in London, and in South Korea at the Asan Medical Centre where he took his 2009 fellowship.

That record of a long general and gastrointestinal surgical career, an endosurgery fellowship and a dedicated transplant attachment is what stands behind an operating list that runs from anti-reflux surgery through major pancreatic resection to adult and paediatric liver transplantation.

dr-prashant-vilas-bhangui.bio:
Dr. Prashant Vilas Bhangui is Director of Liver Transplant at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, HPB and transplant work.

His list is the widest part of his record. On the transplant side he performs deceased donor liver transplant and liver retransplantation. On the resection side he performs liver resection or hepatectomy for operable liver tumors, complex HPB tumor surgery, biliary tract tumor resection and biliary reconstruction, liver cancer surgery, gallbladder cancer surgery, pancreatic cancer surgery with the Whipple procedure, and surgery for operable colorectal cancer.

His postgraduate training after MBBS and an MS in surgery in India was taken in France. He holds a Master in HPB Surgery from the Henri Bismuth Hepatobiliary Institute and completed a fellowship in hepatobiliary surgery and liver transplantation at Hôpital Paul Brousse in Paris. He also holds the European Inter-University Diploma in HPB Oncology, on hepato-biliary-pancreatic cancers and oncosurgical strategies.

His academic record is substantial. He holds a Merck KGaA Germany international educational grant for clinical research and serves as an Associate Editor of the peer-reviewed journal Transplantation. His profile records recognition as a key opinion leader for LDLT and HCC management worldwide, and invited faculty work in the development of international consensus and practice guidelines. He has over 100 publications in key peer-reviewed international journals.

He practises at Medanta — The Medicity in Gurugram.

dr-amruth-raj.bio:
Dr. Amruth Raj is Consultant in GI, HPB, Liver Transplant and Robotic Surgery at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 7 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, HPB and transplant surgery together with general surgery.

His list covers transplantation, resection and reconstruction. He performs deceased donor liver transplant, liver resection or hepatectomy for operable liver tumors, the Whipple procedure and distal pancreatectomy, biliary reconstruction and hepaticojejunostomy, complex HPB tumor surgery, colorectal resection and gastrectomy. Pancreatic cancer and gallbladder cancer are listed as the conditions behind much of that work.

His training ran from Bangalore to Delhi and then abroad. He read MBBS and took his MS in general surgery at Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute, and also holds a DNB in general surgery. His MCh in surgical gastroenterology was taken at GB Pant Hospital in New Delhi. He then completed a fellowship in HPB surgery and liver transplantation at the Asan Medical Center in Seoul, South Korea, and a fellowship in robotic surgery with Intuitive Surgical on the Da Vinci system, which is the robotic element of his current title. He is a Fellow of the International College of Surgeons.

His academic record is short but international. He was selected for oral presentation at the IHPBA World Congress in Paris in 2022 and received a best paper award at the IASGO conference. He has published peer-reviewed research in national and international journals on liver transplantation, HPB surgery and outcomes of complex GI procedures.

dr-vivek-vij.bio:
Dr. Vivek Vij is Chairman of Liver Transplant and Hepato-Biliary Science at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology as his specialty and liver transplantation as his procedure.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS, the MRCS (Ed.) and a DNB.

His awards are all recent and all for the same thing, which reflects how narrowly his practice is defined. In 2024 he was named Best Liver Transplant Surgeon at Sanjeevani, an award given by SEPC under the Ministry of Commerce, Government of India, together with FHWP. In the same year he received the Best Liver Transplant Surgeon award at the HTI Global Healthcare and Wellness Summit in Dubai, UAE. The year before, in 2023, he received the Best Liver Transplant Surgeon Award at Advantage Healthcare India, given by FICCI and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.

His practice is spread across three hospitals in the Delhi NCR group. His primary post as Chairman of Liver Transplant and Hepato-Biliary Science is at Fortis Hospital, Okhla, and he also works at Fortis Hospital, Noida and at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurgaon.

Between the departmental chairmanship, the single listed procedure and three consecutive national and international awards for it, his record describes a career given over entirely to liver transplantation rather than to general gastrointestinal surgery.

dr-adarsh-chaudhary.bio:
Dr. Adarsh Chaudhary is Chairman of the Department of GI Surgery, GI Oncology and Bariatric Surgery at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, HPB and transplant work alongside bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list follows the three arms of that department. The pancreatic and biliary work covers the Whipple procedure, surgical management of pancreatic cancer, complex HPB tumor surgery, liver resection or hepatectomy, biliary reconstruction, biliary tract tumor resection and surgical management of gallbladder cancer. The gastrointestinal cancer work covers gastric cancer and operable colorectal cancer. The bariatric side covers minimally invasive bariatric surgery, gastric sleeve surgery and Roux-en-Y gastric bypass.

His qualifications are MBBS, an M.S. in general surgery and the FRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh.

Two entries in his record stand out because they are about the field rather than a single case. His profile credits him with starting one of the first departments of surgical gastroenterology in India, and with performing the highest number of Whipple's surgeries in the country, which is also the first operation on his procedure list. Alongside the Edinburgh fellowship he holds a fellowship and recognition from the World Health Organization, USA, and his record notes multiple prestigious awards and induction into respected medical associations.

He practises at Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram and at Medanta Mediclinic in Defence Colony, New Delhi.

dr-g-parthasarathy.bio:
Dr. G. Parthasarathy is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 28 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work, general surgery and bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list runs from the stomach to transplantation. He performs gastrectomy and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication, liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy and the Whipple procedure, and on the transplant side pancreas transplant and simultaneous pancreas–kidney transplant.

His training is recorded by institution rather than by year for the most part. He took postgraduate medical training at JIPMER and his super specialty degree in surgical gastroenterology at SGPGIMS in Lucknow. Training in advanced hepatobiliary surgery and liver transplantation followed at CLBS in New Delhi, and he was an international visiting fellow at the Asan Medical Center in Seoul, South Korea. In 2016 he took the FIAGES fellowship of the Indian Association of Gastroendoscopic Surgeons.

His conference record is a run of placings at the national meetings of the Indian Association of Surgical Gastroenterology. He won the best paper award at the XV national conference at Chandigarh in 2005 and second prize for best poster at the XVI national conference at Lucknow in 2006, and received a travel bursary award at the XXII national conference at Bengaluru. Outside the society, the Times Group named him a Rising Star in gastroenterology in AP and Telangana for 2019–20.

dr-rajesh-rajalingam.bio:
Dr. Rajesh Rajalingam is Clinical Lead for HPB Surgery at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

His list is transplantation and upper abdominal resection: liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy and the Whipple procedure.

His degrees are dated at four-year intervals. He read MBBS at Tirunelveli Medical College in 2003, took his MS in general surgery at JIPMER in Pondicherry in 2007 and his MCh in gastrointestinal surgery at G B Pant Hospital in New Delhi in 2011, then completed a post-doctoral fellowship in liver transplantation at Global Hospital in Chennai in 2013. He won a gold medal in anatomy as an undergraduate.

Portal hypertension runs through his presented work. At IHPBA 2010 in Delhi he took a best poster award for management of hypersplenism in non-cirrhotic portal hypertension and presented a paper on extra-hepatic portal venous obstruction, with further posters at IHPBA in Argentina the same year. His conference attendance is listed in full: PON CON 2006 and 2007, Surgery Update 2007, HPB CON 2008, IHPBA 2010, IAP 2011, IASG 2012, ILTS 2013 and 2017, and laparoscopy basic training programmes.

His publications appear in peer-reviewed journals including American Surgeon, Digestive Surgery, Saudi Journal of Gastroenterology, Tropical Gastroenterology, Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Diseases International, Journal of Gastrointestinal Cancer, Hepatology International, Liver Transplantation and Transplantation.

dr-shyam-sunder-mahansaria.bio:
Dr. Shyam Sunder Mahansaria is Head of Liver Transplant and Senior Consultant in GI and HPB Surgery at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, HPB and transplant work together with surgical oncology.

His list is largely cancer resection. He performs liver resection or hepatectomy and liver cancer surgery, distal pancreatectomy for pancreatic cancer, surgery for gallbladder cancer and bile duct cancer, gastric cancer surgery and colorectal resection.

His three degrees were taken in Rajasthan and Delhi. He read MBBS at the University of Rajasthan and took his MS in general surgery at Rajasthan University of Health Sciences, then the MCh in hepato-pancreato-biliary and liver transplant surgery at the Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences in New Delhi. The Chief Minister of Rajasthan has felicitated him for his contribution to liver transplant and hepatopancreatobiliary surgery in the state.

His conference record centres on IASCON 2014, where he took first prize for work on the unmasking of a myeloproliferative disorder in a patient with EHPVO following PSRS, and the Burzarjee award.

His publications follow both halves of his practice. On the transplant side he has published on "No go" donor hepatectomy in living donor liver transplantation in Hepatol Int in 2018, on the association of thrombocytopenia with outcome following adult living donor liver transplantation, and on liver transplantation after bone marrow transplantation for end-stage liver disease with severe hepatopulmonary syndrome. On the resection side he has published on major liver resection for large and locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma in Indian J Surg in 2017, on ampullary mixed adenoneuroendocrine carcinoma, and on adenomyomatosis of the gallbladder.

dr-aditya-kunte.bio:
Dr. Aditya Kunte is a Consultant Surgical Oncologist and HPB Surgeon at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records surgical oncology alongside the HPB surgery and liver transplantation side of surgical gastroenterology, and hepatobiliary work.

His operating list sits where those two specialties meet. He performs liver tumor surgery and liver transplant, and on the pancreatic side pancreatectomy and the Whipple procedure.

His training follows the same double track. After MBBS and an MS in general surgery he took the MCh in surgical oncology, then added two fellowships, one in HPB oncology and one in liver transplantation. The cancer qualification and the transplant qualification together account for a practice in which liver resection for tumour and liver replacement are both on the list.

His record notes that he trained at Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai, and he currently practises at Gleneagles BGS Hospital at Parel in the same city.

His academic work is recorded in three strands. He has multiple scientific publications in reputed, peer-reviewed international medical journals, has received multiple awards at national and international conferences for key research papers and presentations, and has authored several book chapters in HPB and cancer surgery. Those chapters cover the same ground as his clinical list, which is the surgical management of tumours of the liver and pancreas.

dr-moode-jayanth.bio:
Dr. Moode Jayanth is a Consultant Surgical Gastroenterologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 8 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, hepatobiliary work, surgical oncology and general surgery, and his operating list covers the Whipple procedure, liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy and gastrectomy.

His training is dated and moves steadily towards minimally invasive technique. He read MBBS at Kurnool Medical College in Andhra Pradesh in 2013 and took his MS in general surgery at the same college in 2017. He became a Fellow of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo Surgeons in 2020 and took the FALS fellowship degree in advanced laparoscopic surgery and robotic surgery in June 2022. His DrNB in gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary-pancreatic surgery was taken at Global Hospitals in Hyderabad, and he holds a Vattikuti Fellowship in robotic surgical oncology from the Mazumdar Shaw Cancer Centre at Narayana Health City in Bengaluru.

His presented work is mostly operative video and matches that robotic and laparoscopic training. He submitted two videos to the KS International Robotic Surgery Video Awards in 2022, on robotic pancreaticojejunostomy after Whipple's procedure and on robotic excision of retroperitoneal paraganglioma, the first of which is the reconstruction stage of the operation heading his procedure list. He presented a video on laparoscopic redo fundoplication at HSI-ECON 2020, and a poster at IAGES-2020 in Guwahati on invasive candida infection after bariatric surgery for morbid obesity presenting as a late anastamotic leak.

dr-amit-javed.bio:
Dr. Amit Javed is Principal Director and Head of Laparoscopic GI, GI Onco, Bariatric and MIS Surgery at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 27 years of experience. His profile records general surgery, gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work and bariatric and metabolic surgery.

His list covers the three arms of his department. The cancer work runs to gastric cancer surgery, colorectal cancer surgery, esophageal cancer surgery and pancreatic cancer surgery, with liver resection or hepatectomy for tumours and liver disease, the Whipple procedure for periampullary and pancreatic tumors, complex GI resections and CRS with HIPEC, which is cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy. The bariatric work covers gastric sleeve surgery, minimally invasive bariatric surgery and robotic bariatric surgery. Laparoscopic cholecystectomy is listed alongside them.

His training ran through three of the country's teaching institutions. He read MBBS at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal, took his MS in general surgery at PGIMER in Chandigarh and his MCh in gastrointestinal surgery at AIIMS in New Delhi. He is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons, awarded at San Francisco, California, and is ECFMG certified.

His practice is spread across four hospitals in the capital region. Besides Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurgaon he works at Fortis Hospital in Shalimar Bagh, Fortis Hospital in Vasant Kunj and CK Birla Hospital, all in New Delhi.

dr-t-s-bala-shanmugam.bio:
Dr. T S Bala Shanmugam is Senior Consultant and Head of the Department of Minimally Invasive Bariatric and GI Surgery at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with bariatric and metabolic surgery and general surgery.

His listed procedures are anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication, gastrectomy, pancreatectomy and ostomy surgery.

His training moved from Chennai to Mangalore and then abroad. He read MBBS at Sri Ramachandra Medical College and Research Institute in Chennai and took his MS in general surgery at Kasturba Medical College in Mangalore. The Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India awarded him the FMAS as a Fellow of Minimal Access Surgery. His advanced laparoscopic surgery training was taken at IRCAD in Strasburg, France, and his robotic surgery training at World Laparoscopic Hospital in New Delhi, which together account for the minimally invasive half of his departmental title.

Much of his record is editorial and examining rather than clinical. He sits on the editorial board of World Journal of Laparoscopic Surgery and of Gastroenterology International. He examines for the MS in general surgery and for MBBS and BDS at various universities, and is a post-doctoral fellowship examiner in minimal access surgery for Dr. MGR University, the same subject as his own AMASI fellowship.

He practises at Gleneagles Global Health City in Chennai.

dr-rajanikanth-patcha.bio:
Dr. Rajanikanth Patcha is Clinical Lead and Senior Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

Transplantation heads his list. He performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, and alongside them liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy, the Whipple procedure and gastrectomy.

His qualifications are the longest part of his record and most of them were taken abroad. After MBBS he took his MS in general surgery at JIPMER in Pondicherry, then the MRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons at Edinburgh and Ireland, and the FRCS. He holds a Diploma in Laparoscopy from the University of Louis Pasteur in France, taken in 2007. In 2014 he added two European Board of Surgery fellowships, one in liver transplantation and one in hepato-pancreato-biliary surgery.

Those two 2014 fellowships are also the single distinction recorded against his name: his profile notes that he was the first South Indian to achieve Fellow of the European Board of Surgery in both liver transplantation and hepato-biliary surgery. The pairing matches his operating list, where transplant work and major liver and pancreatic resection sit side by side rather than one being an adjunct to the other.

He practises at Gleneagles Global Health City in Chennai.

dr-p-anbalagan.bio:
Dr. P Anbalagan is a Senior Consultant at MGM Healthcare, Chennai, with more than 21 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology, general surgery and surgical oncology for GI cancers.

His list is concentrated on the upper abdomen. He performs the Whipple procedure and pancreatectomy, gastrectomy, liver tumor surgery and anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication, a range that covers both the cancer and the functional sides of his specialty.

All three of his degrees were taken at government teaching institutions in the south. He read MBBS at Government Stanley Medical College in Chennai and took his MS in general surgery at JIPMER in Pondicherry, then returned to Stanley for the MCh in surgical gastroenterology at its Institute of Surgical Gastroenterology and Liver Transplantation.

He finished that superspecialty course at the top. He was named best outgoing student in surgical gastroenterology and received the Dr. Rangabashyam Gold Medal for surgical gastroenterology from the Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR Medical University in 2012.

His published work runs to 12 original articles and 8 case reports in peer-reviewed journals, and he has presented at multiple national and regional conferences. The split between original articles and case reports suggests a record built on series drawn from his own practice as well as on individual cases.

Besides MGM Healthcare he practises at SIMS Hospital in Vadapalani, Chennai. Both of those are in the city where he trained, and his surgical gastroenterology institute at Stanley also carries liver transplantation in its name.

dr-giriraj-bora.bio:
Dr. Giriraj Bora is Chairperson of Liver Transplant and Senior Consultant in GI and HPB Surgery at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

His list is built around the liver. He performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, liver resection or hepatectomy, liver tumor surgery and liver cancer surgery. Beyond the liver he performs the Whipple procedure, pancreatectomy, cholecystectomy, and surgery for gallbladder cancer, bile duct cancer and pancreatic cancer.

His training began in Rajasthan and finished in Delhi. He read MBBS and took his MS in general surgery at JLN Medical College in Ajmer, then completed a senior residency in GI surgery at SGPGIMS in Lucknow. His MCh in HPB and gastrointestinal surgery was a three-year course at G.B. Pant Hospital, Maulana Azad Medical College, in New Delhi.

He returned to his training state for the case that heads his awards: the Chief Minister of Rajasthan felicitated him for performing the state's first liver transplant.

His other recognition comes from the International Liver Transplant Society, which gave him a travel award at San Francisco in 2012 and its Young Investigator Award at Sydney in 2013. He is a founding member of the Liver Transplant Society of India.

He practises at Artemis Hospital in Gurugram.

dr-jasper-sandeep-rajasekar.bio:
Dr. Jasper Sandeep Rajasekar is an Associate Consultant at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

His list is among the broadest in transplantation on this profile set. He performs liver transplant and pediatric liver transplant, pancreas transplant and simultaneous pancreas-kidney transplant. The paediatric side extends to the Kasai procedure and pediatric GI surgery, and his resection work covers liver tumor surgery, pancreatectomy, the Whipple procedure and gastrectomy.

After MBBS and an MS he took the MCh in surgical gastroenterology at Madras Medical College in 2015, then a post-doctoral fellowship in liver transplantation at Rela Hospital in 2018, which is the hospital where he now practises. He is a Member of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh.

His society memberships follow the transplant thread through his training. He belongs to the International Liver Transplant Society and to the Liver Transplantation Society of India, and is an active member of five prominent professional and scientific societies in all.

The combination of a surgical gastroenterology superspecialty degree, a dedicated transplant fellowship and a list that includes the Kasai procedure alongside adult and paediatric liver transplantation describes a practice centred on transplantation at both ends of the age range.

dr-aashish-r-shah.bio:
Dr. Aashish R Shah is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records three specialties: surgical gastroenterology, bariatric and metabolic surgery, and general surgery.

His operating list is concentrated on the upper gastrointestinal tract and the organs behind it. He performs anti-reflux surgery by Nissen fundoplication and gastrectomy, and on the pancreatic and hepatic side pancreatectomy, the Whipple procedure and liver tumor surgery. Between them those five operations span the functional oesophageal work, the gastric work and the major resections that a surgical gastroenterology service handles.

His qualifications are recorded in seven parts and divide into degrees and fellowships. The degrees are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and a DNB in surgical gastroenterology, together with MNAMS. The fellowships are FIAGES, as a Fellow of the Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo-Surgeons, FALS in advanced laparoscopic surgery, and FACS as a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons.

Two of those three fellowships are in endoscopic and laparoscopic technique rather than in a disease area, which places minimal access surgery at the centre of his training rather than at its margin, and the third is an international credential.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals on Bannerghatta Road in Bengaluru.

dr-asif-mehraj.bio:
Dr. Asif Mehraj is a Consultant at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records general surgery together with the colorectal surgery side of surgical gastro, HPB and transplant work, and colorectal surgical oncology.

His list is almost entirely colorectal. He treats operable colorectal cancer and performs colorectal resection, colorectal cancer surgery, low anterior resection, total mesorectal excision, hemicolectomy and abdominoperineal resection, with stoma creation and reversal alongside them and management of complex anal conditions. His laparoscopic general work covers cholecystectomy, hernia repair and appendectomy.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS and an MD, and he holds the FIAGES.

Much of his record is editorial and organisational rather than clinical, and all of it sits within his own subspecialty. He has been Joint Editor of the Indian Journal of Colorectal Surgery since September 2019. He was Joint Organizing Secretary of the 19th International Conference at AIIMS, Srinagar, in 2019, and Organizing Secretary of the Uttar Pradesh International Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology in Surgery and Medical Research in October 2022. Since November 2022 he has been State Level Coordinator for the public sector in Andhra Pradesh for the Association of Colon and Rectal Surgeons of India.

He practises at Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills.

dr-ravindra-nidoni.bio:
Dr. Ravindra Nidoni is a Consultant Liver Transplant and HPB Surgeon at Gleneagles Hospitals, Bengaluru, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastroenterology together with gastroenterology and hepatobiliary work.

His list follows the two halves of his title. The transplant half is liver transplant. The HPB half covers liver tumor surgery, the Whipple procedure and pancreatectomy, with gastrectomy alongside them.

His qualifications run in the same order as that practice. After MBBS he took an MS in general surgery, then the DNB in surgical gastroenterology as his superspecialty, and finally a fellowship in liver transplant and HPB surgery, which is the training that corresponds directly to his present post. He is also a Fellow of the American College of Surgery.

That fellowship is the single distinction recorded against his name, and his profile explains why it is listed: the FACS is an international distinction awarded to surgeons who meet rigorous standards of education, training, professional qualifications, surgical competence and ethical conduct. His record notes that further awards information is not available from the sources it draws on, so the entry is left there rather than extended.
