He practises at Gleneagles BGS Hospital at Kengeri in Bengaluru.

dr-sourabh-jindal.bio:
Dr. Sourabh Jindal is a Consultant at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in Delhi NCR, with more than 5 years of experience. His profile records surgical gastro, HPB and transplant work alongside bariatric and metabolic surgery and general surgery.

His list divides along those lines. The HPB work covers the Whipple procedure, liver resection or hepatectomy, biliary reconstruction, complex HPB tumor surgery and periampullary tumor resection. The colorectal work covers low anterior resection, colorectal resection, colorectal cancer surgery and stoma creation and reversal. The bariatric work covers minimally invasive bariatric surgery and gastric sleeve surgery, and laparoscopic cholecystectomy is listed alongside them.

His three degrees were taken in three different states. He read M.B.B.S. at Datta Meghe Institute of Medical Sciences in Nagpur, took his M.S. in general surgery at Government Medical College and Hospital in Chandigarh, and completed the M.Ch. in surgical gastroenterology at Madras Medical College in Chennai.

His record notes that he has secured top positions in national medical quizzes, and he received the Best Free Paper Award at ASICON 2021, the annual conference of the Association of Surgeons of India. He is a life member of that association and of the Tamil Nadu Surgical Gastroenterology Alumni Association, the second of which follows from his M.Ch. at Madras Medical College.

He practises at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in New Delhi.

dr-deepu-banerji.bio:
Dr. Deepu Banerji is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Thane, in Mumbai, with more than 40 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery, and his qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an MCh in neurosurgery.

His operating list is largely cranial. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, craniotomy, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, endoscopic brain surgery, pituitary tumor surgery and aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms. The paediatric side of the list covers pediatric brain tumor surgery and hydrocephalus surgery in children as well as adults.

His society membership is the longest part of his record and much of it is international. In India he belongs to the Neurology Society of India, the Bombay Neuroscience Association, the Association of Spinal Surgeons of India, the Skull Base Surgery Society of India and the Indian Society of Neuro-oncology. Abroad he is an International Fellow of the American Association of Neurological Surgery, an international member of the Congress of Neurological Surgeons and of the editorial board of Surgical Neurology International, an honorary member of the Society of Neurosurgeons of South Africa, a member of the International Society for Pituitary Surgeons and of the Asian Congress of Neurological Surgeons.

He gave the NSI Presidential Oration at the Silver Jubilee Annual Conference of IAN in Chennai in 2017 and the 1st Prof RS Dharkar Oration at Gwalior in November 2019, and SGPGIMS Lucknow has named an operation theatre after him. He has 70 publications, 20 book chapters, more than 150 guest lectures and edited volumes 10 to 12 of Progress in Clinical Neurosciences.

dr-girish-krishna-joshi.bio:
Dr. Girish Krishna Joshi is a Consultant Neurosurgeon and Spine Surgeon at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial. He performs brain tumor surgery and glioma surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, endoscopic brain surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy and epilepsy surgery.

His training is an unusually long sequence of short fellowships taken across the country. After MBBS and an MS in general surgery he graduated from J.N. Medical College, Belgaum, in 2005 and took his MCh in neurosurgery at Rajagiri Medical College, together with a DNB in neurosurgery and the FRCS at Edinburgh. In 2017 he completed a fellowship in endoscopic pituitary surgery and a fellowship at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai, in brain tumour surgery and awake craniotomy with intraoperative assistance and fluorescence guidance. In 2018 he took a fellowship in anterior approaches to spine at Bangalore with AIMIS/IMIS and a fellowship in skull base surgery at Lucknow, and in 2019 a fellowship in minimally invasive spine surgery at IGIMS, Lucknow, with epilepsy monitoring participation at NIMHANS and an observership in renal and liver transplantation at Hyderabad. He also holds a fellowship in intraoperative neuroelectrophysiological monitoring taken at Kolkata.

His record notes further training in endoscopic spine and brain surgery at AIIMS, New Delhi, and in minimally invasive spine surgery at AIIMS, Lucknow, and a Best Outgoing Student Award. He is a member of the Royal College of Surgeons at Edinburgh, the Neurological Society of India, AOI and the Indian Medical Association.

dr-v-k-jain.bio:
Dr. V.K. Jain is Principal Director of the Department of Neurosurgery at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 35 years of experience.

His list covers tumour, vascular and stereotactic work. He performs brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms, arteriovenous malformation surgery, Chiari malformation surgery and stereotactic brain surgery.

His training is dated across three decades and four countries. He read MBBS at King George Medical College, Lucknow, in 1974 and took his MCh in neurosurgery at NIMHANS, Bangalore, in 1981. A micro-neurosurgery fellowship followed at Fujita Health University in Japan from November 1985 to October 1986. He took a brain atlas operators course at Mundelein, IL, in June 1992, attended international workshops on stereotactic techniques at the Karolinska Hospital in Stockholm in October 1998 and a dosimetry and dose planning course at the Gamma Knife Centre, Komaki City Hospital, Nagoya, in May 1999. He was a visiting professor at Fujita Gakuen Health University in Toyoake in 1999 and at the University Hospital of Geneva in June 2001.

His published contributions include descriptions of a new entity of benign subarachnoid hemorrhage and of a new technique for surgery of atlanto-axial dislocation, and he authored Craniovertebral Junction Anomalies – The Indian Experience in 1997. He is Vice President of the Asian Australasian Society of Neurological Surgeons and a past president of the Neurological Society of India, the Skull Base Surgery Society of India, the Indian Society of Cerebro-Vascular Surgery, the NeuroTrauma Society of India and the UP NeuroScience Society.

dr-daljit-singh.bio:
Dr. Daljit Singh is Vice Chairman and Head of Neurosurgery and Unit Head of Neuro Intervention at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery, spine surgery and interventional neuroradiology.

His list is correspondingly wide. The tumour work covers brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pediatric brain tumor surgery and endoscopic brain surgery. The vascular work covers aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery, which matches the interventional arm of his title. The functional work covers epilepsy surgery and deep brain stimulation, and he also performs peripheral nerve surgery and surgery for congenital brain and spine anomalies.

All three of his degrees were taken at Delhi University. He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in 1984 and took his MS in surgery at the same college in 1990, then the MCh in neurosurgery at G B Pant Hospital in 1994. In 2025 he received a fellowship of the National Academy of Medical Sciences.

His awards run from 1997 to 2017. They include the Dr. B C Roy National Award in 2016, the Times of India Legend in Neurosurgery Award and the Distinguished Alumnus Award of MAMC in 2017, the Dr. V S Dave Oration at KGMU in 2015, the Delhi State Doctor Award in 2011, a Best Published Paper Award, the Vishist Chikitsa Ratan Award and a Medical Innovation Award finalist place in 2012, the Rashtriya Gaurav Award in 2002, the Millennium Doctor Award in 2000 and DMA Distinguish Services Awards in 1997 and 2009.

dr-suresh-sankhla.bio:
Dr. Suresh Sankhla is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 41 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is cranial and divides between tumour and paediatric work. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery. The paediatric side covers pediatric brain tumor surgery and hydrocephalus surgery in children and adults.

His qualifications are MBBS and a DNB together with the FICS and FIMSA. Between 1995 and 1998 he took two clinical fellowships in the USA, one in skull base surgery and one in neuro-oncological surgery, which are the two areas his tumour list is built around.

He has held three society presidencies in six years: the Skull Base Surgery Society of India in 2013, the Bombay Neurosciences Association in 2014 and the Indian Society of Neurooncology in 2019. He founded the Journal of Pediatric Neurosciences as its editor in 2006, and is senior faculty of the International Society for Pediatric Neurosurgery and of the International Federation of Neuroendoscopy, which correspond to the paediatric and endoscopic parts of his list.

His writing runs to over 114 published papers and articles in indexed journals, more than 24 chapters in medical books, and two neurosurgery textbooks he has edited.

Besides Gleneagles Hospital at Parel he has been associated with the Sir JJ Group of Hospitals and the Bombay Hospital Institute of Medical Sciences, both in Mumbai.

dr-rajasekhar-reddy-k.bio:
Dr. Rajasekhar Reddy K is a Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon and Spine Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour and vascular work in both compartments. He performs brain tumor surgery, meningioma surgery and glioma surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, spinal tumor surgery, and on the vascular side arteriovenous malformation surgery and aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms.

His three degrees were taken at three government medical colleges over seven years. He read MBBS at Andhra Medical College in Visakhapatnam in 2000, took his MS in general surgery at Guntur Medical College in 2003 and his MCh in neurosurgery at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad in 2007.

He came top at almost every stage. He was best outgoing student in MS general surgery in the Andhra region, secured first rank in the MCh neurosurgery entrance examination at Osmania Medical College, and was awarded the V. S Ram Avatar Medal as best outgoing student in MCh neurosurgery in 2007. He also holds the Dr. Madhira Dasaradhi Ram Memorial Prize from NTR University of Health Sciences.

His presented work dates from his training years: a poster on spontaneous regression of vein of Galen malformation in a paediatric patient at NSICON in 2005, a clinico pathological study of cerebral abscess at AP Neurocon in 2005 and a clinico pathological study of diffuse axonal injury with outcome analysis at AP Neurocon in 2006. He is a member of the Neurological Society of India.

dr-aditya-gupta.bio:
Dr. Aditya Gupta is Chairman of Neurosurgery, CyberKnife and Gamma Knife Radiosurgery at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 40 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with the CyberKnife and Gamma Knife side of radiation oncology.

His list runs across open surgery and radiosurgery. The open work covers brain tumor removal and brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, spinal tumor surgery, cervical spine surgery and minimally invasive spine surgery. The functional work covers deep brain stimulation, stereotactic brain surgery and surgery for movement disorders. The radiosurgical work covers CyberKnife, Gamma Knife and stereotactic radiosurgery.

He read MBBS and took his MCh in neurosurgery at AIIMS, New Delhi, and is certified by the American Board of Neurological Surgery. He holds a fellowship of the Medical College at Richmond, Virginia, and his advanced training was taken at the University of Amsterdam, Hospital Pitié-Salpêtrière in Paris, the University of Marseilles, the University of Virginia at Charlottesville, the University of Kyoto and in Germany.

His memberships follow the stereotactic and radiosurgical thread: the American Society for Stereotactic and Functional Neurosurgery, the Indian Society for Stereotactic and Functional Neurosurgery, the International Gamma Knife Society and the Congress of Neurological Surgeons, with life membership of the Neurological Society of India and the Skull Base Surgery Society.

His awards begin as a student, with best student in anatomy at AIIMS in 1992, and continue with the Dr. Dinesh Talya Award in 1998, the STRENGTH Fellowship Award of the Federation of India in 2006, the Chief of Army Staff Award in 2012 and the DN Bagchi Oration.

dr-rajesh-alugolu.bio:
Dr. Rajesh Alugolu is Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon and Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 26 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with the movement disorders and Parkinson's disease side of neurology.

Functional work heads his list. He performs deep brain stimulation, epilepsy surgery, VNS implant and microvascular decompression for trigeminal neuralgia. The tumour work covers brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery.

His three degrees were taken in three states. He read MBBS at Thanjavur Medical College in Tamil Nadu under Dr. M.G.R. Medical University in 2001, took his M.S. in general surgery at V.S.S. Medical College, Burla, under Sambalpur University in Odisha in 2006, and his M.Ch. in neurosurgery at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences at Punjagutta in Hyderabad in 2009.

His record puts numbers to the functional half of his practice: more than 850 DBS procedures performed in India, within a neurosurgical experience of more than 5,000 surgeries. He has authored more than 80 peer-reviewed publications and 5 book chapters, has served as an examiner for M.Ch and DNB examinations and thesis assessments, and is course coordinator for the post-doctoral fellowship programme on surgery for movement disorders at NIMS.

He is a life member of the Neuro-Spinal Surgeons Association of India, the Andhra Pradesh Neuroscientists Association, the Indian Society for Bone and Mineral Research, the Indian Academy of Cerebral Palsy, the Neurological Society of India and the Indian Society of Stereotactic and Functional Neurosurgery, where he is also an executive member. He works at Citi Neuro Centre as well.

dr-naresh-panwar.bio:
Dr. Naresh Panwar is Senior Consultant and Head of Unit II in Neurosurgery at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour, vascular and functional work. The tumour work runs to brain tumor surgery, meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery. The vascular work covers aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery, and the functional work deep brain stimulation and epilepsy surgery.

His training moved through three states. He read MBBS at GSVM Medical College in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, took his MS in general surgery at King George's Medical University in Lucknow and his MCh in neurosurgery at SMS Medical College in Jaipur, Rajasthan. He also holds a fellowship in neuroendoscopy, which matches the endoscopic entry on his list.

His hospital history follows the same route. Besides Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad, he has been associated with the Medanta Institute of Neurosciences and RMLIMS in Lucknow, the Asian Institute of Medical Sciences in Faridabad, Fortis Escorts Hospital in New Delhi and SMS Medical College in Jaipur. He is registered with the Delhi, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan medical councils, which covers the three states he has practised in.

He belongs to the Neurological Society of India, the Neurotrauma Society of India and the European Association of Neurological Societies. He received a best poster award at IAESCON-2012 at KGMU, Lucknow, for a presentation on the approach to Ca rectum.

dr-zahid-khan.bio:
Dr. Zahid Khan is a Director at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery, and his listed procedures are brain tumor surgery, deep brain stimulation, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery.

He took his DNB in neurosurgery at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi in 2009. What follows in his record is a sequence of short courses taken abroad and in India, each tied to a specific technique. He attended a microsurgical workshop at the Johnson and Johnson Institute in New Delhi in 2013, took training in spinal pumps at Keel and in ICP monitoring at Harburg, both in Germany, in 2016, and a minimal invasive spinal surgery workshop at M. S. Ramaiah Medical College in Bengaluru in 2017. His deep brain stimulation training was taken at Shuzou and Shangai in China in 2018, and he returned to M. S. Ramaiah Medical College for a deformity correction cadaver course in 2024.

His presented work dates from the start of his career and is on head injury imaging. He gave a research presentation on radiological evaluation of post-traumatic CSF rhinorrhea, comparing metrizamide CT with MRI, at the Annual Neurotrauma Conference in Rajkot in 2000, and won the Suresh Kare-Indoco Remedies Best Poster Award from the Neurotraumatology Committee of the Neurological Society of India the same year. In 2001 he received a letter of appreciation for a poster at the 50th annual conference of the Neurosurgical Society of India.

He belongs to the Neurological Society of India, the Neurological Surgeons Society of India, the Delhi Neurological Association, AO Spine, the Delhi Spine Society and the Indian Medical Association.

dr-nigel-symss.bio:
Dr. Nigel Symss is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 16 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list has a strong paediatric component. He performs pediatric brain tumor surgery and pediatric hydrocephalus surgery alongside hydrocephalus surgery and Chiari malformation surgery, and on the adult side brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, endoscopic brain surgery, epilepsy surgery, deep brain stimulation and arteriovenous malformation surgery.

His training is long and largely overseas. He completed MBBS at Bangalore Medical College in 1993 and was awarded the DNB in neurosurgery in 2005 after a five-year neurosurgical training programme at the Post Graduate Institute of Neurological Surgery, VHS Medical Centre, Chennai. A fellowship in pediatric neurosurgery and neuro endoscopy followed at the Jikei University School of Medicine in Tokyo from May to August 2007. He then took two fellowships in Adelaide at Flinders Medical Centre and the Women's and Children's Hospital: a spinal and microneurosurgery fellowship from July 2011 to July 2012, and a fellowship in functional and micro neurosurgery and spine surgery from August 2014 to March 2017.

Hydrocephalus and endoscopy run through his other appointments. He sits on the Hydrocephalus Research World Record Ranking Committee and on the continental editorial boards of the International Journal of Hydrocephalus and the Journal of Neuro Endoscopy, and was an Oi-Sami Fellowship awardee at Jikei University in 2007.

He has 24 publications in Indian and international journals, chapters in three neurosurgery textbooks, and has presented at national and international conferences. He has also worked at Fortis Malar Hospital and The Voluntary Health Services Hospital in Chennai.

dr-deepak-keshav-bhangale.bio:
Dr. Deepak Keshav Bhangale is Director of Endoscopic and Minimally Invasive Neurosurgery at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list matches that title on the cranial side. He performs endoscopic brain surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, brain tumor surgery and glioma surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and deep brain stimulation.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an MCh in neurosurgery, together with a Global Diploma in Spine Surgery. His endoscopic training was taken abroad in two short international placements, at Samsung General Hospital in Seoul, South Korea, and at Fujita Health University in Nagoya, Japan. He also holds an AI/ML certification from the IIIT Hyderabad Medical Professionalist Program, which is unusual in a surgical record.

His research has been recognised at WFNS, with award-winning presentations at its conferences in Istanbul and in Nagoya, the second of these in the city where he trained in endoscopy. He holds the Torrent Young Scholar Award in Neurosurgery and multiple international scholarships for research and training.

His organisational work sits with the minimally invasive societies. He is an executive council member of ISMINS and NSSI, was organizing secretary of YNFCON 2025, and examines for the DNB neurosurgery exit examination.

He practises at Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram and at Medanta Mediclinic Golf Course.

dr-prakash-singh.bio:
Dr. Prakash Singh is Director and Unit Head of Neurosurgery at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 36 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is cranial and covers both tumour and vascular work. He performs brain tumor surgery, meningioma surgery and glioma surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, and on the vascular side aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an M.Ch in neurosurgery.

His hospital record divides into two halves and explains the shape of his career. The service half runs through Army Hospital in Pune, Northern Command Hospital in Udhampur and AFMC in Pune, with PGI in Chandigarh alongside them. The civilian half is in the capital region and at Mohali: Max Super Speciality Hospital and Saket City Hospital, both at Saket in New Delhi, and Max Hospital in Mohali.

His two highest honours come from that service career. He holds the Vashisht Seva Medal, awarded by the President of India, and a Chief of Army Staff Commendation. His academic recognition is a Best Paper Award at AFMRC in 2001.

He belongs to the Neurological Society of India, the Neurological Surgeon Society of India and the Association of Spine Surgery of India.

dr-k-kartik-revanappa.bio:
Dr. K Kartik Revanappa is a Consultant Neurosurgeon at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 25 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is split between cranial and spinal work. The cranial half covers brain tumor resection and removal, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, and on the vascular side aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery. The spinal half covers spinal tumor surgery, minimally invasive spine surgery, cervical spine surgery and lumbar spine surgery.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery, an MCh in neurosurgery, a DNB in neurosurgery and MNAMS as an elected member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences. Two overseas fellowships follow: one in neurovascular surgery at Tokyo Women's Medical University in Japan, taken on a Japanese Government MEXT scholarship, and one in stereotaxy at the University of Alberta in Canada.

He was named best outgoing student in the MCh in neurosurgery at NIMHANS in 1998. His later recognition includes first prize at the CNS Conference in Bangalore in 2017 for a publication on brain tumors, and multiple awarded oral and poster presentations at national and international neurosurgery conferences.

He is a life member of the Neurological Society of India and a life member and Fellow of the Neurological Surgeons' Society of India.

Besides Apollo Hospitals he practises at Apollo Hospitals in Seshadripuram and at CNS Clinics in Jayanagar, both in Bangalore.

dr-nitin-dange.bio:
Dr. Nitin Dange is a Consultant Neurosurgeon at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery, spine surgery and interventional neurosurgery.

His list is cranial and weighted towards vascular and skull base work. He performs aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery, brain tumor surgery, meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS and an M.Ch in neurosurgery, together with the OBNI-USA certification and the FFHU fellowship from Japan.

Stroke and interventional work runs through the non-clinical part of his record. He was honorary chairperson of Ram Chandra Advanced Interventional Neuro-Radiology in Chennai in 2014 and lectured on endovascular management of acute stroke to the Maharashtra Chapter of Neurological Surgeons in 2016. India Today Magazine has featured him as one of India's top stroke and neurovascular surgeons, and print media named him among Mumbai's best young neurosurgeons in 2018.

His other recognition includes the Abdul Kalam Excellency Award at Taj Banjara in Hyderabad in 2017, an appreciation award from the Medical Association at Bandra-Khar in 2013, and an award from the Multicon International Board of IBMS in Medicine and Surgery.

Alongside Gleneagles Hospital he is a consultant neurosurgeon at Lilavati Hospital and Research Centre and at Sushrusha, CritiCare and Holy Family hospitals, and is Professor of Neurosurgery at KEM Hospital and Seth GS Medical College, all in Mumbai.

dr-ankit-jain-1.bio:
Dr. Ankit Jain is a Consultant Neurosurgeon and Neurointervention Specialist at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery, spine surgery and interventional neuroradiology.

His list is cranial and covers both tumour and vascular disease. He performs brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, with aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery on the vascular side, which matches the neurointervention half of his title.

His record is marked by examination results at both ends of his superspecialty training. He took AIR 1 in the AIIMS neurosurgery superspeciality entrance examination and first rank in the MCh neurosurgery final examination. His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and that MCh, together with the FINS fellowship in neurosurgery and the FINR fellowship in neuroradiology and neurointervention.

His overseas exposure was taken as an international visiting scholar at the Barrow Neurological Institute in Phoenix, Arizona, with advanced training exposure at Boston Children's Hospital under Harvard Medical School and at University Hospital Zurich.

Two further programmes are recorded: PMDT training under the Revised National TB Control Programme in March 2016, and the Organ Retrieval Banking Organization education and training programme at AIIMS in August 2019.

Besides Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi he practises at Ujala Cygnus Rainbow Hospital in Agra and Ujala Cygnus Central Hospital in Haldwani.

dr-venkatesan-sanjeevi.bio:
Dr. Venkatesan Sanjeevi is a Consultant Neurosurgeon at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial. He performs brain tumor surgery, meningioma surgery and glioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, with aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery on the vascular side.

His training is dated across two decades. He read MBBS at Government Medical College, Salem, between 1997 and 2003, took his MS in general surgery at Madras Medical College in Chennai between 2010 and 2013 and his MCh in neurosurgery at the same college between 2015 and 2018, finishing as a gold medalist and university rank holder. An endoscopic spine surgery fellowship followed at Suyash Hospital in Raipur in 2022, and a fellowship in neuroendovascular surgery and stroke intervention at Kameda Medical Center in Japan in 2025.

He is the author of the Clinical Handbook of Neurosurgery, whose first edition appeared in 2020 and second in 2025. His more than 30 peer-reviewed national and international publications cover brain and spine tumors, neurovascular and aneurysm surgeries, endoscopic and minimally invasive neurosurgery, pediatric neurosurgery, and stroke and neuroendovascular interventions, which between them span the range of his own training.

Besides Gleneagles Hospital at Perumbakkam he has been associated with SNHRC in Vellore, MIOT International and Apollo Proton Cancer Centre in Chennai, Meenakshi Mission Hospital in Madurai, and Madras and Kilpauk medical colleges.

dr-m-vijaya-saradhi.bio:
Dr. M. Vijaya Saradhi is a Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 29 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour, vascular and functional work. He performs brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery, deep brain stimulation and epilepsy surgery, and hydrocephalus surgery including in children.

He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College in Hyderabad, took his DNB in neurosurgery from the National Boards in New Delhi in 2000 and his MCh in neurosurgery at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in the same city. NIMS was also his hospital from 1995 to 2024, a single attachment of nearly three decades, and he has been a visiting fellow at St. Joseph Medical Centre and the Barrow Neurological Institute in Phoenix, Arizona.

A substantial part of his record is regulatory rather than clinical. He has been an inspector for the NMC and the National Board of Examination since 2010, and sat on the draft committee for the NMC regulations superseding the Indian Medical Council professional conduct, etiquette and ethics regulations of 2002. He belongs to the Neurological Society of India and the Andhra Pradesh Neuroscientists Association.

His awards are civic. Megaciti Navakala Vedika gave him the Vijayasaradhi Award for social service in medicine in October 2007 and the Vaidya Siromani Award for outstanding medical service in October 2008, and Sri Ramanujaseva Trust presented him the Vaidyarathna Award through the Governor of Telangana on 1 July 2023.

dr-anand-v-k.bio:
Dr. Anand V K is a Senior Consultant at Medicover Hospital, Bangalore, in Bengaluru, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

Vascular work heads his list. He performs aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms, arteriovenous malformation surgery and cavernoma surgery. The tumour work covers glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, brain tumor surgery and spinal tumor surgery, with craniotomy, endoscopic brain surgery and epilepsy surgery alongside them.

His training moved from Bangalore to Chandigarh and then overseas. He read MBBS at BMC Bangalore and took both his MS in general surgery and his MCh in neurosurgery at PGIMER, Chandigarh. He then took a diploma in cerebrovascular and skull base surgery at Sapporo in Japan and a fellowship in cerebrovascular surgery at Catholic University in Seoul, South Korea, the two subjects that head his procedure list. His fellowship in endoscopic neurosurgery was taken with ESMINT.

His examination record is the clearest marker of that training. He placed second in both the AIIMS and PGI entrance examinations for the MCh simultaneously, and was named best outgoing student at Dr. RML Hospital. He also took second prize in a poster presentation at IASG and has presented at national and international conferences.

Besides Medicover Hospitals in Bengaluru he has been associated with Narayana Hrudayalaya at its Whitefield and HSR branches, Apollo Hospitals, and Amara Hospital in Tirupati.

dr-anurag-gupta.bio:
Dr. Anurag Gupta is Associate Director and Head of the Unit in Neurosurgery at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is unusually evenly divided between the two. The cranial work covers brain tumor surgery and glioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, endoscopic brain surgery, deep brain stimulation, arteriovenous malformation surgery, peripheral nerve surgery, and paediatric brain tumor and hydrocephalus surgery. The spinal work covers microdiscectomy, spinal tumor surgery, spinal fusion surgery, spinal trauma surgery and endoscopic spine surgery.

All three of his degrees were taken at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal: MBBS in 2003, an MS in general surgery in 2006 and the MCh in neurosurgery in 2010.

His published work covers both compartments and mostly reports unusual cases or technique. He published on endoscopic evacuation of septated chronic subdural hemorrhage, with its technical considerations, results and outcome, in Surgical Neurology International in 2022. In the Asian Journal of Neurosurgery he reported a rare case of simultaneous multifocal craniospinal hemangiopericytomas, and in Neurology India both an unusual shunt entrapment with the distal end placed inside the falciform ligament and a paper on synchronous spinal lesions. His retrospective study of eight cases of traumatic atlanto-axial instability appeared in the Indian Journal of Orthopaedics.

Besides Max Healthcare in New Delhi he has been associated with Fortis Flt. Lt. Rajan Dhall Hospital, Narayana Super Speciality Hospital and Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurugram, Adarsha Super Speciality Hospital in Udupi, and Kasturba Medical College.

dr-sogani-shani-kumar.bio:
Dr. Sogani Shani Kumar is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 35 years of experience in neurosurgery. His qualifications are MBBS, an MS and an MCh in neurosurgery.

His list runs across cranial, spinal and paediatric work. On the cranial side he performs brain tumor removal and resection, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, arteriovenous malformation surgery, endoscopic brain surgery and traumatic brain injury surgery. The paediatric side covers pediatric brain tumor surgery and pediatric hydrocephalus surgery alongside hydrocephalus surgery generally. The spinal side covers spinal tumor surgery, minimally invasive spine surgery, cervical spine surgery and lumbar spine surgery.

His awards are civic rather than academic and four of them were given in a single year. In 1993 he received the Pride of India Gold Award, the Indira Gandhi Priyadarshini Award, the Jain Gaurav Award and the Rajiv Gandhi Excellence Award. His record lists further honours including the Misa Sansar Pragyashikha Award, the Nalin Gandhi Excellence Award, the Uttam Sewa Ratan Award and the Sanjay Jena Bravery Sportsman Award.

His teaching and academic record is given in volume rather than by title: he has delivered over 200 lectures nationally and internationally and published several papers at national and international conferences.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals, Delhi, at Sarita Vihar on the Delhi-Mathura Road.

dr-m-balamurugan.bio:
Dr. M Balamurugan is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospital, Chennai, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour, vascular, functional and paediatric work. He performs brain tumor surgery and glioma surgery, craniotomy, spinal tumor surgery, pediatric brain tumor surgery and pediatric hydrocephalus surgery with hydrocephalus surgery generally, deep brain stimulation and stereotactic brain surgery, and on the vascular side arteriovenous malformation surgery and aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms.

His qualifications are MBBS and a DNB in neurosurgery, together with the FRCS of Glasgow and the FAANS as a Fellow of the American Association of Neurological Surgeons. He also holds a fellowship from the American Academy of Neurological Surgeons.

Three international meetings are recorded within a single eight-month span, and they track the breadth of his list: the annual conference of the Asian Society of Cervical Spine Surgery in Istanbul in November 2014, the Hydrocephalus Update and Consensus Meeting at Le Locle in France in April 2015, and the World Spine Society Meeting in Bali in June 2015.

His published work is largely in Neurology India, where he has written on post-electrocution demyelination, midline frontal lesions and synchronous spinal lesions. He has also worked on the role of CT, MRI and neuropsychological evaluation in head injuries.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals on Greams Road in Chennai.

dr-kapil-khandelwal.bio:
Dr. Kapil Khandelwal is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Thane, in Mumbai, with more than 16 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery, and his qualifications are MBBS, an MS and an MCh in neurosurgery.

His list is cranial. He performs brain tumor surgery, craniotomy, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, endoscopic brain surgery, trigeminal neuralgia surgery, and on the vascular side arteriovenous malformation surgery and aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms.

His society memberships are mostly for life and divide between the cranial and spinal halves of his practice. He is a lifetime member of the Neurological Society of India, of the Skull Based Surgery Society of India, of NASSA and of the Bombay Neurosciences Association, together with the Maharashtra Chapter of Neurological Surgeons. On the spinal side he is a member of AO Spine.

His published work is a set of individual reports rather than series. He published a case report on Rosai Dorfman disease in the Gujarat Medical Journal in February 2016, and a paper in the NIHL Journal of Medical Science on isolated solitary intramedullary spinal cord metastasis presenting as the first manifestation of adenocarcinoma of lung. He has also contributed a chapter on foramen magnum decompression to ASSI, which sits at the junction of the cranial and spinal work his two listed specialties cover.

He practises at KIMS Hospital in Thane.

dr-sujit-kumar-vidiyala.bio:
Dr. Sujit Kumar Vidiyala is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 35 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is one of the broadest cranial lists on this profile set. The tumour work covers brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery and acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery. The vascular work covers aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms, arteriovenous malformation surgery and cavernoma surgery. The functional work covers deep brain stimulation and VNS implant, and he also performs craniotomy and peripheral nerve surgery.

His training is dated to the month across fifteen years. He read M.B.B.S at J.S.S. Medical College in Mysore in June 1993 and took ECFMG certification in the USA in September 1995, then his MCh in neurosurgery at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad in December 2001. Two fellowships in Japan followed: micro neurosurgery at Fujita Health University in December 2007, and a WFNS fellowship in skull base surgery at Keio University in July 2008.

His hospital history stays close to home. Besides KIMS Hospitals in Hyderabad he has been associated with BBR Hospital and Sunshine Hospital in the same city, Osmania General Hospital and Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences where he trained, and Vijay Hospital and the Prathima Institute of Medical Sciences in Karimnagar.

dr-manas-kumar-panigrahi.bio:
Dr. Manas Kumar Panigrahi is Head of Department and Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour, vascular and functional work. The tumour work runs to brain tumor surgery and glioma surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, with craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery. The vascular work covers aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery. The functional work covers deep brain stimulation, epilepsy surgery and focused-ultrasound thalamotomy, the last of these an incisionless technique that is rare on an Indian operating list.

His training is dated across eleven years. He read M.B.B.S. at M.K.C.G. Medical College in Berhampur, Orissa, between 1983 and 1989, and took his MCh in neurosurgery at NIMHANS in Bangalore between 1989 and 1994. He is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons.

His academic record is the largest part of his profile. He has more than 140 publications in national and international peer-reviewed journals, has contributed chapters to textbooks in neurosciences and has received multiple best paper awards at national and international meetings. He is a regular faculty member at national and international meetings and CME programmes, has organised numerous meetings in neurosciences, and is an international member of the Congress of Neurological Surgeons.

He practises at KIMS Hospitals in Secunderabad and Hyderabad.

dr-abhidha-shah.bio:
Dr. Abhidha Shah is a Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 22 years of experience. Her profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

Her list is largely cranial tumour work. She performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, with epilepsy surgery and spinal tumor surgery alongside them.

Her training was taken in Mumbai and then Bangalore. She read MBBS at Grant Medical College in Mumbai and took her MS in general surgery at Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital in the same city, then her MCh in neurosurgery at NIMHANS in Bangalore. She also holds a DNB in neurosurgery and the intercollegiate FRCS as a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons, UK. Two further fellowships follow: an advanced fellowship of the Royal College of Neurological Surgeons, and an advanced and free flap fellowship from the Joint Chapter of Neurological Surgeons, USA.

Her awards are for presented and published research. She was a top entry and winner in neurosurgery for the World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies International Award in 2016, and received the Young Neurosurgeon Award of the Neurotrauma Society of India for best clinical presentation in 2017. She also took second prize at the national annual conference of the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, and the Sri Ratan Tata Award for research in Frontiers in Neurosurgery at NIMHANS, Bangalore, where she trained.

She practises at Apollo Hospitals at CBD Belapur in Navi Mumbai.

dr-rahul-gupta-.bio:
Dr. Rahul Gupta is a Consultant Neurosurgeon at Fortis Escorts Heart Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is split between the head and the spine. The cranial work covers brain tumor surgery and glioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery, endoscopic brain surgery and endoscopic skull base surgery, with aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery on the vascular side. The spinal work covers spinal tumor surgery, spinal trauma surgery and spinal cord injury.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an MCh in neurosurgery. His later training was taken abroad and matches two entries on his list directly: advanced training in fluorescence 5-ALA guided malignant glioma surgery at Graz in Austria, and training in functional neurosurgery at Amsterdam in Holland. He also holds the Sugita Scholarship, awarded at Nagoya University of Medical Science in Japan in 2011.

His writing runs in two directions. For the profession he has published approximately 55 articles in reputed national and international scientific journals and presented numerous papers at conferences. For patients he has authored a book on back pain, published in both English and Hindi, which is an unusual entry on a neurosurgical record and sits with the spinal half of his practice.

He is an active member and participant in many neurosurgical societies, and practises at Fortis Escorts Heart Institute and Fortis Noida.

dr-m-anbuselvam.bio:
Dr. M. Anbuselvam is a Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 42 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour, vascular, functional and paediatric work: brain tumor surgery and meningioma surgery, craniotomy, cavernoma surgery and arteriovenous malformation surgery, endoscopic brain surgery, surgery for congenital brain and spine anomalies, pediatric brain tumor surgery, deep brain stimulation, epilepsy surgery, and stereotactic brain biopsy and stereotactic brain surgery.

He read MBBS at Government Kilpauk Medical College in Chennai between 1979 and 1984, and took his MCh in neurosurgery at the Institute of Neurology, Madras Medical College, under The Dr. MGR Medical University between 1989 and 1994, where he was awarded Prof. S. Kalyanaraman's Gold Medal.

The middle of his career was spent abroad. After four years at the Institute of Neurology and Madras Medical College and Hospital from Dec 1994 to May 1998, he moved to Brunei Darussalam, working at RIPAS Hospital in Bandar Seri Begawan from May 1998 to Oct 2014 and at Jerudong Park Medical Centre and the National Stroke and Rehabilitation Centre. He was a visiting lecturer and OSCE examiner at the PAP Rashidah Sa'adatul Bolkiah Institute of Health Sciences, University Brunei Darussalam, from 2009 to 2013, and national faculty four times in the Brunei Scoliosis Week international programme between 2008 and 2014. He returned to Apollo Speciality Hospitals in Chennai from Nov 2014 to Jan 2021.

He has presented at the ASEAN Neurosurgery Conference in Singapore, the Asian Congress of Neurosurgery in Istanbul, the Asian Neurosurgery Conference in Beijing, BORNEO Surgical Delights and the Neurological Society of India annual conference.

dr-air-cmde-krishan-kumar-yadav.bio:
Dr. (Air Cmde) Krishan Kumar Yadav is Professor and Clinical Director of Neurosurgery and Neurospine Surgery at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram, in Delhi NCR, with more than 40 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pediatric brain tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery.

All three of his degrees were taken at the Armed Forces Medical College under Pune University, at roughly eight-year intervals: MBBS in 1990, an MS in general surgery in 1999 and the MCh in neurosurgery in 2006. Alongside them his record lists the service courses MOIC, MOSCC, SMOCC and Aviation Medicine, and further training in MET, BCSIR, SHAIK, ethics, telemedicine and communication skills.

His hospital history follows the same service career across the country. He has worked at AFMC and Command Hospital Southern Command in Pune, Command Hospital Eastern Command in Kolkata and Command Hospital Air Force in Bangalore. In Bangalore he has also been at SDU Medical College and RLJ Hospital and at Kauvery Hospitals, before his present post at Marengo Asia Hospitals in Gurugram.

The combination of an aviation medicine course, a service rank in his name and a superspecialty degree from the armed forces medical school describes a neurosurgical career built entirely within military medicine before moving to civilian practice.

dr-ganesh-krishna-murthy.bio:
Dr. Ganesh Krishna Murthy is a Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon at Medicover Hospital, Bangalore, in Bengaluru, with more than 37 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial and covers both tumour and functional work. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, deep brain stimulation and epilepsy surgery. His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an MCh in neurosurgery.

His student record is a run of three gold medals awarded in a single year, and all three were taken outside neurosurgery. In 1995 he won the gold medal in medicine at Kilpauk Medical College, the inter-collegiate gold medal in urology at Madras Medical College and the inter-collegiate gold medal in clinical medicine at Stanley Medical College. He has since published multiple research papers in neurosurgery journals.

His society memberships cover both halves of his practice at national and city level. He belongs to the Neurological Society of India and the Neuro Spine Society of India, and to the Bangalore Neurological Society in the city where he practises. The spine society membership sits with the second specialty on his profile, which his listed procedures do not otherwise describe.

He currently works at Medicover Hospitals in Whitefield, Bengaluru. Between the deep brain stimulation and epilepsy entries on one side and the tumour resections on the other, his list covers both the functional and the oncological halves of cranial neurosurgery across a career of more than 37 years.

dr-alok-ranjan.bio:
Dr. Alok Ranjan is Consultant and Coordinator of the Department of Neurosurgery at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is short and cranial: brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy, epilepsy surgery and deep brain stimulation. His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery, an MCh in neurosurgery and the FRCS in neurosurgery.

His presented work includes an award-winning case presentation on a rapidly evolving intracerebral mass mimicking brain abscess surgery, intrinsically invasive growth factor, alfa antibodies and IgG4-related hypertrophic pachymeningitis. He has also received the best GNCC prize for neurosurgical presentations since 1993 at Nizam's Hospital in Hyderabad.

His published research covers epidural spinal cord compression, hub injuries and neurosurgical outcomes, and has appeared in peer-reviewed journals including Neurology India and the British Journal of Neurosurgery. He has further publications on gunshot and ballistic surgery, epidural abscess management and craniofacial surgical approaches. Taken together, the trauma and infection subjects in that list sit alongside rather than inside the elective tumour and functional work his procedure list describes.

Besides Apollo Hospitals and Apollo Health City at Jubilee Hills he has been associated with Aware Gleneagles Global Hospital at LB Nagar, also in Hyderabad.

dr-dattatray-mazumdar.bio:
Dr. Dattatray Mazumdar is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 23 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with neuro-oncology on the surgical oncology side.

His list reflects that pairing. The tumour work covers brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery and spinal tumor surgery. Alongside it he performs epilepsy surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery.

His qualifications are the longest string on this profile set and run to eight entries. After MBBS and an MS he took the FCPS of the College of Physicians and Surgeons, the MCh in neurosurgery, a DNB and MNAMS as a member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences. Two international fellowships complete the list: FICS as a Fellow of the International College of Surgeons and FACS as a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons.

His attachments explain the two specialties on his profile directly. Besides Gleneagles Hospital at Parel he is associated with KEM Hospital through its epilepsy surgery programme and neuro-oncology tumor board, which correspond to the epilepsy and tumour entries on his list, and with Tata Memorial Hospital through joint neuro-oncology meetings.

That combination of a cancer centre tumour board, a hospital epilepsy programme and a private consultant post describes a practice in which cranial tumour surgery and epilepsy surgery are both handled through multidisciplinary meetings rather than in isolation.

dr-yawar-shoaib-ali.bio:
Dr. Yawar Shoaib Ali is Director and Head of Unit I in Neurosurgery at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 21 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial and covers tumour, vascular and functional work. He performs brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery, peripheral nerve surgery, deep brain stimulation and epilepsy surgery.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in surgery and an MCh in neurosurgery, and he was awarded university gold medals in surgery and in pharmacology.

His hospital history runs through the public and private sectors and includes a post abroad. Before his present appointment at Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad, he worked at Max Superspeciality Hospital at Saket and at Shalimar Bagh in New Delhi, at PGIMER and Dr. RML Hospital in the same city, and at Zayed Military Hospital in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

He is a life member of the Neurological Surgeons Society of India and of the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, the two bodies corresponding to the two specialties recorded on his profile.

dr-anuvrat-sinha.bio:
Dr. Anuvrat Sinha is a Consultant at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery, and his listed procedures are brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery, meningioma surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery.

His training moved from the north to the south. He read MBBS at King George's Medical University in Lucknow, with distinction in pharmacology, and took his MS in general surgery at Motilal Nehru Medical College in Allahabad, affiliated to KGMU. His MCh in neurosurgery was taken at Rangaraya Medical College and Government Hospital in Kakinada, affiliated to NTR University of Health Sciences in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, between 2018 and 2021.

His awards come from both stages of that training. In 2017 he won the ASI-Torrent Young Scholar Award for general surgery and was adjudged best PG at ASICON in Jaipur, took second prize at the ASI Regional Refresher Course at RML in New Delhi in August of that year, and was recognised as best postgraduate student in surgery at Motilal Nehru Medical College. After moving to neurosurgery he took third prize in the APNEUROCON neuroradiology quiz in 2020.

His society memberships follow the same route: the Association of Surgeons of India from his general surgical training, the Andhra Pradesh Neuroscientists Association from his superspecialty years, and the Neurological Society of India.

He practises at Artemis Hospital in Gurugram.

dr-anshul-goel.bio:
Dr. Anshul Goel is a Consultant at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 13 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is weighted towards the spine and towards children. The spinal work covers spinal tumor surgery, spinal fusion surgery, cervical spine surgery, spinal deformity correction, spinal trauma surgery and endoscopic spine surgery. The paediatric and congenital work covers pediatric brain tumor surgery, pediatric hydrocephalus surgery and hydrocephalus surgery, and surgery for congenital brain and spine anomalies. He also performs brain tumor surgery, peripheral nerve surgery and endoscopic brain surgery.

His three degrees were taken at four-to-five year intervals and each at a different institution. He read MBBS at Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College in Belagavi, Karnataka, in 2013, finishing with the gold medal for best outgoing student, took his MS in general surgery at Maulana Azad Medical College in New Delhi in 2018 and his MCh in neurosurgery at AIIMS, New Delhi, in 2021.

His conference record covers his training years. He took the best poster presentation award at the ASI Conference in Jaipur in 2017, presented a poster at the WFNS Conference in Beijing and both a poster and a paper at the NSI Conference in Mumbai in 2019, and presented a paper at the INDSPN Conference in Kolkata in 2020, the last of these at the paediatric neurosurgery meeting that matches the paediatric half of his list.

He practises at Max Healthcare and at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in New Delhi.

dr-kapil-jain.bio:
Dr. Kapil Jain is Director and Head of Unit in Neurosurgery at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial with a paediatric strand. He performs brain tumor surgery and pediatric brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, surgery for congenital brain and spine anomalies, arteriovenous malformation surgery and deep brain stimulation.

His training is dated across two decades. He read MBBS at the University College of Medical Sciences and Guru Tegh Bahadur Hospital in Delhi in 2001 and took his MS in general surgery at the same institution. His MCh in neurosurgery was taken at Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Lucknow in 2010, followed by a post-doctorate fellowship in paediatric neurosurgery at the same institute in 2011, which accounts for the paediatric entries on his list. Two later courses were taken in Mumbai in 2019: Prof. Ramani's Spine Master's Teaching Course, and European Continuing Medical Training in deep brain stimulation for movement disorders.

His recognition is recent and local. The Delhi Medical Association gave him its Excellence in Medicine Award in 2024, and Max Hospital, Saket, its Gem Award. He is a DNB mentor and co-guide for thesis submissions.

He practises at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in New Delhi.

dr-muralidharan-vetrivel.bio:
Dr. Muralidharan Vetrivel is a Consultant at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery, interventional neuroradiology and spine surgery.

His list covers open and endovascular treatment of the same conditions. On the open side he performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy, spinal tumor surgery, cavernoma surgery, arteriovenous malformation surgery and aneurysm clipping. On the endovascular side he performs aneurysm coiling, AVM embolization and stroke thrombectomy, which is the interventional neuroradiology arm of his profile.

His training is dated and much of it was taken abroad. He read MBBS at Madras Medical College and Government General Hospital in 2012, then completed a six-year integrated MCh in neurosurgery at Christian Medical College, Vellore, in 2019. His fellowship in endovascular neurosurgery was taken at the University of Catania in Italy in 2020. He also holds advanced microvascular anastomosis training from the Christian Doppler Medical Centre in Salzburg, Austria, and exclusive training in microvascular anastomosis techniques at Erasmus Medical Centre in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

His speaking record is recent. He was an invited speaker at TEDx in 2023, and in 2024 was faculty at the World Neurosciences Summit and at the Neurological Society of India.

He has been at Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre in Chennai since 2025, and worked at Panimalar Medical College Hospital and Research Institute from 2021 to 2025.

dr-v-s-mehta.bio:
Dr. V S Mehta is Chairman Emeritus of Neurosciences at Paras Hospitals, Gurugram, in Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is cranial and largely tumour work. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery, pediatric brain tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, with spinal tumor surgery alongside them.

After M.B.B.S. and an M.S. in general surgery he took his M.Ch. in neurosurgery at AIIMS, New Delhi. He is a Fellow of the National Academy of Sciences, India, and a Fellow of the National Academy of Medical Sciences.

The Government of India has awarded him the Padma Shri in recognition of his distinguished contributions to the field of neurosurgery. That civilian honour, together with fellowships of both national academies and the title of Chairman Emeritus rather than a serving departmental head, describes a career whose standing rests on its length and contribution to the specialty as much as on its current operating list.

The list itself is worth setting out by group. Glioma, meningioma and brain tumor surgery are recorded together as the general tumour work. Skull base tumor surgery, skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery and acoustic neuroma surgery form a second group at the base of the skull. Pediatric brain tumor surgery extends the same work to children, and spinal tumor surgery takes it below the head. Craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery are listed as the approaches.

He practises at Paras Health in Gurugram.

dr-rajendra-prasad.bio:
Dr. Rajendra Prasad is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 35 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list runs across tumour, vascular and functional work. The tumour half covers brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, and pituitary tumor surgery, with craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery as the approaches. The vascular half covers aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery. The functional half covers epilepsy surgery, VNS implant and deep brain stimulation, so the same practice treats tumours, aneurysms and drug-resistant epilepsy.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an M.Ch in neurosurgery. His fellowship training was taken at various international institutions, including programmes in the USA, the UK, France and Japan.

His record notes multiple national and international awards for his contributions to neurosurgery, recognition for excellence in brain tumor surgery and spinal neurosurgery, awards for distinguished research and publications in peer-reviewed neurosurgical journals, and honours at neurosurgical conferences for academic and clinical contribution. No titles or years are recorded on the profile, so they are left as the record gives them.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals, Indraprastha.

dr-binit-kedia.bio:
Dr. Binit Kedia is an Associate Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 13 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial and covers tumour, vascular and functional work. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy, endoscopic brain surgery and hydrocephalus surgery, with aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery on the vascular side, and epilepsy surgery and deep brain stimulation on the functional side.

His training began in the northeast and finished in the northwest. He read MBBS at Assam Medical College in Dibrugarh and took his MS in general surgery at Gauhati Medical College, both in Assam, then his MCh in neurosurgery at RNT Medical College in Udaipur, Rajasthan.

His hospital history follows the same route in reverse. Besides his present post at Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad, he has worked at Metro Hospital in Sector 16 in the same city, at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in New Delhi, at RNT Medical College in Udaipur where he trained, and at Star Hospital and Research in Hojai, Assam.

His published work is a comparison of techniques in skull reconstruction: cranioplasty using autologous bone against titanium mesh, published in the Romanian Journal of Neurosurgery.

dr-sanjeev-srivastava.bio:
Dr. Sanjeev Srivastava is a Senior Consultant at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is almost entirely functional and stereotactic. He performs deep brain stimulation, epilepsy surgery, VNS implant, stereotactic brain surgery and stereotactic radiosurgery, together with brain tumor surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery and craniotomy.

He read MBBS at M.L.B. Medical College in Jhansi and holds a DNB in general surgery and a DNB in neurosurgery. His advanced fellowship in functional neurosurgery and neuromodulation was taken in the Department of Neurosurgery at the University of Illinois at Chicago in October and November 2018, under Dr. (Prof.) Konstantin Slavin, and it corresponds directly to the DBS and VNS entries on his list.

His student record is exceptional even among surgical profiles. He won fourteen gold medals in MBBS at M.L.B. Medical College for securing the highest marks in various subjects across the curriculum, two Governor's Gold Medals from Bundelkhand University in Jhansi for being the overall university topper throughout MBBS, and a university bronze medal from the same university for securing 66.87% marks.

He practises at the Artemis Agrim Institute of Neurosciences at Artemis Hospital in Gurugram, and trained previously at Medanta, the Medicity, in Gurgaon.

dr-sudhir-dubey.bio:
Dr. Sudhir Dubey is Chairman of the Department of Neurosurgery and Neurosciences at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 30 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is cranial and built around tumour work. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery.

He read M.B.B.S. at King George's Medical College, where he was awarded the Sir Rupkishan Das Gold Medal for his final year and held a merit scholarship, and took his M.Ch in neurosurgery at NIMHANS, finishing as best outgoing student in neurosurgery with the Silver Jubilee Award.

His highest distinction came early and from abroad. The World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies conferred its Young Neurosurgeon's Award on him, and his record notes that he was the first and only recipient from India. His cutting-edge work on brain tumors also received international recognition at Sydney, Australia, in 2001, which is the same area his operating list centres on.

Read together, his awards follow a single line. The gold medal and merit scholarship belong to his undergraduate years at King George's Medical College, the Silver Jubilee Award to the end of his superspecialty training at NIMHANS, the Sydney recognition to his early consultant work on brain tumors, and the World Federation award to the standing that followed it. The departmental chairmanship at Medanta is the present point on that line.

He practises at Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram.

dr-bipin-walia.bio:
Dr. Bipin Walia is Chairman and Head of Neurosurgery and Neurospine at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is cranial with a spinal component. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, together with spinal tumor surgery.

He read MBBS and took his MS in general surgery at the Armed Forces Medical College in Pune, then his M.Ch in neurosurgery at AIIMS, New Delhi. He also holds a DNB in neurosurgery.

A distinct part of his record is teaching rather than operating. The National Board of Examinations recognises him as a post graduate teacher for the MS in general surgery at the universities of Delhi and Pune, and for the DNB in neurosurgery, which covers both the general surgical stage he trained in at Pune and the superspecialty he practises.

His practice runs across three hospitals in the same area of the capital: Max Super Speciality Hospital and Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, both at Saket in New Delhi, and Max Hospital at Saket West.

dr-b-g-ratnam.bio:
Dr. B G Ratnam is a Consultant Neurosurgeon at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour, functional and paediatric work. He performs brain tumor surgery and glioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy, epilepsy surgery, peripheral nerve surgery, and hydrocephalus surgery including in children.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an MCh in neurosurgery, and his fellowship training covered cranial surgery, spine surgery and neuro-oncology, the three areas his procedure list draws on.

His academic record is presented mainly through the meetings he has taken work to. He received recognition in 2014 at Rajiv Gandhi University and the 49th Congress of Indian Association of Neurosurgeons at Greater Noida, and has presented research at national conferences including the annual conference of the Neurological Society of India and meetings of the Indian Society of Neuro-Oncology, the latter matching the neuro-oncology strand of his fellowship training. He has published multiple research papers in national and international neurosurgery and neurotrauma journals, so the trauma side of the specialty appears in his writing even though it is not named on his procedure list.

He practises at Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad.

dr-sunit-mediratta.bio:
Dr. Sunit Mediratta is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is cranial. He performs brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery, craniotomy, endoscopic brain surgery and epilepsy surgery.

His qualifications run to five entries before his fellowships. After MBBS he took an MS, then the MCh in neurosurgery and a DNB, and is a member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences.

His two fellowships were taken abroad in successive years and in different areas of the specialty. The first was a cerebrovascular surgery fellowship at Fujita Health University in Nagoya, Japan, in July 2009. The second was a spinal surgery fellowship in minimally invasive techniques at Hochtaunusklinik in Bad Homburg, Germany, in August 2010. Between them they add vascular and spinal training to a listed practice that is otherwise built on cranial tumour resection and epilepsy surgery.

The procedures themselves fall into three groups. Brain tumor surgery, skull base tumor surgery, skull base surgery and pituitary tumor surgery are the tumour work, and the skull base entries indicate where much of it sits. Craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery are the two approaches recorded. Epilepsy surgery stands apart from both as the one non-tumour indication on the list.

He practises at Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals in Delhi, and holds the MCh and the DNB in neurosurgery alongside membership of the National Academy of Medical Sciences.

dr-v-r-roopesh-kumar.bio:
Dr. V. R. Roopesh Kumar is Director of Neurosurgery at MGM Healthcare, Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list covers tumour, vascular and functional work. He performs brain tumor surgery, glioma surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, pituitary tumor surgery and craniotomy, with aneurysm clipping for brain aneurysms and arteriovenous malformation surgery on the vascular side, and deep brain stimulation on the functional side.

His three degrees were taken over eight years. He read MBBS under Dr. MGR Medical University in 1996, took his MS in general surgery at Madurai Medical College under the same university in 2001, and his MCh in neurosurgery at NIMHANS in Bangalore in 2004.

His recognition is recent and regional. In 2022 the Top-Notch Foundation named him Best Neurosurgeon in Tamil Nadu, the Atal Achievement Awards, supported by the Ministry for Rural Development and Steel, named him Most Trusted Neurosurgeon of South India, and he received the Mayan Award for Best Neurosurgeon in Chennai. In 2023 the Pride of Nation Awards by Brand Solutions named him Outstanding Neuro-Oncologist of the Year for 2022–23, which points to the tumour half of his list.

He practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai.

dr-naren-nayak.bio:
Dr. Naren Nayak is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is short and weighted towards functional work. He performs deep brain stimulation and epilepsy surgery alongside brain tumor surgery, acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery, pituitary tumor surgery and craniotomy.

After MBBS and an MS he took his MCh in neurosurgery, then a fellowship in stereotaxy and functional neurosurgery in the Department of Neurosurgery at Tokyo Women's Medical University in Japan, under Prof. Takaomi Taira. That fellowship is the training behind the deep brain stimulation and epilepsy entries that head his procedure list.

His record credits him with initiating and co-leading the first deep brain stimulation programme at Gleneagles Hospital, Parel, where he now practises, so the subject of his fellowship became a new service at his own hospital rather than an individual technique he brought back. He has also served in academic and surgical leadership roles at top Mumbai medical institutions, and has been associated with Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital and Medical College in the same city.

The rest of his list sits either side of that functional core. Brain tumor surgery, pituitary tumor surgery and acoustic neuroma or vestibular schwannoma surgery are the tumour work, and craniotomy is the approach recorded for it. Spine surgery is listed as his second specialty.

dr-sridutt-bhadri.bio:
Dr. Sridutt Bhadri is a Consultant Neurosurgeon at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 7 years of experience in neurosurgery.

His list is cranial and concentrated on tumour resection. He performs brain tumor surgery and meningioma surgery, skull base tumor surgery and skull base surgery, craniotomy and endoscopic brain surgery, a set of procedures in which the endoscopic and open approaches are both represented.

His qualifications are the most detailed part of his record and run to seven entries, which is a long list for a surgeon at this stage of a career. He read M.B.B.S. and took his M.S. in general surgery, then completed two separate neurosurgical qualifications, the M.Ch. and the D.N.B., and was elected a member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences.

Two of the seven are international board qualifications rather than Indian degrees. He is a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons, England, and a Fellow of the European Board of Neurological Surgeons, the latter examined at European rather than national level. Holding both alongside the M.Ch. and D.N.B. means his training has been assessed under three separate examination systems.

Besides Apollo Hospitals on Bannerghatta Road he practises at Apollo Specialty Hospital in Jayanagar, Bengaluru.

dr-s-sahariah.bio:
Dr. S. Sahariah is Senior Consultant and Head of the Organ Transplantation Centre at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 48 years of experience. His profile records urology together with the transplantation side of surgical gastroenterology.

Transplantation is most of his list. He performs kidney transplant surgery, living donor and deceased donor kidney transplant and ABO-incompatible kidney transplant, and also treats BPH or enlarged prostate and overactive bladder.

His training runs from Assam to Chandigarh and then to the United States. He passed the higher secondary examination at Jorhat, Assam, in 1962, read MBBS at Gauhati University and completed a surgical residency at Government Medical College, Gauhati. Both his MS in surgery and his MCh in urology were taken at PGI Chandigarh. He was an ICMR research fellow in the Department of Renal Transplantation at the University of Minnesota from November 1976 to August 1978, and held fellowships at Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital and at Peter Bent Brigham Hospital in Boston.

His record credits him with performing the first renal transplantation in Andhra Pradesh in 1983 and in Assam, with the first cadaveric renal transplantation in multiple states of India, and with an award for outstanding contribution to cadaveric organ transplant programme development.
