He is a life member of the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation, the Urological Society of India and the Association of Surgeons of India, a Fellow of the International College of Surgeons, a member of the American Society of Transplant Surgeons and a selected member of The Transplantation Society.

dr-varun-agarwal.bio:
Dr. Varun Agarwal is a Consultant Urologist and Robotic Surgeon at Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list divides between cancer and stone work. The cancer half covers radical prostatectomy and prostate cancer surgery, kidney cancer surgery, radical cystectomy for bladder cancer and testicular cancer surgery. The stone and outflow half covers percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy, kidney and bladder stone surgery, BPH or enlarged prostate and laser prostate surgery.

He took his MS in general surgery at Grant Medical College and Sir J.J. Hospitals and his MCh in urology at Topiwala National Medical College and B.Y.L. Nair Hospital, both in Mumbai, and also holds a DNB in urology, MNAMS and FMAS. His fellowship in robotic uro-oncology was taken at Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital in Mumbai, with international training at Royal Adelaide Hospital in Australia and at the Miami Cancer Institute and Vattikuti Foundation in the USA.

His prize record runs from medical school to recent conferences. He took second rank in the MBBS examinations in 2009 and first rank in the finals in 2010, was best outgoing student for 2009–2010 and held a JRD Tata Scholarship from 2008 to 2010, then topped the MCh urology exams at Nair Hospital in 2019. At conferences he won first prize at the Mumbai Urological Society meeting at Karjat in 2017, second at Daman in 2018, and first prize for a moderated poster at WZUSICON 2021 in Goa on robotic surgery safety in urological cancers.

dr-gutta-srinivas.bio:
Dr. Gutta Srinivas is Senior Consultant Urologist and Transplant Surgeon and Clinical Director of the Department of Urology at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records urology together with andrology.

Transplantation heads his list. He performs kidney transplant surgery, living donor, deceased donor and ABO-incompatible kidney transplant. The rest covers percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and kidney stone surgery, laser prostate surgery, urethroplasty and urinary tract reconstruction.

He read MBBS at KMC Hubli under Karnataka University, took his MS in general surgery at Government Medical College, Bellary, under Gulbarga University, and his DNB in urology at Apollo Hospitals, Chennai, under the NBE.

His firsts and prizes are both in transplantation. His record credits him with the first dual kidney transplant in Andhra Pradesh and the first ABO-incompatible transplant using the adsorbent technique in India, and he has published on the first ABO kidney transplantation in India in the Indian Transplant Newsletter of 2011. He took best paper awards for ABO-incompatible transplant experience at Shenzen in China, for laparoscopic donor nephrectomy and for auto-transplantation for renal artery stenosis at SOGUS-2018, and for elderly donor experience at the SZ-USI conference in Bengaluru in 2022.

His case reports cover giant ureteric calculus in Indian J Urol in 2013, and leiomyosarcoma of the scrotum and penile fracture with complete urethral disruption in the International Journal of Medical and Applied Sciences.

He belongs to the Urological Society of India, the Association of Southern Urologists, SOGUS and the Hyderabad Urological Society.

dr-sujit-chowdhary.bio:
Dr. Sujit Chowdhary is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 27 years of experience. His profile records pediatric urology.

His list is almost entirely children's surgery. He performs pediatric urological reconstruction, correction of congenital urological anomalies, pediatric kidney stone surgery and pediatric urinary tract surgery, urinary tract reconstruction and redo urological reconstruction, kidney, bladder and ureteric stone surgery, and bladder outlet obstruction surgery. Pediatric GI surgery and congenital GI anomalies are listed alongside them.

All three of his degrees were taken in Delhi, at Maulana Azad Medical College and Lok Nayak Hospital: MBBS, an MS in general surgery and the MCh in pediatric surgery. His fellowship in pediatric urology was taken at Charitè University in Berlin, and he also trained surgically in the United Kingdom. He is a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh, a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons of Glasgow admitted in 1997, a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons admitted in 2005 and a Fellow of the National Academy of Medical Sciences, India.

The Indian Association of Pediatric Surgeons gave him its Best Faculty Award for surgical skill consecutively for three years across 2016 and 2017. He is a member of the British Association of Urological Surgeons.

His publication record in peer-reviewed national and international journals covers pediatric urology, hypospadias, vesicoureteral reflux, urinary tract reconstruction and other pediatric surgical conditions. He has also been associated with Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi.

dr-mallikarjuna-reddy-n.bio:
Dr. Mallikarjuna Reddy N is Senior Consultant and Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 31 years of experience. His profile records urology, urological cancers and prostate artery embolization on the interventional radiology side.

His list spans adult and paediatric work. The cancer work covers radical prostatectomy and radical cystectomy. The general urology covers kidney transplant surgery, kidney stone surgery, laser prostate surgery, urinary incontinence and sling surgery for it. The paediatric work covers hypospadias repair, vesicoureteral reflux and pediatric urological reconstruction.

His qualifications are dated across fifteen years. He read MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal in 1991, took his MS in general surgery at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh, in 1996, his MCh in genito urinary surgery at Osmania Medical College under NTR University of Health Sciences in 1999 and a DNB in the same subject from the National Board of Examinations in 2000. He became a Fellow of the European Board of Urology in 2006.

His paediatric urology standing is recorded in teaching rather than prizes. He has been invited as faculty at Cincinnati Children's Hospital in Ohio and at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, is a proctor for pediatric robotic surgery, and was national convener for pediatric urology at the USI from 2012 to 2014.

He was President of the Association of Southern Urologists in 2020 and President of the Society of Genito Urinary Surgeons of AP and Telangana in 2019, and was its honorary secretary for two terms. He sits on the Governing Council of the Urological Society of India and of Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences, was organising secretary of USICON at Hyderabad in 2016, and is an editorial board member of the Indian Journal of Urology.

dr-devpriya-mitra.bio:
Dr. Devpriya Mitra is a Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 16 years of experience. His profile records urology together with urological cancers.

His list is broad general urology. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, bladder stone surgery and ureteroscopy. The prostate and outflow work covers BPH or enlarged prostate, laser prostate surgery and overactive bladder. The reconstructive work covers urethroplasty and hypospadias repair, and he also performs kidney transplant surgery, hydrocele and varicocele surgery, adult circumcision and vasectomy.

He read MBBS at Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences in Bangalore, took his MS in general surgery at S N Medical College in Agra and his DrNB in urology at BLK MAX Superspeciality Hospital in New Delhi. He is a Fellow of the European Board of Urology.

His research follows two of the operations on his list. He has studied erectile dysfunction as a consequence of urethroplasty in a prospective observational study, and the correlation between multi-parametric MRI prostate findings and TRUS guided prostate biopsy results in patients with raised serum PSA. A third study examines the surgical transversus abdominis plane block in abdominal surgeries.

He took first prize in the moderated podium session at NZUSICON 2020, gave a podium presentation at USICON 2019 in Kochi and a poster at NZUSICON 2019 in Greater Noida.

Besides Sarvodaya Hospital he has worked at BLK MAX, Indraprastha Apollo, Rajiv Gandhi Superspeciality and PSRI hospitals in New Delhi, Marengo Asia Hospital in Faridabad, S N Medical College in Agra and Sharda Institute of Medical Sciences.

dr-y-m-prashanth.bio:
Dr. Y.M. Prashanth is a Consultant Urologist, Uro-Oncologist, Andrologist and Robotic Surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list covers stones, prostate and reconstruction. He performs kidney stone surgery and ESWL, laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate, urethroplasty, hypospadias repair, urinary tract reconstruction and kidney transplant surgery.

He read M.B.B.S. at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad and took his M.S. in general surgery at the Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh, then both his M.Ch. and DNB in urology at Vardhaman Mahavir Medical College and Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi. He is a member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences and a Fellow in Minimal Access Surgery of AMASI, and has a fellowship in advanced clinical training in laparoscopic and robotic surgeries. Two short courses at IMMAST in Mumbai cover RIRS and reconstructive urology, the second matching the urethroplasty and reconstruction entries on his list.

He was a BOE–USI international travel fellow with BAUS-UK, placing fifth in the all-India ranking, and took the fellowship in 2019.

His conference record is recent and consistent. He won first prize for a poster at DUSCON 2019 in Delhi and the DUSCON Achievers Award in 2020, best poster at USICON 2021 and second prize for best video at NZUSICON 2021. He was a core committee member for the URO Oncology and Neuro Urology Masterclass at Safdarjung Hospital across 2018 and 2019.

dr-srikanth-munna.bio:
Dr. Srikanth Munna is a Consultant Andrologist and Urologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 9 years of experience. His profile records urology together with male infertility and andrology.

His list is general urology with a paediatric strand. He performs kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and pediatric kidney stone surgery, laser prostate surgery and treatment of BPH or enlarged prostate, urinary incontinence and sling surgery for it, and pediatric urological reconstruction.

He read MBBS at Guntur Medical College, took his DNB in general surgery at Delhi and his MCh in urology at Osmania Medical College. His andrology training is the distinct part of the record: a master's in male fertility taken in the USA, together with specialised training in penile implants and artificial urinary sphincter.

His student record is two gold medals from two universities. He was university topper with the gold medal in general surgery at NTR University and took the top gold medal in urology at KNR University. In 2023 he received the APJ Abdul Kalam Excellence Award for best andrologist and urologist.

His memberships match the andrology half of his practice as much as the urology: the Urological Society of India, the International Sexual and Men's Health Society and the International Council for Sex Education and Parenthood.

Besides KIIMS Hospital in Secunderabad he has worked at St. Stephen's and Safdarjung hospitals in Delhi, Osmania General Hospital, Tx Hospitals at Uppal and Kachiguda, ANDRO9 and V9 Hospitals, and Oasis Fertility in Hyderabad.

dr-narmada-prasad-gupta.bio:
Dr. Narmada Prasad Gupta is Professor Emeritus in the Division of Urology at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 47 years of experience. His profile records urology together with renal care.

His list is endourology and reconstruction. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, retrograde intrarenal surgery, bladder stone surgery and ureteric stone surgery. The prostate and outflow work covers laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate and bladder outlet obstruction surgery. The reconstructive work covers urethral stricture surgery, urethroplasty and urinary tract reconstruction, and he also performs kidney transplant surgery.

His qualifications run from M.B.B.S. and an M.S. in surgery through the M.Ch. in urology to a D.Sc., and he is a Fellow of the Academy of Medical Sciences.

His honours are national and he has led his specialty's societies. The Government of India awarded him the Padma Shri in 2007, and the Medical Council of India the Dr. B.C. Roy National Award in 2005. From the Urological Society of India he holds a certificate of commendation for excellence in urology from 1987, the Dr. Himadari Sarkar Memorial Oration of 2009, the Urology Gold Medal of the same year and a Life Time Achievement Award from its North Zone Chapter in 2010. He was President of the Urological Society of India in 2007 and of the Urological Society of Asia from 2008 to 2010, and national delegate and board member of the Société Internationale D'Urologie from 2004 to 2006.

He practises at Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram and at Medanta Mediclinic on Golf Course Road and at Defence Colony.

dr-m-gopichand.bio:
Dr. M. Gopichand is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 26 years of experience. His profile records urology together with urological cancers.

His list is endoscopic. He performs kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy and ureteroscopy, laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate for BPH or enlarged prostate, urethroplasty, and treats overactive bladder and recurrent UTI.

He read M.B.B.S. at V.S.S. Medical College in Burla, Sambalpur, Orissa, in 1996, and took his M.Ch. in urology and andrology at Bombay Hospital Institute of Medical Sciences in Mumbai between 1999 and 2002, with a DNB in urology from New Delhi.

The clearest figure in his record is volume: more than 10,000 endoscopic surgeries performed, including RIRS and HoLEP, which matches a list built almost entirely on endoscopic stone and prostate work. He is also a DNB teacher who has trained 15 students, and has published in international peer-reviewed journals including BJU International and the Journal of Laparoendoscopic and Advanced Surgical Techniques.

He is a former secretary of the Society of Genitourinary Surgeons of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, an active member of the Hyderabad Urology Society, and a member of the Urological Society of India, its South Zone chapter, the Robotic Urology Forum and the Society of Genitourinary Oncologists.

Besides Yashoda Hospitals he was at KIMS Hospital in Hyderabad from 2005 to 2025, and has worked at Ruia Hospital in Tirupati, Dr. Ramayya Urology Nephrology Institute and Hospitals, and Bollineni Hospital in Nellore.

dr-pradeep-rao.bio:
Dr. Pradeep Rao is Director and Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 34 years of experience. His profile records urology, uro-oncology and robotic surgery, and his listed procedures are kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy and ureteroscopy.

His qualifications are MBBS, the FRCS in surgery, MNAMS in general surgery and urology, the FICS in urology and a Diploma in Laparoscopic Urology.

Most of his further training was taken in a single year and each placement was with a different subspecialty. In July and August 2000 he was a visiting fellow in laparoscopic urology with Dr. Inderbir Gill at the Cleveland Clinic Foundation, in August 2000 a visiting fellow in reconstructive urology at the University of California, and in September 2000 a visiting fellow in pediatric urology with Dr. Warren Snodgrass at Southwestern Children's Hospital. He returned to laparoscopy the following year with training at EITS in December 2001.

His hospital history is unusual in being largely in the public system. Alongside Gleneagles Hospital at Parel he has been associated with Muljibhai Patel Urological Hospital and with five municipal general hospitals in Mumbai: Rajawadi, R.N. Cooper, L.T., Mulund and Sant Muktabai.

Taken together, a diploma and a course in laparoscopic urology, three overseas visiting fellowships and robotic surgery as a listed specialty describe a practice built on minimal access technique rather than open surgery.

dr-sandeep-guleria.bio:
Dr. Sandeep Guleria is a Transplant Specialist Surgeon at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 33 years of experience. His profile records the kidney transplant side of urology together with nephrology.

His list is transplantation. He performs kidney transplant surgery, living donor and deceased donor kidney transplant and ABO-incompatible kidney transplant, and also treats vesicoureteral reflux.

His qualifications include four separate Royal College fellowships. After MBBS, an MS and a DNB he took the FRCS of England, of Edinburgh and of Glasgow, and the FRCP of Edinburgh, and is a member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences. Holding both surgical and physician fellowships is unusual and sits with the two specialties recorded on his profile.

His record is built on programmes established rather than individual operations. At AIIMS he set up the paediatric transplant unit and established the laparoscopic donor nephrectomy programme. The Government of Nepal invited him to establish the renal transplant programme at Bir Hospital in Kathmandu, where he trained the surgical team and performed the first two successful renal transplants, and he continues to mentor that programme.

Besides Apollo Hospitals and Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals in Delhi he has been associated with AIIMS in the same city and with St. James's University Hospital in Leeds, U.K.

dr-p-v-g-s-prasad.bio:
Dr. P.V.G.S. Prasad is Senior Consultant Urologist, Andrologist, Robotic and Renal Transplant Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records urology together with urological cancers.

His list covers stones, prostate, transplantation and reconstruction. The stone work runs to kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery. The prostate work covers laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate. On the transplant side he performs kidney transplant surgery and living donor kidney transplant, and his reconstructive work covers urethroplasty, urinary incontinence and pediatric urological reconstruction.

All three of his degrees were taken in his own state. He read MBBS at Kurnool Medical College and took his MS in general surgery at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad, both under Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences, then his MCh in urology at Nizams Institute of Medical Sciences in the same city.

His record is unusually full of examination placings. He took 121st rank in APEAMCET in 2000, 68th state rank in the SOCRATES Academic Talent Search Exam, 54th rank in the APPG exam and second state rank in NIMSET in 2013, which is the entrance for the institute where he took his MCh. He also won first prize in the Surgi Quiz at APASICON 2010, and received an APJ Abdul Kalam Excellency Appreciation Award in 2023.

He belongs to the Urological Society of India, the Association of Southern Urologists, the Society of Genito Urinary Surgeons for AP and TS, and the Hyderabad Urological Society, and also practises at KIMS-Sunshine Hospital in Secunderabad.

dr-anil-mandhani.bio:
Dr. Anil Mandhani is Chairman of Urology at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 35 years of experience. His profile records urology together with kidney transplant work on the nephrology side.

His list divides between transplantation and cancer. The transplant half covers kidney transplant surgery, living donor and deceased donor transplant and ABO-incompatible kidney transplant. The cancer half covers radical prostatectomy, radical cystectomy, kidney cancer surgery and bladder cancer surgery. He also performs kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, laser prostate surgery and urethral stricture surgery.

After MBBS, an MS in surgery, the M.Ch. in urology and a DNB in urology, he took a fellowship in robotic surgery at the Institute of Robotic Surgery, Brady Urology Center, NYP Weill Medical College of Cornell University in New York, and a clinical fellowship in robotic uro-oncology at New York Presbyterian Hospital across 2006 and 2007.

His awards follow his research. He took a best paper award for prediction of fragility of stone by DEXA at the National Conference of Urology in 2003, and an Innovation Award from the Urological Society of India for an endopyelotomy sheath, a new device to facilitate antegrade endopyelotomy. At DUSUCON he won best clinical work on PSA characteristics in prostate cancer in 2013 and the North Zone Urological Society of India award for best research work in 2014. The Journal of Urology named him best reviewer in 2017.

He became a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons in 2012, having held its International Guest Scholarship in 2010, and practises at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurgaon.

dr-mrigank-shekhar-jha.bio:
Dr. Mrigank Shekhar Jha is a Director at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records urology together with kidney transplant work on the nephrology side.

His list is stone work, prostate work and reconstruction. The stone half covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and ESWL. The prostate half covers laser prostate surgery and BPH or enlarged prostate. He also performs kidney transplant surgery and living donor kidney transplant, urethroplasty and urinary tract reconstruction, varicocele surgery and kidney cancer surgery.

His training moved across three cities. He read MBBS at Ranchi Institute of Medical Sciences, took his MS in general surgery at Lady Hardinge Medical College in New Delhi and his MCh in urology at SGPGIMS, Lucknow.

His prizes are for operative video, which suits a practice built on endoscopic and reconstructive technique. In 2007 he took first position in the best video competition at USICON and second position at NZ-USICON. He was also awarded second position in MBBS.

His hospital history is almost entirely in the capital. Besides Max Healthcare he has been associated with Moolchand Hospital, Primus Super Speciality Hospital, Aakash Healthcare and Super Speciality Hospital, Venkateshwar Hospital, PSRI Hospital and Batra Hospital and Medical Research Centre, all in New Delhi, and with Fortis Hospital in Noida.

dr-karandeep-guleria.bio:
Dr. Karandeep Guleria is a Consultant at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list divides evenly between cancer and general work. The cancer half covers kidney cancer surgery, bladder cancer surgery and prostate cancer surgery, with radical prostatectomy and radical cystectomy as the operations. The general half covers kidney transplant surgery and living donor kidney transplant, kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy, laser prostate surgery and urethroplasty.

His training is dated at roughly three-year intervals. He read MBBS at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences in Kochi in 2012, took his MS in general surgery at Indira Gandhi Medical College in Shimla in 2018 and his MCh in urology and renal transplant at ABVIMS and RML Hospital in New Delhi in 2022, then a fellowship in uro-oncology and robotic surgery with the Vattikuti Foundation in Detroit, Michigan, in 2023.

His conference record is recent and international. In 2023 he took the KDAH first prize at the 5th Robotic Urology Forum Congress, a best poster award at the 43rd World Congress of SIU in Istanbul, and an ESMO Asia travelling fellowship, and he held SIU trainee travel scholarships to Montreal and Istanbul in 2022 and 2023. He won the Agra best video award at NZUSICON in Gurugram in 2024 and Delhi Urology Society Achievers Awards in 2021 and 2023.

His published work covers trends in organ donation and awareness in Ernakulam, Kerala, in BMC Proceedings in 2012, and a randomized prospective comparison of ventral and dorsal onlay urethroplasty in female urethral stricture in the Journal of Urology in 2021.

dr-gaurav-garg.bio:
Dr. Gaurav Garg is a Principal Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records urology, robotic surgery and andrology.

His list is broad general urology with paediatric and andrological strands. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy, bladder stone surgery and pediatric kidney stone surgery. The prostate and bladder work covers BPH or enlarged prostate, laser prostate surgery and overactive bladder. The andrology and men's health work covers hydrocele and varicocele surgery, vasectomy and adult circumcision, and the paediatric work extends to pediatric urinary tract surgery and vesicoureteral reflux, with urethroplasty alongside them.

His training is dated and each stage was taken at a different institution. He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in New Delhi in 2010, took his MS in general surgery at the University College of Medical Sciences in the same city in 2015 and his MCh in urology at King George's Medical University in Lucknow in 2019. Three further trainings match three parts of his list: paediatric urology at Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Lucknow in 2019, NSV and vas recanalisation at the Centre of Excellence for NSV at King George's Medical University the same year, and male infertility and sexual health at Muljibhai Patel Urological Hospital in Nadiad in 2023.

He took All India Rank 1 in the AIDMMCh entrance examination in 2016, first prize in the moderated poster session at NZUSICON in Meerut in 2017 and second prize in the inter-institutional quiz at Ludhiana in 2018. He has more than 50 publications and more than 80 peer reviews in indexed urology journals.

dr-rohit-chauhan.bio:
Dr. Rohit Chauhan is an Associate Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list is stone and prostate work. He performs kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ESWL, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery, laser prostate surgery and treatment of BPH or enlarged prostate and recurrent UTI, and on the transplant side kidney transplant surgery and deceased donor kidney transplant.

He read MBBS and completed his internship at UCMS and GTB Hospital in Delhi, took his MS in general surgery at ABVIMS and Dr. RML Hospital as a gold medalist, and his MCh in urology at PGIMER, Chandigarh. He holds a USI International Travelling Fellowship awarded in 2025.

His presented work is the largest part of his record and each entry names its subject. At USICON 2025 in Chennai he took first prize in the best paper category for a prospective study on the association between the urinary microbiome and stages of urothelial carcinoma of bladder, the best video category for robotic-assisted partial nephrectomy for an endophytic renal tumor, and gave a moderated poster on rare neuroendocrine prostate cancer with penile metastasis. Earlier he won first prize at ANDROCON 2023 in New Delhi on preoperative predictors during microsurgical vaso-epididymal anastomosis in obstructive azoospermia, and first prize at NZUSICON 2023 in Varanasi on combined multi-parametric MRI and PSMA-PET CT in diagnosing localized prostate cancer. He presented a video at KTCON 2024 in Bhubaneshwar on percutaneous nephrolithotomy in a dual kidney deceased donor transplant, and took third prize in the Androcon quiz in Mumbai in 2025.

dr-rajiv-yadav.bio:
Dr. Rajiv Yadav is Vice Chairman of the Department of Urology, Uro-Oncology, Robotics and Renal Transplant at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list is largely robotic cancer surgery. He performs robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy, robotic partial and radical nephrectomy for kidney cancer, and robotic-assisted radical cystectomy for bladder cancer. Alongside it he performs kidney transplant surgery from living and deceased donors and ABO-incompatible kidney transplant, transurethral resection of prostate, urethroplasty for urethral stricture and kidney stone surgery.

He took both his MS in surgery and his MCh in urology at AIIMS, New Delhi, where he won a gold medal, and also holds a DNB in urology and MNAMS. His two overseas fellowships are in the techniques that head his list: robotic surgery at the University of Southern California, and uro-oncology and laparoscopic urology at Henry Ford Hospital, both in the USA.

His awards are for research and operative video. He has taken the Urological Society of India best research paper award in multiple years, best video awards at national urological conferences, and first prize at the Indian American Urological Association and scientific session awards.

He is an active member of the Urological Society of India, the American Urological Association, the Society of Robotic Surgery, the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation and the International Society of Urology, a membership list that covers the robotic, oncological and transplant arms of his departmental title.

dr-francis-sridhar-katumalla.bio:
Dr. Francis Sridhar Katumalla is a Consultant Urologist, Andrologist, Kidney Transplant Surgeon and Robotic Surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Kondapur, in Hyderabad, with more than 29 years of experience. His profile records urology together with urological cancers.

His list covers stones, prostate and transplantation. The stone work runs to kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery. The prostate work covers transurethral resection of prostate, laser prostate surgery and BPH or enlarged prostate. He also performs kidney transplant surgery, living donor kidney transplant and urethroplasty.

All three of his degrees were taken at Christian Medical College. He read MBBS under Punjab University between 1993 and 1998, took his MS in general surgery at CMC Ludhiana under Baba Farid University of Health Sciences between 2001 and 2004, and his MCh in urology at CMC Vellore under MGR University between 2008 and 2011.

He collected medals at both ends of that training. He won the Vipin Khanna Gold Medal as best intern of 1998, and at the end of his urology residency the Shri Shalivahan Singh Rawal Gold Medal as best outgoing urology resident of 2011 at CMC Vellore, together with the Prof. A Rajasekaran Gold Medal in MCh urology for securing the highest marks in Dr. MGR Medical University that year.

His other recognition includes the Prof. C.L. Ashok Kumar Medal best poster prize at SZ – USICON 2005, first prize in the radiology quiz at SZ – USICON 2010, an international travel fellowship to BAUS Manchester in 2010, and selection as Upcoming Young Urologist from India jointly by the Urological Society of India and the European Urological Society in March 2013.

dr-pradeep-kumar-bansal.bio:
Dr. Pradeep Kumar Bansal is Senior Director of Urology, Uro-oncology, Robotics and Renal Transplant at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience in urology.

His list runs from transplantation through endourology to reconstruction. He performs kidney transplant surgery from living and deceased donors. His stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, retrograde intrarenal surgery and ureteroscopy. His prostate work covers laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate, and his reconstructive work urethral stricture surgery, urethroplasty and pediatric urological reconstruction.

He read MBBS and took his MS in general surgery at King George's Medical College in Lucknow, then his MCh in urology at Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences in the same city.

His undergraduate record at the University of Lucknow is a long run of distinctions. He took a certificate of honor in biochemistry and honors in physiology, pathology, microbiology, social and preventive medicine, pharmacology, forensic medicine, medicine and pediatrics, and ophthalmology, together with a silver medal and certificate of honor in the S.S. Khan dissection competition at KGMC.

His conference record centres on a single meeting. At the North Zone Urological Society of India conference at Udaipur in October 2001 he took the best paper award for a critical appraisal of techniques in substitution urethroplasty for anterior urethral strictures, and both first and second prize in the urology quiz for trainees. He participated again at Udaipur in October 2002.

He now practises at Fortis Hospital in Gurgaon, and has previously worked at Artemis Hospital and Max Hospital.

dr-ritesh-mongha.bio:
Dr. Ritesh Mongha is Clinical Director and Head of Urology, Uro-Oncology and Renal Transplant at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list covers transplantation, stones and prostate work: kidney transplant surgery from living and deceased donors, kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy, laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate.

His four qualifications were taken at four institutions. He read MBBS at Nalanda Medical College in Patna, took his MS in general surgery at the Institute of Medical Sciences in Varanasi and a DNB in general surgery from the National Academy of Medical Sciences in New Delhi, then his MCh in urology at IPGMER in Kolkata.

His record is given almost entirely in case volumes, and they set out the shape of the practice more precisely than a procedure list. He has performed more than 700 renal transplants including complex multi-vessel cases, and more than 700 laparoscopic donor nephrectomies. On the endoscopic side he has carried out more than 20,000 endourological procedures including PCNL, URS, TURP and TURBT, more than 1,000 laser prostate surgeries and more than 1,000 RIRS procedures. His cancer work runs to more than 500 major uro-oncological surgeries including radical nephrectomy, prostatectomy, adrenalectomy and cystectomy.

His record also notes expertise in robotic-assisted surgery for prostate, kidney and bladder cancers, and recognition for penile implant surgery, reconstructive urology and male infertility management.

dr-koushik-amancharla.bio:
Dr. Koushik Amancharla is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records urology, urological cancers and prostate artery embolization on the interventional radiology side.

His list is prostate and bladder work with stone surgery alongside. He performs laser prostate surgery and treats BPH or enlarged prostate, kidney stone surgery and ureteroscopy, urethroplasty, adult circumcision, and manages overactive bladder and urinary incontinence.

His training is recorded to the month. He read M.B.B.S. at GSL Medical College in Rajahmundry between Oct 2005 and Jun 2011, took his M.S. in general surgery at the Indian Navy Hospital in Mumbai between Jun 2013 and May 2016, and his M.Ch. in urology at NIMS, Hyderabad, between Aug 2017 and Sep 2020, having topped the NIMS entrance examination in 2017. He is a Da Vinci certified robotic surgeon in advanced urological procedures.

His record puts numbers to both his operating and his teaching: over 10,000 surgeries across 14 years, and more than 2,000 doctors trained across India, and he is a co-founder of VISE Academy. He is also a national-level swimming medalist.

His presented work covers renal cancer and adrenal tumors at the 30th SOGUS meeting in 2018, reconstructive surgery at the 74th ASICON in 2014 and a poster on type III duodenal atresia in 2015.

Besides Yashoda Hospitals he has worked at Andhra Hospitals in Vijayawada and Medicover Hospital at Hitec City, Hyderabad.

dr-g-madhusudhan-reddy.bio:
Dr. G. Madhusudhan Reddy is a Senior Consultant Renal Transplant Surgeon and Urologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

Transplantation heads his list. He performs kidney transplant surgery and living donor and deceased donor kidney transplant. The rest divides between stone work, with percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and kidney stone surgery, prostate work, with transurethral resection of prostate and laser prostate surgery, and reconstruction, with urethroplasty, hypospadias repair and urinary tract reconstruction.

His three degrees were taken at three institutions in two cities. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad, took his MS in general surgery at PGIMER, Chandigarh, and his M.Ch. in urology at NIMS in Hyderabad.

His hospital history covers the public and private sectors in both the capital and his own state. In Delhi he has worked at AIIMS and at VMMC and Safdarjung Hospital. In Hyderabad he has been at NIMS where he trained, at ESIC Hospital and Medical College in Sanathnagar, and at CARE Hospital and Medicover Hospital, before his present post at Yashoda Hospitals in Somajiguda.

He is a member of the Urological Society of India, the Society of Genitourinary Surgeons and the Association of Southern Urologists, the second and third of which are the state and regional bodies for his specialty.

dr-likhiteswer-pallagani.bio:
Dr. Likhiteswer Pallagani is a Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list is stone and prostate work. He performs kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery, laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate for BPH or enlarged prostate, and treats overactive bladder.

His training is dated across sixteen years and each stage was taken at a different institution. He read MBBS at Mamatha Medical College in Khammam between 2006 and 2012, took his MS in general surgery at Gandhi Medical College in Secunderabad between 2013 and 2016, and his MCh in urology at AIIMS, Jodhpur, between 2018 and 2021. His fellowship in uro-oncology and robotic surgery was awarded by the Vattikuti Foundation in MI and taken from AINU, Hyderabad, across 2021 and 2022.

His hospital history runs between Hyderabad and Delhi. Besides KIMS Hospital in Secunderabad he has worked at Yashoda Hospitals in Somajiguda and ESIC Super Speciality Hospital in Sanathnagar, both in Hyderabad, at Max Superspeciality Hospital in Saket, Delhi, and at AIIMS, Jodhpur, where he trained.

He is a member of the Urological Society of India, the Association of Southern Urologist, the Society of Genito-urinary Surgeons and the Association of Surgeons of India, covering his specialty at national, regional and general surgical level.

dr-anupam-bhargava.bio:
Dr. Anupam Bhargava is Chairman of Urology at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 47 years of experience.

His list is broad general urology. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy, bladder stone surgery and ESWL. The prostate and bladder work covers BPH or enlarged prostate, laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate and overactive bladder. The reconstructive and men's health work covers urethroplasty, urinary tract reconstruction, hypospadias repair, hydrocele and varicocele surgery, vasectomy and adult circumcision.

He graduated and took his postgraduation at Gwalior Medical College. Most of his further training was taken abroad, beginning with training in urology at Vienna and Munich between 1979 and 1980. He then took a special intensive course in endoscopic urology at the Technical University of Munich under Professor Wolf Mauermayer across 1982 and 1983, and postgraduate training in the Department of Urology at Allg. Polliklinik in Vienna from October 1982 to June 1983. He returned to Vienna in 1987 for six weeks of intensive training in ESWL at the Rudolf Hospital, which corresponds to the lithotripsy entry on his list.

His hospital record includes a hospital of his own: he founded North Point Hospital Pvt Ltd and ran it from 1992 to 2012. He has also worked at Saket City Hospital, Adiva Super Speciality Care and Northern Railway Central Hospital, and abroad at King Fahad Hospital in Saudi Arabia, before his present post with Max Healthcare.

dr-nand-kumar-madhekar.bio:
Dr. Nand Kumar Madhekar is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 21 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list covers stones, prostate, reconstruction and children. The stone work runs to kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and pediatric kidney stone surgery. The prostate work covers laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate. The reconstructive work covers urethroplasty and hypospadias repair, and he also performs kidney transplant surgery and treats overactive bladder and urinary incontinence.

His training is dated across nineteen years. He read M.B.B.S. at M.R. Medical College under Gulbarga University between 1984 and 1989 and took his M.S. in general surgery at the same college between 1991 and 1994, then his M.Ch in genito-urinary surgery at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad between 2000 and 2003.

His memberships cover his own specialty and the two broader surgical bodies: the Urological Society of India and the Andrology Society of India alongside the Association of Surgeons of India and the Indian Medical Association.

His hospital history stays in Hyderabad. Besides Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad he has been associated with Prime Hospitals, Yashoda Hospitals in Hyderabad, Ramayya's Pramila Hospitals and Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, where he took his superspecialty degree.

dr-nitesh-jain.bio:
Dr. Nitesh Jain is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospital, Chennai, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records urology together with urological cancers.

His list is endourology and reconstruction. He performs kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy and ureteroscopy, transurethral resection of prostate and laser prostate surgery for BPH or enlarged prostate, and on the reconstructive side urethroplasty and hypospadias repair, with management of urinary incontinence alongside them.

His examination record is a run of firsts. He passed with distinction in the first, second and third parts of MBBS, came first in the university in surgery, and first in the university in M.Ch urology.

His presented work is almost entirely laparoscopic, which is notable given how much of his listed practice is endoscopic. He has worked on laparoscopic seminal vesical sparing radical prostatectomy using a low energy source, reporting better continence and potency. At the Asian Congress of Urology in New Delhi in 2008 he presented laparoscopic radical cystectomy with extracorporeal urinary diversion, and a laparoscopic approach for the repair of lower ureteric injuries due to gynecological surgeries. At USICON in Agra in 2010 he reported a series of 218 cases of retroperitoneal ureterolithotomy performed over nine years, which is the stone surgery on his list carried out by an open retroperitoneal route.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals on Greams Road and at Apollo Firstmed Hospital, both in Chennai.

dr-gagan-gautam.bio:
Dr. Gagan Gautam is Chairman of Urology and Renal Care at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in urology.

His list is weighted towards cancer. He performs radical prostatectomy and prostate cancer surgery, kidney cancer surgery, radical cystectomy and bladder cancer surgery, and testicular cancer surgery. The general urology alongside it covers kidney stone surgery and percutaneous nephrolithotomy, laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate, bladder outlet obstruction surgery and urinary tract reconstruction.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS and a DNB in general surgery and the M.Ch in urology, followed by a clinical fellowship in minimally invasive urology.

His awards begin before his superspecialty training. He took the best podium presentation at the 6th annual conference of the American College of Surgeons, India Chapter, in 2002. At USICON 2006 he won both the CKP Menon Award for the best original research presentation and the Chandigarh Prize for best video presentation at the Urological Society of India's national conference, and he has also received the Agra Award for the best presentation at a zonal Urological Society of India conference. In 2018 Max Healthcare gave him its CEO Award.

Taking the research prize and the video prize at the same national meeting points to a record built on both published work and operative technique, which is consistent with a minimally invasive fellowship and a cancer-led operating list.

dr-anjani-kumar-agrawal.bio:
Dr. Anjani Kumar Agrawal is Senior Director of Andrology and Urology at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 34 years of experience in urology.

His list is prostate, stone and andrological work. He performs laser prostate surgery and transurethral resection of prostate for BPH or enlarged prostate, kidney stone surgery and bladder stone surgery, and treats overactive bladder. The andrology side of his title is represented by varicocele surgery and vasectomy.

His three degrees are dated at five-year intervals. He read MBBS at Patna University in 1987, took his MS in surgery at AIIMS, New Delhi, in 1992 and his M.Ch in urology at the same institution in 1997. He is certified in Da Vinci system training for robotic surgery.

His hospital history runs from the teaching hospitals where he trained to the stone and research institutes that match his listed practice. Besides Max Healthcare and Max Super Speciality Hospital at Saket he has been associated with the Pushpawati Singhania Research Institute and the RG Stone Urological Research Institute in New Delhi, Escorts Hospital and Research Center in Faridabad, and AIIMS in New Delhi and Patna Medical College where he studied.

The pairing of andrology with urology in his departmental title, alongside a list that covers both the prostate and the scrotum, describes a practice that treats men's urological and reproductive complaints in the same service.

dr-vijay-kumar-1.bio:
Dr. Vijay Kumar is Senior Director of Reconstructive and Laparoscopic Urology at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 29 years of experience. His profile records urology together with reconstructive and laparoscopic urology.

His list is broad general urology. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery. The prostate and bladder work covers BPH or enlarged prostate, laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate and overactive bladder. The reconstructive and men's health work covers urethroplasty, vesicoureteral reflux, hydrocele and varicocele surgery and vasectomy.

His four qualifications are dated at roughly three-year intervals. He read MBBS at Sarojini Naidu Medical College in Agra in 1990 and took his MS in surgery at the same college in 1993, then a DNB in surgery at New Delhi in 1994 and a DNB in urology at the Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Medical Sciences in Puttaparthi in 1997.

His hospital history is recorded with dates and runs in an unbroken line. He was at the Sri Sathya Sai Institute from 1995 to 1998, then North Point Hospital in New Delhi from 1998 to 2012, Adiva Super Speciality Care from 2012 to 2015, and Max Smart Superspeciality Hospital at Saket from 2015 onwards. He has also worked at Max Multi Speciality Centre in Panchsheel Park and as a visiting consultant at Northern Railway Central Hospital, both in New Delhi.

dr-vijay-sharma.bio:
Dr. Vijay Sharma is Senior Consultant and Head of Unit II of Urology at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list has an unusually strong paediatric component. He performs pediatric kidney stone surgery, pediatric urinary tract surgery, correction of congenital urological anomalies and hypospadias repair, alongside kidney stone surgery, ureteroscopy, bladder stone surgery and management of recurrent UTI.

His three degrees were taken at three universities. He read MBBS at Pt. B.D. Sharma University in Rohtak, took his MS in general surgery at Dr. R.M.L. Avadh University in Faizabad and his MCh in urology and renal transplant at Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Lucknow.

He was a gold medalist in both his MS in general surgery and his MCh in urology, so the distinction was repeated at each stage of his surgical training, and he has received a best paper award from the Indian Journal of Urology.

He is a member of the Urological Society of India and of the North Zone Urological Society.

Before his present appointment he was an assistant professor at Dr. R.M.L. Hospital and a senior consultant in urology at R.G. Stone Hospital and at Sharda Hospital.

dr-jitendra-jagtap.bio:
Dr. Jitendra Jagtap is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 21 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list is endoscopic stone and prostate work. He performs kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery, and laser prostate surgery for BPH or enlarged prostate.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and a DNB in urology, followed by two fellowships that correspond to the two halves of a modern urology practice: one in endo urology, which matches the stone and prostate work on his list, and one in laparoscopy and robotic surgery.

His record is a run of examination and competition results. He stood second in the MS general surgery final examination and first in the GPSC exam for Assistant Professor of Surgery. He then held two travelling fellowships in successive conference years, the Eagle Traveling Fellowship at WZUSICON 2009 through the Department of Urology at AIIMS, New Delhi, and the Olympus USI International Traveling Fellowship at USICON 2011 in Kolkata. In 2012 he won first prize in the national UROQUIZ at USICON in Bangalore.

Read in order, those results follow the same path as his qualifications. The MS placing and the GPSC rank belong to his general surgical years, the two travelling fellowships to the period after his DNB in urology, and the quiz win to his time as a consultant. The two fellowships that follow, in endo urology and in laparoscopy and robotic surgery, are what distinguish the practice he now runs.

He practises at Gleneagles Hospital at Parel in Mumbai.

dr-sanish-shrikant-shringarpure.bio:
Dr. Sanish Shrikant Shringarpure is a Consultant Urologist, Andrologist and Kidney Transplant Surgeon at Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records urology together with male infertility.

His list is described in his record with the technique attached to each entry, which sets out how he operates rather than only what he treats. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy including retrograde intrarenal surgery, laser treatment of bladder stones and ESWL for ureteric stones. The prostate work is endoscopic laser treatment for BPH or enlarged prostate. The andrology work covers microscopic varicocelectomy and treatment of male infertility disorders. He also performs kidney transplant surgery and manages recurrent UTI and other urinary tract disorders.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and a DNB in urology. He received an international travelling fellowship from the Urological Society of India in 2009, and is a member of the Indian Urological Society and the South Zone Urology Association.

His hospital history runs down the west coast and across to Chennai. Besides Medicover Hospital at Kharghar in Navi Mumbai he has worked at Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai and at Fortis Hiranandani Hospital in Vashi, at Aster Adhar Hospital in Kolhapur, and at Apollo Hospitals in Chennai.

dr-amit-singh-malhotra.bio:
Dr. Amit Singh Malhotra is Associate Director of Urology, Kidney Transplant and Robotic Surgery at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records urology together with urological cancers.

His list is one of the longest in this specialty. The transplant work covers kidney transplant surgery, living donor and deceased donor transplant and ABO-incompatible kidney transplant. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, ureteroscopy, bladder stone surgery and pediatric kidney stone surgery. The prostate and bladder work covers BPH or enlarged prostate, laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate, overactive bladder and urinary incontinence. He also performs urinary tract reconstruction, pediatric urinary tract surgery, varicocele surgery, vasectomy and adult circumcision.

His training is dated and was taken in two cities. He read MBBS at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal between 1997 and 2003, then took his DNB in general surgery at St. Stephen's Hospital in New Delhi between 2003 and 2006 and his DNB in urology at Batra Hospital and Medical Research Centre in the same city between 2008 and 2011.

He won a gold medal in DNB general surgery, awarded by the Honorable Former Home Minister of India, Mr. Shivraj Patil, and second prize in the oration contest in pathology and pharmacology at Manipal. His later prizes are for operative video: first prize at DUSCON 2018, first prize at the Agra Urological Club for best video at NZUSICON 2019, and second prize at DUSCON 2023.

dr-n-v-k-n-karthik.bio:
Dr. N. V. K. N. Karthik is a Consultant Kidney and Pancreas Transplant Surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 9 years of experience. His profile records kidney transplant on the urology side, pancreas transplant on the surgical gastroenterology side, and vascular surgery.

His list is transplantation alone: kidney transplant surgery from living and deceased donors.

His training is dated and most of it was taken at one institution. He read M.B.B.S at Gandhi Medical College under Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences between 2009 and 2014, winning the orthopedics gold medal in 2013. He then took his M.S. in general surgery at PGIMER, Chandigarh, between 2015 and 2018, and returned there for the M.Ch in renal and pancreas transplant surgery between 2022 and 2024, the qualification that matches his present post directly.

His presented work is recent and follows both halves of his transplant practice. At the ISOT term meet in 2023 he took third prize for an e-poster on a successful pregnancy outcome in a recipient of simultaneous pancreatic kidney transplantation. At TTS 2024 he received a mentor-mentee award for a prospective comparative study assessing the learning curve of trainee surgeons in hand-assisted against pure total laparoscopic donor nephrectomy.

He has four peer-reviewed publications and multiple oral and poster presentations at ASICON, ISOT and TTS conferences between 2019 and 2024, and is a lifetime member of the Association of Surgeons of India and the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation.

dr-rishikesh-velhal.bio:
Dr. Rishikesh Velhal is a Consultant Urologist at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 8 years of experience in urology.

His list is long for a surgeon at this stage. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, retrograde intrarenal surgery, ureteroscopy, ureteric stone surgery and bladder stone surgery. The prostate and outflow work covers laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate and bladder outlet obstruction surgery, and the reconstructive work urethral stricture surgery and urethroplasty. He also performs kidney transplant surgery and surgery for bladder, kidney and prostate cancer.

His five qualifications were taken in Mumbai and Pune. He read MBBS and took his MS in general surgery at Grant Medical College and Sir JJ Group of Hospitals in Mumbai, then his MCh in urology at B.J. Medical College in Pune. He also holds the FCPS in surgery and a DNB in genitourinary surgery.

His student record is concentrated in the early years of MBBS. He won the gold medal in biochemistry and took first rank in anatomy in his first year, and second rank in the first and second year finals.

He is a member of the Urological Society of India and of its Maharashtra chapter, and practises at Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai.

dr-vipin-arora.bio:
Dr. Vipin Arora is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 33 years of experience. His profile records urology together with pediatric urology.

His list is stone, prostate and reconstructive work. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy and bladder stone surgery. The prostate and outflow work covers laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate and bladder outlet obstruction surgery. The reconstructive work covers urethral stricture surgery and urethroplasty, and he also performs kidney transplant surgery.

His qualifications are unusual in being almost entirely from the UK after his Indian degrees. He holds MBBS and an MS, then the FRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh, a Diploma in Urology taken in England, and a further FRCS in urology from the Royal College of Surgeons. Holding both a general surgical fellowship and a urological one, alongside a separate diploma in the specialty, means his training was examined at three separate stages in the UK system.

He is a life member of the Urological Society of India and practises at Apollo Hospital in Delhi.

The pairing of adult and paediatric urology on his profile, with a list that runs from stone surgery through prostate work to urethral reconstruction, describes a general urology practice rather than one narrowed to a single organ or technique.

dr-tarang-preet-kaur.bio:
Dr. Tarang Preet Kaur is a Consultant at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 11 years of experience. Her profile records female urology and urogynaecology together with obstetrics and gynecology and cosmetic gynaecology.

Her list is the bladder rather than the operating range of general urology. She performs sling surgery for urinary incontinence and manages urinary incontinence, overactive bladder and recurrent UTI.

Her training is dated year by year and much of it was taken in the United Kingdom. She read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in Delhi in 2015 and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology at the same college in 2019. She then completed an international fellowship in urogynaecology at the Royal Albert Edward Infirmary in Greater Manchester, took the MRCOG of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in 2023 and an MCh in urogynaecology at Edge Hill University in 2024. Her fellowship in cosmetic gynaecology was taken at the Institute of Interventional Dermatology and Aesthetic Gynaecology in Jaipur in 2025.

Her recognition follows the same route between the two countries. She won a gold medal at the NARCHI conference in New Delhi in 2021, had work selected among the top 500 abstracts at the BJOG World Congress in 2022, and received the Best Student Award at Edge Hill University in 2024.

She practises at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in New Delhi.

dr-anant-kumar.bio:
Dr. Anant Kumar is Chairman of Urology, Renal Transplant and Robotics at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 40 years of experience. His profile records urology together with urological cancers.

His list follows the three arms of that title. The transplant work covers kidney transplant surgery from living and deceased donors and ABO-incompatible transplant. The robotic cancer work covers radical prostatectomy, radical cystectomy and robotic partial nephrectomy for kidney cancer. The endourology covers percutaneous nephrolithotomy, retrograde intrarenal surgery, ureteroscopy and HOLEP laser prostate surgery, with urinary tract reconstruction alongside them.

He read M.B.B.S at King George Medical University in Lucknow and took the rest of his training at PGIMER, Chandigarh: his M.S. in general surgery, his M.Ch in urology and a DNB in urology.

His academic record is the largest part of his profile. He has published over 180 papers in national and international journals, written several book chapters and invited reviews, and delivered many guest lectures at meetings and institutes.

He practises at Max Super Specialty Hospital at Saket in New Delhi and at Max Super Specialty Hospital in Vaishali.

A list in which robotic cancer surgery, transplantation and laser stone and prostate work all appear, held together by a chairmanship that names all three, describes a department built around minimally invasive technique across the whole specialty rather than in one part of it.

dr-sandesh-parab.bio:
Dr. Sandesh Parab is a Consultant Urologist, Andrologist and Renal Transplant Surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Thane, in Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list spans transplantation, children and reconstruction. He performs kidney transplant surgery and living donor kidney transplant, urethroplasty, kidney stone surgery and ureteroscopy, pediatric kidney stone surgery and pediatric urinary tract surgery, varicocele surgery, vasectomy, surgery for vesicoureteral reflux, transurethral resection of prostate, sling surgery for urinary incontinence, and management of incontinence and recurrent UTI.

His qualifications are an MS, a DNB in general surgery and an MCh in urology. He is a member of the Urology Society of India and of West Zone USI.

His published work is closely tied to the reconstructive half of his list and covers urethroplasty in detail. In the Turkish Journal of Urology in 2017 he asked whether the site of a buccal mucosa graft for bulbar urethral stricture affects outcome, comparing ventral, dorso-lateral and dorsal graft augmentation urethroplasty. In Urology Annals in Apr 2020 he reported the use of a gracillis muscle flap as a cover for a tubularised buccal mucosal graft in posterior urethral injury. His third paper, in the Journal of Pediatric Nephrology in May 2018, reports his experience of metabolic evaluation in pediatric urolithiasis, which matches the paediatric stone surgery on his list.

He practises at KIMS Hospital in Thane.

dr-lokendra-kumar-yadav-1.bio:
Dr. Lokendra Kumar Yadav is a Senior Consultant at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 8 years of experience. His profile records urology together with uro-oncology.

His list covers transplantation, prostate work and reconstruction. He performs kidney transplant surgery and living donor kidney transplant, laser prostate surgery for BPH or enlarged prostate, ureteroscopy, urethroplasty and adult circumcision.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS and the MCh super-specialty degree in urology.

His post at Marengo Asia Hospitals in Faridabad is recorded in full as Senior Consultant in Urology, Robotic Uro-Oncology and Kidney Transplantation, which names the robotic and cancer arms of his work alongside the transplant practice on his list.

His hospital history runs across three states and includes both teaching and private institutions. He has been associated with Metro Heart Institute with Multispeciality in Faridabad and Aakash Healthcare Super Speciality Hospital at Dwarka in New Delhi, with the World College of Medical Sciences and Research in Jhajjar and the Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Rohtak, both in Haryana, and with Shri Mahant Indiresh Hospital and the SGRR Institute of Medical and Health Sciences in Dehradun.

Taken together, a transplant and uro-oncology practice held at a senior consultant grade this early, across a set of attachments that includes two medical colleges, describes a career that has combined operating with academic institutions from the start.

dr-shafiq-ahmed.bio:
Dr. Shafiq Ahmed is Senior Director of Urology, Andrology and Renal Transplant at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in urology.

His list is among the longest in this specialty and divides into four groups. The transplant work covers kidney transplant surgery from living and deceased donors. The cancer work covers bladder, kidney and prostate cancer surgery, with radical cystectomy and radical prostatectomy as the operations. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, retrograde intrarenal surgery, ureteric stone surgery, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery. The prostate and reconstructive work covers laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate, urethral stricture surgery, urethroplasty and urinary tract reconstruction.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS, a DNB and MNAMS.

His hospital history is the widest part of his record and runs from Kashmir to the capital. He trained or worked at the Sher-I-Kashmir Institute of Medical Science in Srinagar and Christian Medical College and Hospital in Ludhiana, and has since been associated with the Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences in New Delhi, Dharmshila Cancer Hospital in Delhi, Manipal Hospital at Dwarka, and Naryana Superspeciality Hospital and Fortis Memorial and Research Institute in Gurgaon, before his present post at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in New Delhi.

A cancer hospital, a liver institute and a transplant-led departmental title together account for a list in which oncology and transplantation carry as much weight as general stone and prostate work.

dr-deepak-bolbandi.bio:
Dr. Deepak Bolbandi is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 18 years of experience in urology.

His list is endourology and reconstruction. The stone work covers kidney stone surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, retrograde intrarenal surgery, ureteric stone surgery, ureteroscopy and bladder stone surgery. The prostate and outflow work covers laser prostate surgery, transurethral resection of prostate and bladder outlet obstruction surgery. The reconstructive work covers urethral stricture surgery, urethroplasty and correction of congenital urological anomalies.

His qualifications are MBBS, an MS in general surgery and a DNB in urology and genito-urinary surgery.

His record notes 17 papers presented at scientific sessions at national and international conferences, and a scientific award and lecture for a leading implant company presentation. It also records that his innovations and techniques have been accepted into the Urology Guide, where they are used in day-to-day urology practice, which is an unusual entry and puts his contribution into routine use rather than only into the literature.

He is currently honorary secretary for the Bangalore Urological Society of the Urological Society of India and for Karnataka, and an associate member of the Singapore Urological Society.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals on Bannerghatta Road in Bangalore.

dr-mrudula-kuchekar.bio:
Dr. Mrudula Kuchekar is a Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 17 years of experience. Her profile records urology together with urogynaecology.

Her list reflects that pairing. The urogynaecological work covers urinary incontinence and sling surgery for it, overactive bladder and recurrent UTI. The urological work covers urethroplasty, percutaneous nephrolithotomy and ureteroscopy, so stone surgery and bladder function are handled in the same practice.

Her qualifications are MBBS, a DNB in general surgery and an MCh in urology.

Her record notes recognition for her expertise in minimally invasive urology, reconstructive urology and renal transplant surgery, and a strong reputation in the medical community for her commitment to patient care and advanced surgical techniques. Two of those three areas, the minimally invasive and the reconstructive, are directly represented on her procedure list by the endoscopic stone work and the urethroplasty.

She practises at Gleneagles Global Hospital at Parel and at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, and is associated with Advanced Urology Mumbai.

A consultant urologist whose listed specialties include urogynaecology, and whose procedures are weighted towards continence and the lower urinary tract rather than towards oncology or transplantation, describes a practice organised around bladder function in women alongside general endoscopic urology.

dr-tarush-rustagi.bio:
Dr. Tarush Rustagi is Senior Consultant in Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records spine surgery together with orthopedics.

His list covers the whole column. He performs spinal fusion surgery, microdiscectomy and endoscopic spine surgery, disc replacement surgery, spinal deformity correction, cervical and lumbar spine surgery, spinal tumor surgery and spinal trauma surgery, and treats spondylolisthesis and degenerative disc disease.

His fellowship training is the longest part of his record and most of it was taken in the United States. After MBBS, an MS and a DNB in orthopaedics, and ECFMG certification, he took a spine fellowship at the Spine Foundation in Mumbai, followed by a comprehensive two-year fellowship at the same institution. Three further one-year fellowships followed abroad: an accredited adult and pediatric spine fellowship at the State University of New York, a complex and minimally invasive spine fellowship at the Swedish Medical Center in Seattle, and a complex and spine tumor fellowship at Ohio State University and the James Cancer Center.

His academic record runs to more than 65 peer-reviewed scientific articles in international journals, cited over 1,000 times globally, together with book chapters and research presented at NASS and AO Spine.

He belongs to the North American Spine Society, AO Spine, the Indian Spinal Cord Society, the Delhi Spine Society, the Bombay Orthopaedic Society, the Delhi Orthopaedic Association and the Delhi Medical Association, and has worked at hospitals in Delhi, Noida, Mohali and Mumbai.

dr-suresh-cheekatla.bio:
Dr. Suresh Cheekatla is a Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records spine surgery together with orthopedics.

His list is broad degenerative and deformity work: cervical and lumbar spine surgery, discectomy and microdiscectomy, disc replacement surgery, endoscopic spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery, spinal stenosis surgery and spinal deformity correction, with cervical spondylosis, degenerative disc disease, slip disc, spondylolisthesis and spinal cord injury as the conditions behind them.

He read MBBS at Siddhartha Medical College in Vijayawada and took his DNB in orthopaedics at the Shadan Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Center in Hyderabad. Four spine fellowships follow, each in a different technique and country. He was a fellow in the Department of Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in New Delhi and an AO-Synthes fellow at the same centre, a SICOT fellow in deformity correction at Aarhus University Hospital in Denmark, and an IASA spine fellow in minimally invasive spine surgery at Mount Sinai Hospital in New York. He also took spine microsurgery training at Ganga Hospital in Coimbatore.

His awards are for research and came in three successive periods. In 2010 he received the VT Ingalhalikar Gold Medal from ASSI and OASIS and the OASIS Consultants Gold Medal for work on paediatric accommodative spinal cord shortening. In 2012 the Indian Orthopaedic Association gave him the SP Mandal Gold Medal for a paper on intraoperative scrape cytology of transpedicular biopsy of vertebral body lesions, and in 2014 ASSI its Young Investigators Award for research on trends in Indian spinal research.

dr-m-d-s-sasidharan.bio:
Dr. M D S Sasidharan is a Spine Surgeon at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 13 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list is wide for his years in practice. It covers endoscopic spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery and disc replacement surgery, spinal deformity correction, vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty, spinal tumor surgery and spinal trauma surgery, discectomy and microdiscectomy, cervical and lumbar spine surgery, and revision surgery for failed back surgery.

His training is dated year by year. He read MBBS under Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences between 2007 and 2013 and took his MS in orthopaedics at Chettinad University between 2014 and 2017, then training in spine surgery at Kasturba Medical College Hospital in Mangalore in 2019. His FASSI in spine surgery was taken at Apollo Hospitals, Chennai, between 2019 and 2021, alongside an AO Spine Asia Pacific fellowship at Ganga Hospitals in Coimbatore and a robotic and complex spine surgery fellowship at Apollo Main Hospitals, both in 2021. Deformity training in Seoul followed in 2022, and two endoscopic placements in Germany in 2023, at Schoen Klinik in Munich and St. Anna in Herne.

His teaching and speaking record is recent and local, with faculty roles at Apollo Hospitals Chennai in January 2020, at an instructional spine course in Mangalore in September 2019, at Gleneagles Health City in September 2023 and at a Chennai Ortho Spine Society osteoporosis programme in January 2024. He has given podium presentations at Global Spine Week 2023 in Melbourne, Global Spine Congress 2021 in Paris, ASSICON 2020 and the AO Spine Conference 2020, and published on endoscopic technique, robotic-guided TLIF and lumbar fusion outcomes.

dr-bsv-raju.bio:
Dr. BSV Raju is a Senior Consultant Neuro and Spine Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 29 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is spinal. He performs microdiscectomy and discectomy, endoscopic spine surgery, vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty, cervical spine surgery and spinal tumor surgery.

His qualifications are dated across sixteen years and take in both orthopaedics and neurosurgery. He read MBBS at Rangaraya Medical College in Kakinada in 1987, took his MS in orthopaedics at Andhra Medical College in Visakhapatnam and a DNB in orthopaedics from the National Board of Education, both in 1992, then his MCh at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad in 1995. Two American fellowships followed, at Wayne State University in Detroit in 2002 and at Stanford University in 2003.

His awards are civic and professional in roughly equal measure. He received the Acharya Sushrut Sadbhavana Puraskar in 2010 from the Indian Cultural Department of Society in Hyderabad, the Seva Ratna Award from the Mother Teresa Foundation in 2012, and in 2015 both a Best Doctor's Award from Health Care International and the Best Hyderabad Neuro and Spine Surgeon Award at the Global Healthcare Excellence Awards in New Delhi. He was also selected for Who is Who in the USA in 2003.

He belongs to the Neurological Society of India, the North American Spine Society, the Indian Society for Pediatric Neurosurgery, the Twin Cities Neuro Club, the Twin Cities Spine Club and the Indian Medical Association.

dr-ankur-nanda.bio:
Dr. Ankur Nanda is Associate Director of Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list covers the whole column and both ends of the operating range. He performs spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction, endoscopic spine surgery, cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine surgery, spinal tumor surgery and spinal trauma surgery, discectomy, laminectomy, spinal stenosis surgery, and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty.

He read MBBS at BJ Medical College in Ahmedabad and took his MS in orthopaedics at NHL Municipal Medical College in the same city, where he ranked first and received an academic excellence scholarship. He also holds an MBA in healthcare from Sikkim Manipal University. His two spine fellowships were taken abroad, in endoscopic spine surgery in Germany and in spine surgery at Seoul, South Korea, and he holds AO Spine basic, advanced and faculty education program certificates.

His published research covers pelvic obliquity in neuromuscular scoliosis in SPINE in 2010 and transpedicular percutaneous biopsy of vertebral body lesions in Spinal Cord in 2008. He won the gold medal best paper award in 2010 at the combined 49th International Spinal Cord Society, 10th Spinal Cord Society and 8th ASCoN annual scientific meeting in New Delhi.

A large part of his record is society office. He is ASSI Program Committee Chair and a past member of its executive committee, AO Spine fellowship officer and council member for the Indian subcontinent, an executive committee member of the Delhi Spine Society and a member of the Spinal Cord Society.

dr-neeraj-gupta-.bio:
Dr. Neeraj Gupta is Senior Consultant in Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list covers the whole column. He performs spinal fusion surgery, cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine surgery, disc replacement surgery, spinal deformity correction, microdiscectomy, laminectomy and discectomy, spinal trauma surgery and spinal tumor surgery, and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty.

His qualifications run from MBBS and a D.ORTHO through a DNB in orthopaedics to the FNB in spine surgery, with the MRCS parts I and II taken in the United Kingdom and a DTB from the National University Hospital in Singapore. Two further fellowships were taken abroad: an IASA spine fellowship at Michigan University Hospital in the USA, and a fellowship at St. Mary's Hospital in Seoul.

His published and presented work runs from general orthopaedics towards the spine.
