He presented a paper on surgical treatment of tumors of the spine at the National Surgical Update of the International College of Surgeons in 2004, and a case report on isolated tuberculosis of talus at the Asia Pacific Orthopaedic Association meet in Khajuraho. He took second prize in instructional course lectures at ICS 2014 in Udaipur, published a series of 119 cases of intraspinal anomalies in congenital scoliosis in the Asian Spine Journal, and co-authored a CME on radiographic evaluation of the lumbar spine for the Tamil Nadu Orthopaedic Association Journal.

He was organising secretary of Spine Update 2015, a national conference in Delhi NCR on minimal invasive spine surgery and spine deformity, and has worked at Ganga Hospital and at hospitals across Delhi NCR.

dr-hitesh-garg.bio:
Dr. Hitesh Garg is Head of the Spine Surgery Department at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list covers degenerative, deformity and revision work: cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery and disc replacement surgery, spinal deformity correction, spinal stenosis surgery, spinal tumor and trauma surgery, endoscopic spine surgery, treatment of spondylolisthesis, and revision surgery for failed back surgery.

He read MBBS and took his MS in orthopaedics at SMS Medical College in Jaipur. Four fellowships follow, in four countries: spine surgery at Christian Medical College Vellore, spine surgery at a university hospital in Germany, an AO Spine fellowship at a hospital in South Korea, and a fellowship at Thomas Jefferson University in Philadelphia. He also holds an Advanced Management Program in Healthcare from the Indian School of Business in Hyderabad and IIM Indore.

His awards are largely for innovation and for his standing in the specialty. The Delhi Orthopaedic Association named him Best Innovative Member in 2017, and he has received the Mercy India Golden Merit Award as Best Spine Surgeon of the Year in 2019, the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre award for Best Young Indian Spine Surgeon, and the Fernström Trusted Healthcare Award for best spine surgeon in Gurgaon in 2023. He was a Dr. BC Roy Award nominee and was selected nationally across 12 conferences and 48 CME publications for the Indian Young Inventor Award.

He also holds a best paper award at ISSICON and an AO Spine fellowship award for 2016–17, and has published over 40 articles and textbook chapters on cervical disc replacement, motion preservation and spinal deformity surgery.

dr-madhu-kiran-yarlagadda.bio:
Dr. Madhu Kiran Yarlagadda is a Consultant Spine Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 16 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list covers most of the column. He performs endoscopic spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery and disc replacement surgery, spinal deformity correction, cervical and lumbar spine surgery, microdiscectomy and laminectomy, spinal trauma surgery and spinal tumor surgery, and revision surgery for failed back surgery.

His training was taken in Chennai and Singapore. He read MBBS at Sri Ramachandra University in Chennai in 2009 and took his MS in orthopaedics at the same university in 2013, then a fellowship in spine surgery at the National University Health System in Singapore in 2015.

Two figures in his record set out where his practice sits. He was a member of the pioneering team that performed the first robotic spine surgeries in Southeast Asia, and has completed over 300 endoscopic spine surgeries, with his record also noting recognised expertise in robotic spine surgery. Both the robotic and the endoscopic strands describe a practice built on minimally invasive technique.

His memberships follow the same lines: ASSICON, MISSICON for minimally invasive spine surgery, AO Spine and Trauma, COSCON and the Twin Cities Spine Association.

Besides Yashoda Hospitals in Somajiguda he has worked at Zoi Hospitals in Hyderabad and, in Chennai, at Apollo Cancer Hospital, Apollo Spectra Hospital, Apollo Hospitals on Greams Road and Ramachandra Medical College.

dr-arvind-j-vatkar.bio:
Dr. Arvind J Vatkar is a Consultant Orthopaedic and Spine Specialist at Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records spine surgery together with orthopedics.

His list covers the column from the neck down: cervical and lumbar spine surgery, microdiscectomy and discectomy, laminectomy, spinal fusion surgery, spinal deformity correction, spinal tumor surgery, spinal trauma surgery, and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty.

His training is dated and the second half of it was taken in the United Kingdom. He read MBBS at Lokmanya Tilak Municipal Medical College in Mumbai between 2002 and 2007 and took his MS in orthopaedics at Lady Hardinge Medical College in New Delhi between June 2011 and June 2013. He was an international training fellow reading for the MCh in spine at Stepping Hill Hospital under Stockport NHS Trust from Aug 2019 to Feb 2021, then senior spinal fellow at the Queen's Medical Center, Nottingham University Hospitals, from Feb 2021 to Aug 2022, an RCS approved post. His advanced spine fellowships are recorded at Nottingham, Edge Hill University and Stockport, and he holds ATLS certification from the American College of Surgeons.

He has authored or co-authored 39 peer-reviewed publications in PubMed-indexed journals including the European Spine Journal, Asian Spine Journal and Spine Deformity, gave a podium presentation at BASS 2022 on vertebral body tethering in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, and was a faculty speaker at NMOACON 2022.

He is a life member of the British Association of Spine Surgeons, the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, the Bombay Orthopaedic Society and the Indian Orthopaedic Association, and is registered with the General Medical Council.

dr-parthasarathy-srinivasan.bio:
Dr. Parthasarathy Srinivasan is Senior Consultant in Orthopaedics and Head of Spine Surgery at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records spine surgery together with orthopedics.

His list covers deformity, degenerative and trauma work: spinal deformity correction, endoscopic spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery, discectomy and microdisectomy, cervical and lumbar spine surgery, spinal trauma surgery and spinal cord injury, and revision surgery for failed back surgery.

His qualifications are dated across nine years. He read MBBS at Kasturba Medical College in Mangalore in 2001, took a D Ortho at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal in 2003 and a DNB in orthopaedics from the National Board of Examination in 2006, then the FNB in spine surgery at Ganga Hospital in Coimbatore in 2010. He is a member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences, and held an NTSE scholarship from NCERT awarded in 1993 for his entire academic period.

His academic work is mostly editorial and instructional. He is a national faculty member of AO Spine and of the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, writes invited review articles for the Indian Spine Journal, contributes to ASSI monographs, and reviews for the Indian Journal of Orthopaedics and the Indian Spine Journal. He has published in the European Spine Journal, the Spine Journal and the Journal of Tamil Nadu Orthopaedic Association, and presented at TNOACON, ASSICON and NAILSCON, where he won the best paper award in 2006 at Coimbatore for a paper on floating hip and femur nailing.

Besides Rela Hospital he has worked at Dr. Mehta's Hospital and Sundaram Medical Foundation, both in Chennai.

dr-bhavuk-garg.bio:
Dr. Bhavuk Garg is Principal Director and Head of Orthopaedics and Spine at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with spine surgery.

His list is the longest in this specialty. The operations run to cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine surgery, discectomy and microdiscectomy, disc replacement surgery, laminectomy, endoscopic spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery, spinal stenosis surgery, spinal deformity correction, and spinal tumor and trauma surgery. The conditions listed alongside them include cervical and lumbar spondylosis, degenerative disc disease, degenerative spinal stenosis, slip disc, spondylolisthesis, spondylolysis and spinal cord injury.

His training is dated and after his MS was taken entirely in the United States. He read MBBS at the University College of Medical Sciences in New Delhi in 2000 and took his MS in orthopaedics at AIIMS in 2004, then a Stanford-India Biodesign fellowship at Stanford University in 2005, a spine fellowship at the Dartmouth Spine Center in 2008, a Scoliosis Research Society global outreach fellowship at Milwaukee in 2011 and an orthopaedics fellowship with the American College of Surgeons at Chicago in 2013.

That biodesign training shows in his record. He holds a patent for FlexiOH, a DBT-recognised innovation from 2015, and received the DBT Biotech Product Development and Commercialisation Award in 2020.

His other awards are the AIIMS Research Excellence Award in 2020, the IOA Silver Jubilee Oration Award in 2021, and in 2022 the NASI–Reliance Platinum Jubilee Award and the Sitaram Jaipuria Award. He ranks among the top 2% of researchers globally in the Stanford rankings, and has written three international textbooks and more than 40 book chapters.

dr-devesh-dholakia.bio:
Dr. Devesh Dholakia is a Consultant in Spine Surgery at Gleneagles Hospital, Mumbai, with more than 24 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list covers degenerative, deformity and revision work. He performs cervical spine surgery, microdiscectomy and discectomy, spinal fusion surgery and disc replacement surgery, spinal deformity correction and spinal stenosis surgery, spinal tumor surgery and spinal trauma surgery, and revision surgery for failed back surgery.

After MBBS and an MS his training was taken in four countries, and each placement is recorded twice on his profile, as a qualification and again as a distinction. He held the Wockhardt Fellowship in Spine and the IGOF Fellowship to Germany, was a fellow in the Spinal Division of the Department of Orthopaedic Surgery at the National University Hospital in Singapore, and took a preceptorship in spinal surgery in the U.S.A. His earliest spinal training was in India, in the Department of Neurosurgery at L.T.M.C. in Mumbai.

That neurosurgical grounding, followed by an orthopaedic spinal fellowship in Singapore, means his training came through both of the routes by which surgeons reach this specialty.

He has published research in national and international medical journals and has been invited as a delegate and speaker at conferences in India and overseas.

He practises at Gleneagles Hospital at Parel in Mumbai, and was formerly at K.E.M. Hospital in the same city.

dr-datla-gs-raju.bio:
Dr. Datla GS Raju is a Consultant Spine Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 11 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. The decompression work covers microdiscectomy, discectomy and spinal stenosis surgery, and the reconstructive work spinal fusion surgery, spinal deformity correction and revision spine surgery. He also performs endoscopic spine surgery and treats spinal trauma and spinal cord injury.

He read MBBS at Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences in Andhra Pradesh in May 2011 and took his MS in orthopedics at Narayana Medical College & Hospital in Nellore between May 2012 and April 2015.

Eight fellowships follow, and they are what shape the practice. He trained in spine surgery at Mallika Spine Centre under Dr. J. Naresh Babu from July 2016 to July 2017, in transforaminal endoscopic spine surgery at Cess Shot in Miraj in 2018, and in spine surgery at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in New Delhi under Dr. H. S. Chabra. January 2019 took him to Nouvelle Clinic Bel Air in Bordeaux under Dr. Destandau Jean for endoscopic spine surgery, and the rest of that year to deformity surgery at Beijing Chaoyang Hospital under Dr. Yong Hai, pediatric spine surgery at Peking Union Hospital under Dr. Zhang and Dr. Shen, minimally invasive spine surgery at Schon Klinik Munchen under Dr. Micheal Meyer and Dr. Christoph Siepe, and cervical spine surgery at Sapporo under Dr. Kuniyoshi Abumi.

He is a member of AO Spine, the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, the Spine Society of Andhra Pradesh and the Indian Orthopaedic Association.

dr-gururaj-mallikarjun.bio:
Dr. Gururaj Mallikarjun is Associate Director of Spine Services and Senior Consultant-Cum-Chief of Unit-VI at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 28 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list is the full column. He performs cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction, discectomy and spinal stenosis surgery, and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty. He also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma.

He read MBBS at the Karnataka Institute of Medical Sciences in Hubli in 1998 and took his MS in orthopedics at St. Johns Medical College in Bangalore in 2007. His Fellowship of National Board in spine surgery was taken at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre, the hospital he now helps lead. Four further fellowships were taken abroad: minimally invasive spine surgery in Munich, spinal deformity at Hong Kong University, spinal deformity at Washington University, and cervical spine surgery and deformity at Hokaido University in Sapporo. He also holds a certificate course in pain and palliative care from the Indian Palliative Care Association, which sits alongside the surgical training rather than replacing it.

The Association of Spine Surgeons of India named him Investigator of the Year in 2013, and he held the Dartmouth Hitchcock Travelling Fellowship at Dartmouth Medical University in New Hampshire. He has been awarded and honoured by the Bangladesh Spine Society and the Bangladesh Orthopaedic Association, and his name appears in Marquis World's 'Who's Who' and in World's Intellectuals of the Year for 2013.

dr-karunakaran-s.bio:
Dr. Karunakaran S is Director and Senior Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 25 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list is degenerative and reconstructive spine work. He performs discectomy and microdiscectomy, spinal fusion surgery, cervical and lumbar spine surgery, and spinal stenosis surgery, and he treats spondylolisthesis, slip disc and spinal cord injury. He also carries out spinal deformity correction.

He read MBBS at Rajah Muthiah Medical College, Annamalai University, in 1995, took his MS in orthopedics at Shri Ramachandra Medical College & Research Institute in 2000, and added the DNB in orthopaedics from the National Board in 2001, so his specialist training was examined twice in successive years.

Much of his record is travelling fellowships and awards. He received the Mohandas Weller Gold Medal and Fellowship Award at the 10th Anniversary Meet of the Indo-German Orthopaedic Foundation, the ASSI Travelling Spine Fellowship Award from the Association of Spine Surgeons of India in 2005, and the Tamil Nadu Orthopaedic Association Travelling Spine Fellowship Award in 2006. In 2010 he was recognised for the best publication in the Tamil Nadu Orthopaedic Association Journal.

His memberships run from the state level upward: the Tamil Nadu Orthopaedic Association, the Orthopaedic Association of South India, the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, the Asian Academy of Minimally Invasive Spinal Surgery, the Asia Pacific Spine Society and AO Spine. The two minimally invasive and Asian bodies on that list sit beside a practice built on fusion and decompression at MGM Healthcare.

dr-vikas-tandon.bio:
Dr. Vikas Tandon is Director of Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with spine surgery.

His list is one of the longest in the specialty. The decompression work covers discectomy, microdisectomy, laminectomy and disc herniation surgery, with degenerative spinal stenosis and spondylolisthesis among the conditions treated. The reconstructive work covers spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction across the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. He also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma and treats spinal cord injury.

He holds MBBS, a DNB in orthopaedics, an FNB in spine surgery and MNAMS as a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences, so his specialist qualification was taken through the national board route at both diploma and fellowship level.

His record outside the operating theatre is teaching and society office. He is Chief of Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre, President of the Delhi Spine Society and a past Secretary of the same body, and he has served as chairperson and faculty for AO Spine Asia Pacific. He has presented papers nationally and internationally and been faculty at many national and international conferences, and his paper on tuberculosis of the spine won the Best Paper Award at ISSICON-2007.

Alongside the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre he is affiliated with Max Hospital at Patparganj and Moolchand Hospital at Lajpat Nagar.

dr-rajagopalan-krishnan.bio:
Dr. Rajagopalan Krishnan is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with spine surgery.

His list covers the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. He performs spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction, spinal stenosis surgery and disc replacement surgery, and he operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma.

His qualifications are unusual in being built as much on research as on surgery. After MBBS and an MS he took the MCh with honours at the University of Liverpool in 1984, where he won the gold medal, then a PhD at the University of London in 1993. He also holds the FRCSOrth of the Royal College of Surgeons in orthopedics.

The research strand is documented in his own record. He held academic grants from the Arthritis & Rheumatism Council, the Wolfson Foundation, the Hammersmith & Queen Charlotte Special Health Authority and Proteus Molecular Design, all in the UK, and supervised postdoctoral fellows, two of whose research assistants went on to obtain a PhD in related projects. A surgeon who has run funded laboratory work and trained doctoral researchers brings a different background to a spinal deformity or tumour case than one trained only on the operating list.

He is a past member of the British Orthopedic Association and belongs to the Association of Spine Surgeons of India and the Delhi Spine Society.

dr-vijayaraghavan-g.bio:
Dr. Vijayaraghavan G is a Senior Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 22 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list is weighted toward degenerative lumbar work and revision surgery. He performs discectomy and microdiscectomy, laminectomy and spinal stenosis surgery, spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction, and endoscopic spine surgery. Degenerative spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis and revision surgery after failed back surgery are all on his list.

He read MBBS at Madras Medical College in Chennai in 2004, took his MS in orthopaedics at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi in 2010, and added the DNB in orthopaedics from the National Board of Examinations in 2013.

Six fellowships follow. He held a spine clinical fellowship at National University Hospitals in Singapore and a clinical spine research fellowship at AIIMS in New Delhi, the APSS Spine Depuy Synthes Fellowship across Korea, Japan and China, the ASSI Travelling Spine Fellowship in India, the IASA Spine Fellowship at the University of California San Francisco in 2018, and the AO Spine National Fellowship at Bombay Hospital in Mumbai. The research fellowship alongside the clinical ones explains a record in which papers feature as prominently as procedures.

His awards are all for presented work: a best paper presentation gold medal as co-author at Kodaikanal in 2013, a silver medal best paper award at the 6th Conference of the World Society for Endoscopic, Navigated and Minimal Invasive Spine Surgery in New Delhi the same year, and a best paper presentation at the Singapore Spine Society annual meeting in 2018.

dr-abhay-nene.bio:
Dr. Abhay Nene is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 31 years of experience. His profile records spine surgery together with pediatric spine surgery.

His list runs from routine decompression to major reconstruction. He performs microdiscectomy, spinal fusion surgery across the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine, disc replacement surgery, and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty. He also carries out spinal deformity correction, spinal tumour surgery, spinal trauma surgery and revision surgery after failed back surgery.

He read MBBS at the University of Bombay in 1995 and took his MS in orthopedics at the same university in 1998. His Spine Foundation Fellowship ran from 2000 to 2001, and in September 2006 he held the ASSI-Dartmouth Spine Fellowship at Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center in New Hampshire.

Two further international awards sit on his record from the years between. He received the International ISSLS Spine Fellow Award from the International Society for the Study of Lumbar Spine at Cleveland, Ohio, in May 2002, and a Scoliosis Research Society Scholarship at Buenos Aires in September 2004. Lumbar spine research and scoliosis are the two bodies' respective fields, and both appear on his list of procedures.

Alongside Gleneagles Hospital at Parel he is affiliated with Wockhardt Hospital, Hinduja Surgical Specialty Hospital, Sportsmed Hospitals and B.J. Wadia Children's Hospital in Bombay. The children's hospital affiliation sits with the pediatric spine surgery recorded on his profile.

dr-varun-khanna.bio:
Dr. Varun Khanna is a Consultant in the Ortho-Spine Department at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers degenerative, deformity and trauma work. He performs discectomy and laminectomy, spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery and endoscopic spine surgery, along with vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty. Cervical spine surgery, cervical spondylosis and degenerative spinal stenosis are on his list, as are spinal deformity correction, spinal tumour surgery and spinal trauma surgery.

He read MBBS at Medical College, Kolkata, and took his MS in orthopaedics at Government Medical College, Amritsar, followed by the DNB in orthopaedics and the FNB in spine surgery at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi. He also holds FIJR as a Fellow of the Indian Journal of Rheumatology and MNAMS as a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences. His AO Spine International Fellowship in endoscopic and minimally invasive spine surgery was taken at Schön Klinik in Munich.

His published work is concentrated on the cervical spine. He has written on equations for cervical lordosis and T1 slope in young adults in the Journal of Korean Society of Spine Surgery in 2022, on clinico-radiological risk factors associated with inability to achieve MCID in cervical spondylotic myelopathy in the Asian Spine Journal in 2023, and on the influence of preoperative sagittal alignment on functional recovery in the same condition in the Asian Journal of Neurosurgery. He also contributed a chapter on operating theatre illumination to the ASSI Operation Theatre Manual for Spine Surgery.

He practises at Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram and Artemis Lite Hospital at NFC.

dr-dheeraj-batheja.bio:
Dr. Dheeraj Batheja is a Senior Consultant at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list is degenerative spine work. He performs microdiscectomy, discectomy and laminectomy, spinal fusion surgery and disc replacement surgery, endoscopic spine surgery and spinal stenosis surgery across the cervical and lumbar spine. Spondylolisthesis and degenerative disc disease are among the conditions treated, and he also carries out spinal deformity correction.

He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in Delhi and took his MS in orthopaedics at the University College of Medical Sciences, also in Delhi, followed by the DNB in orthopedics and MNAMS. His examinations continued abroad with the MRCS of England, and he holds the AO Global Spine Diploma taken at Davos.

His fellowship in spine surgery was at the Robert Jones and Agnes Hunt Orthopaedic Hospital NHS Trust in Oswestry, and his UK hospital record extends past it: he has been affiliated with St. Richards Hospital in Chichester and Worthing University Hospital in Western Sussex. Three separate NHS hospitals on one profile describe a substantial period of practice within that system rather than a single fellowship visit.

In India he is affiliated with Artemis Hospital in Gurugram and Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in Delhi. The combination of the AO Global Spine Diploma, an English surgical membership and a specialist spine fellowship in Oswestry sits behind a list that is mostly decompression and fusion for degenerative disease.

dr-samarth-mittal.bio:
Dr. Samarth Mittal is a Consultant in Orthopaedic Spine Surgery at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 10 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. He performs spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction, discectomy, endoscopic spine surgery and spinal stenosis surgery, and he operates on spinal tumours. Spondylolisthesis, cervical spondylosis and degenerative disc disease are among the conditions treated.

He holds MBBS and an MS, and trained at the University College of Medical Sciences in Delhi and at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in Rishikesh. His record notes dedicated training in spinal surgeries and in non-surgical management for spinal problems, so conservative care is part of the stated practice rather than an afterthought. He also trained in minimally invasive spine surgery and has international exposure in spine deformity, spinal tumours and endoscopy.

The robotic strand is specific. He has trained in robotic spine surgeries at BLK-Max and his record counts more than 100 robotic pedicle screw insertions, which places a measured volume behind the technique rather than a claim of familiarity with it.

His research record is substantial for the length of his career. He has authored more than 30 research papers published in international and national spine journals, and the All India Institute of Medical Sciences gave him its Best Researcher Award. He practises at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in Delhi.

dr-abhishek-srivastava.bio:
Dr. Abhishek Srivastava is a Principal Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records spine surgery together with pediatric orthopedics for scoliosis.

His list is among the fullest in the specialty. The decompression work covers discectomy, microdiscectomy, laminectomy, endoscopic spine surgery and spinal stenosis surgery, with degenerative spinal stenosis, cervical and lumbar spondylosis, degenerative disc disease, slip disc, spondylolisthesis and spondylolysis among the conditions treated. The reconstructive work covers spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery and spinal deformity correction across the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine, and he also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma and treats spinal cord injury.

He read MBBS at MGM Medical College and M.Y. Hospital in Indore between 1997 and 2003 and took his MS in orthopaedics at the same institution from 2004 to 2007. His senior residency and complex spine surgery training were at AIIMS in New Delhi, followed by a clinical fellowship in spine surgery at Singapore General Hospital and a senior spine fellowship at the Centre for Spinal Studies & Surgery, Queens Medical Center, Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust.

Two awards extend the deformity strand. He held the Scoliosis Research Society GOP Fellowship at Och Spine Hospital in New York and the IASA Visiting Surgeon Program for paediatric spinal deformity at the Nemours/Alfred I. duPont Hospital for Children in Wilmington, Delaware. He has published extensively in peer-reviewed journals and textbooks, and also practises at Max Hospital in Gurugram and Max Multi Speciality Centre at Panchsheel Park.

dr-ashish-tomar.bio:
Dr. Ashish Tomar is Director of Orthopaedics and Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 18 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers the cervical and lumbar spine. He performs spinal fusion surgery, spinal deformity correction and spinal stenosis surgery, treats slip disc, and carries out revision surgery after failed back surgery. He also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma.

He read MBBS and took his MS in orthopaedics at UCMS, University of Delhi. Three fellowships follow, and all three are named on his qualifications as well as in his training record. He trained in minimally invasive spine surgery under Prof. Kokubun at Sendai Nishitaga Hospital and in cervical spine surgery and deformity correction under Dr. K. Abumi at Sapporo Orthopaedic Hospital, both in Japan, and took a further fellowship in spine surgery at Boston. Two separate periods of training in Japan, one in minimally invasive technique and one in the cervical spine, line up directly with the departmental role he now holds.

He is a member of the Association of Spine Surgery India, the Indian Orthopaedic Association, the Indian Medical Association and the Delhi Spine Society, and the Indian Medical Association gave him its Young Jewel Award.

He practises at Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad, where his directorship covers orthopaedics alongside the minimally invasive spine work.

dr-saurabh-verma.bio:
Dr. Saurabh Verma is Associate Director of Orthopaedics and Spine Surgery at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram, in Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers the cervical and lumbar spine. The decompression work covers discectomy, microdiscectomy, laminectomy and spinal stenosis surgery, and the reconstructive work spinal fusion surgery, spinal deformity correction and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty. He also treats spinal trauma.

His three Delhi degrees were all taken at Maulana Azad Medical College, University of Delhi: MBBS, a Diploma in Anaesthesia and then the MS in orthopaedics. An anaesthesia diploma sitting between a medical degree and a surgical one is unusual, and it stays on his qualifications alongside the surgical training that followed. He added the DNB in orthopaedic surgery from the National Board of Examinations in New Delhi and the FNB in spine surgery at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre, so his specialist spine qualification was examined by the national board rather than earned only through attachment. His fellowship in spine surgery was at National University Hospital in Singapore.

His hospital record is broad for Delhi NCR. Alongside his current role at Marengo Asia Hospitals he has been affiliated with Manipal Hospital and Aakash Healthcare in Dwarka, Park Hospital in Gurugram, and the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in New Delhi, where he also trained. Five hospitals across the region, with the spine centre appearing as both training ground and affiliation, describe a practice built within one metropolitan system.

dr-vishal-mangla.bio:
Dr. Vishal Mangla is an Associate Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is spine work approached from a neurosurgical training. He performs discectomy, microdiscectomy and laminectomy, endoscopic spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery and spinal stenosis surgery across the cervical and lumbar spine. He also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma, and degenerative disc disease is among the conditions treated.

He holds MBBS, an MS in general surgery and an MCh in neurosurgery, followed by a fellowship in spine surgery. The general surgical stage before neurosurgery, and the spine fellowship after it, is what places a neurosurgeon on a list that is almost entirely spinal.

His published work stays on the neurosurgical side. He has published an analysis of cranial nerve schwannomas in the Iranian Journal of Neurosurgery, and a second paper in the same journal arguing that spontaneous intracranial hypotension is not always benign. He presented a rare case of COVID-19 associated solitary Aspergillus brain abscess at the Asian Congress of Neurological Surgeons. He also won first prize in paper presentation at the Kerala State Conference.

Alongside Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad, he has been affiliated with Paras Hospital in Gurgaon and DNSH in New Delhi.

dr-dilip-gopalakrishnan.bio:
Dr. Dilip Gopalakrishnan is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, in Bengaluru, with more than 38 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery covering both brain and spine surgery.

His list runs across both. The cranial work is brain tumour removal and resection. The spinal work covers cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery, minimally invasive spine surgery, disc herniation surgery and spinal stenosis surgery, along with spinal tumour surgery, spinal deformity correction and spinal trauma surgery.

His qualifications explain the range. He holds MBBS, an MS in orthopedics and an MCh, the Master of Chirurgiae, with a neurosurgery and spine surgery specialisation. An orthopaedic master's followed by a neurosurgical one is the training that puts brain tumour resection and spinal fusion on the same list.

His research record spans three decades and more than one field. He published work on cervical intertransverse process grafting in radioculopathy in Neurology India in 2002, and research on vascularized rib graft for defects of the diaphysis of the humerus in children in the Journal of Bone & Joint Surgery in 2000. An earlier 1994 study on the structural organization of carbon-reduced myocardial infarctional surgery sits further back on the same record.

He is a member of the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, the Karnataka Orthopaedic Association and the Bangalore Orthopaedic Society, and is also affiliated with Apollo Specialty Hospital in Jayanagar, Bengaluru.

dr-sumit-kumar.bio:
Dr. Sumit Kumar is a Consultant in the Ortho-Spine Department at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers decompression and reconstruction. He performs discectomy, microdiscectomy, laminectomy and spinal stenosis surgery, spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery and endoscopic spine surgery, along with cervical spine surgery, spinal deformity correction, spinal trauma surgery and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty.

He read MBBS at Government Medical College, Surat, and holds the D.ORTH diploma in orthopaedics. His postgraduate orthopaedics was at Netaji Subhash Chander Bose Medical College in Jabalpur, with the DNB completed through the National Board of Examinations. His FNB in spine surgery was taken at Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi on a two-year super-speciality programme accredited by the NMC. Two further fellowships follow: an AO Spine Fellowship at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in New Delhi, and a MISS and endoscopy fellowship at Schoen Clinic in Munich under Dr. Chritopher Siepe.

His publications are case and measurement work rather than reviews. He reported an isolated tuberculosis of the spinous process of the C5 vertebra in the Journal of Orthopaedic Case Reports in 2023, co-authored a study measuring subaxial cervical vertebral height by computed tomography to optimise anterior cervical plating in a north Indian population in JCDR in 2022, and contributed to a paper in Spinal Cord Ser Cases proposing that concomitant spine and calcaneum fractures may indicate less extensive injury. He practises at Artemis Hospital in Gurugram.

dr-vineesh-mathur.bio:
Dr. Vineesh Mathur is Director of Orthopaedics at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 30 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list is weighted toward degenerative disease. He performs spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery, laminectomy, endoscopic spine surgery and spinal stenosis surgery, and he also carries out spinal deformity correction and spinal tumour surgery. The conditions named on his profile are cervical and lumbar spondylosis, degenerative disc disease, degenerative spinal stenosis and spondylolisthesis, which is the pattern of a practice built on the ageing spine rather than on trauma.

He holds MBBS, an MS in orthopaedics and the DNB in orthopaedics from the National Board, so his specialist qualification was examined twice.

The research strand on his record is older than the surgical directorship and worth reading on its own. He was an Indian Council of Medical Research Junior Research Fellow in 1987 and an ICMR Research Associate in 1993, two consecutive stages of the council's own research ladder, and in 2002 he held a Rotary Foundation Rotary Visiting Fellowship.

He is a member of the Association of Spine Surgeons of India and of the North American Spine Society. Membership of both a national and a North American body sits alongside a list that includes endoscopic and disc replacement work. He practises at Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram.

dr-kalidutta-das.bio:
Dr. Kalidutta Das is Chief and Director of Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list is degenerative spine work and the fractures that follow bone loss. He performs discectomy and microdiscectomy, laminectomy, spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty, and he carries out spinal deformity correction. Cervical spondylosis, lumbar spondylosis, degenerative disc disease, degenerative spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis and slip disc are the conditions named on his profile.

He holds MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics, followed by the FNB in spine surgery from the National Board. His further training was taken abroad in two places with very different casemixes: a spine fellowship at Stoke Mandeville Hospital in the United Kingdom, and advanced training at Ospedale San Raffaele Hospital in Milan.

His presented work maps onto the same two areas as his list. A paper on lower cervical tuberculosis from C3 to C7 won the Gold Medal Award at ISSICON-2009 in Chandigarh, and he was faculty at the national and international Asia Pacific APCESS meeting at Jeju, Korea, where he presented on osteoporotic fractures and compared kyphoplasty with vertebroplasty. Both of those procedures are on his own list, so the comparison is one he makes in practice.

His record describes him as an active contributor to national and international presentations and publications in spine surgery. He practises at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in New Delhi.

dr-v-anand-naik.bio:
Dr. V Anand Naik is Director of Spine and Limb Reconstruction at Paras Hospitals, Gurugram, in Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. The reconstructive work covers spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery and spinal deformity correction, and the decompression work spinal stenosis surgery. He also operates on spinal tumours, and degenerative disc disease and spondylolisthesis are the conditions named on his profile. Disc replacement appearing alongside fusion means both the motion-preserving and the fusion approach to degenerative disc disease are within his practice.

He holds MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics. Two further items on his qualifications are specific to the spine: an Advanced Spine Fellowship, and Post FRACS Spine Education and Training, a stage taken after the FRACS rather than before it.

His memberships describe where his technique comes from. He belongs to the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, the Minimal Invasive Spine Society of Bharat, the Society of Lateral Access Surgery and the North American Spine Society. Lateral access is a distinct route to the lumbar spine and has a society of its own, and his membership of it sits beside the minimally invasive body rather than duplicating it.

The directorship covers limb reconstruction as well as the spine, so his remit at Paras Health in Gurugram is broader than the spinal list alone.

dr-b-mohapatra.bio:
Dr. B. Mohapatra is Director of Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. He performs discectomy and microdiscectomy, spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery, spinal stenosis surgery and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty, along with spinal deformity correction. Cervical spondylosis, degenerative disc disease and spondylolisthesis are the conditions named on his profile.

He holds MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics. His IGASS Fellowship in spinal instrumentation was taken in France and Germany, and his post-doctoral fellowship in spine surgery in Sydney.

That IGASS fellowship was itself an award, given for a paper presented at the International Conference on Lumbar Intervertebral Disc at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in April 2009, reporting that early and sustainable improvement in pain was evident as soon as ten days after total lumbar disc replacement, at a minimum follow-up of two years. Disc replacement remains on his list of procedures.

His earlier prizes are from general orthopaedics and predate the spinal work. He took first prize at OOACON in Jaipur in 2002 for a paper on the management of bone tumours by the Ilizarov technique, and second prize at OOACON in Cuttack in 2001 for a paper on the management of cubitus varus deformity by external fixator, which he published the same year in the Orissa Journal of Orthopaedics. He practises at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in New Delhi.

dr-manoj-jain.bio:
Dr. Manoj Jain is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 18 years of experience across orthopedics and spine surgery.

His list is degenerative and trauma work on the cervical and lumbar spine. He performs discectomy and laminectomy, spinal fusion surgery and spinal stenosis surgery, spinal deformity correction, spinal trauma surgery, and revision surgery after failed back surgery. Degenerative disc disease and slip disc are the conditions named on his profile. Revision work sitting on the same list as primary fusion means he takes on cases where a previous operation has not settled the problem.

He holds MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics, and three fellowships follow, each in a different country. His National Fellowship in Spine was taken in India, an adult reconstructive fellowship in Germany, and a further spine fellowship in Australia. The reconstructive fellowship is the one that sits outside the spine, and it is reflected in a profile that records orthopedics ahead of spine surgery rather than the other way round.

His own record notes that he is a recipient of international spine and reconstructive fellowships in Germany and Australia, a member of several national and international orthopaedic societies, and recognised for his contributions to complex trauma and spine surgery care in Mumbai, where he practises at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel.

dr-manoj-kumar.bio:
Dr. Manoj Kumar is a Senior Consultant in Orthopedic Spine Surgery at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 6 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list is weighted toward degenerative disease and the newer access routes to it. He performs spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery, laminectomy, endoscopic spine surgery and spinal deformity correction. Cervical spondylosis, lumbar spondylosis, degenerative disc disease, degenerative spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis and slip disc are the conditions named on his profile.

He holds MBBS, the DNB in orthopedics and the FNB in spine surgery, so both his general and his specialist qualifications were examined through the national board. He also holds the MRCS, the Membership of the Royal Colleges of Surgeons of the United Kingdom.

The endoscopic strand is trained twice over. He took an endoscopic spine fellowship at Asian Spine Hospital in Hyderabad and a separate endoscopy spine training programme at the Indore Spine Center. Two distinct periods of endoscopic training, at two dedicated spine units, sit behind the endoscopic spine surgery on his list rather than a single course.

Alongside BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in New Delhi he has been affiliated with Jaypee Hospital in Noida and Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi. For a surgeon at this stage of his career, the combination of a national board super-specialty qualification, a UK surgical membership and dedicated endoscopic training describes a practice already narrowed to the spine.

dr-raghava-dutt-mulukutla.bio:
Dr. Raghava Dutt Mulukutla is a Consultant Spine Surgeon at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad, with more than 35 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list covers the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. The reconstructive work covers spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery and spinal deformity correction, and the decompression work discectomy, endoscopic spine surgery and spinal stenosis surgery. He also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma, and spondylolisthesis is among the conditions treated.

He holds MBBS, an MS in orthopedics, the FRCS, and an M.Ch in orthopedics. The FRCS alongside two Indian master's qualifications in the same specialty means his orthopaedic training was examined in two systems before the spine practice took shape.

His record outside the operating theatre is office in the specialty's own institutions. He was President of the Association of Spine Surgeons of India from 2017 to 2019, the national body for the specialty, and is Vice President of the Orthopaedic Association of South Indian States. He is also Editor-in-Chief of the Journal of OASIS, so he holds both an executive and an editorial role within the regional association.

Holding the presidency of the national spine association for a full two-year term, while editing a regional orthopaedic journal, describes a surgeon whose colleagues have placed him at the centre of the specialty rather than one working only within his own hospital. He practises at Apollo Hospital in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad.

dr-m-l-bansal.bio:
Dr. M. L. Bansal is a Senior Consultant in Spine Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience in spine surgery.

His list is degenerative disease, deformity and injury. He performs laminectomy and discectomy, disc replacement surgery, spinal fusion surgery, and vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty, along with cervical spine surgery, spinal deformity correction and spinal trauma surgery. Cervical spondylosis, lumbar spondylosis, degenerative disc disease and degenerative spinal stenosis are the conditions named on his profile, and he also treats spinal cord injury.

He holds MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics, a fellowship in spine surgery from the Association of Spine Surgeons of India, and the KEIO Spine Fellowship taken at Keio University in Tokyo in 2018.

Spinal cord injury is the thread that runs through both his hospital and his presented work. In May 2015 he presented a review of 152 cases of paediatric spinal cord injury at the Global Spine Congress in Buenos Aires, and he has been faculty at ISCoS in Maastricht. A series of that size in children, presented at an international congress, comes from a centre that sees the injury in volume, and he practises at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in New Delhi.

His earlier presented work is on the other end of his list: a paper on his experience with vertebroplasty, given at IOACON-2006 in New Delhi.

dr-sameer-anand.bio:
Dr. Sameer Anand is a Principal Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list is one of the broader ones in the specialty. The decompression work covers discectomy, endoscopic spine surgery and spinal stenosis surgery, with degenerative spinal stenosis, slip disc and spondylolisthesis among the conditions treated. The reconstructive work covers spinal fusion surgery, disc replacement surgery and spinal deformity correction across the cervical and thoracic spine. He also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma and treats spinal cord injury.

He read MBBS at Berhampur University in Orissa and holds the MRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons at Edinburgh. His training in minimally invasive spine procedures was taken in Austria and Singapore, which is what places endoscopic surgery on a list that also includes open fusion and deformity work.

His published work is in book form rather than journal papers. He has published on tuberculosis of the spine and on dysfunctions of the sacroiliac joint, both with CBS Publication. The sacroiliac joint title is notable on a spine surgeon's record, since it addresses a source of back pain below the lumbar spine itself.

He also presented results of ozone nucleoplasty as an alternative management for PIVD at North Zone DOACON, a technique offered as an alternative to the discectomy that is otherwise on his list.

Alongside Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital at Saket he practises at Max Hospital in Gurgaon.

dr-naveen-m-a.bio:
Dr. Naveen M A is Head of Department and Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospitals in Bengaluru, with more than 19 years of experience. His profile records neurosurgery together with spine surgery.

His list is spine work performed through small access routes wherever the case allows. He carries out endoscopic spine surgery and microdiscectomy alongside cervical and lumbar spine surgery, spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction, and he operates on spinal tumours.

His qualifications explain that emphasis. After MBBS, an MS and the MCh in neurosurgery, he took four fellowships, and three of them are in access technique. The FMAS is a fellowship in minimal access surgery, the FMISS was taken in minimally invasive spine surgery at Seoul, and the FASS is a fellowship in advanced spine surgery taken in the USA. His fourth, a fellowship in skull base endoscopy, was also taken in the USA and sits on the cranial side of his neurosurgical training.

Holding both a minimal access fellowship and a minimally invasive spine fellowship, from two different countries, means the endoscopic and microsurgical parts of his list were examined separately rather than picked up alongside general practice. The skull base fellowship extends the same endoscopic approach upward from the spine into the base of the skull.

He heads the department at Gleneagles and is affiliated with Gleneagles BGS Hospital at Kengeri in Bengaluru.

dr-uday-pawar.bio:
Dr. Uday Pawar is a Consultant Spine Surgeon at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 13 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list covers the cervical, thoracic and lumbar spine. The decompression work covers discectomy, microdiscectomy and laminectomy, and the reconstructive work spinal fusion surgery and spinal deformity correction. He also operates on spinal tumours and spinal trauma.

He holds MBBS, the D Ortho diploma and the DNB. His spine fellowship was taken at Hinduja Hospital in Mumbai, the hospital he remains affiliated with, so his specialist training and his continuing practice sit in the same unit.

Two further periods of training were taken abroad. He was Assistant Dartmouth Spine Fellow at Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center, and a visiting spine surgeon under Prof. Jurgen Harms at SRH Klinikum in Germany. A named mentorship of that kind is a specific attachment rather than a general rotation, and it sits alongside deformity correction on his list of procedures.

The shape of his record is narrow by design. A diploma and a national board qualification in orthopaedics, one Indian spine fellowship and two overseas attachments, all before a practice confined to the spine, describes a surgeon who moved into the subspecialty early rather than broadening from general orthopaedics later.

He practises at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai and at PD Hinduja Hospital in the same city.

dr-rajesh-verma.bio:
Dr. Rajesh Verma is Associate Director of Orthopedic Spine Surgery at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 11 years of experience across spine surgery and orthopedics.

His list is degenerative spine work and the two ways of treating it. He performs spinal fusion surgery and disc replacement surgery, laminectomy, endoscopic spine surgery, cervical spine surgery and spinal deformity correction. Cervical spondylosis, lumbar spondylosis, degenerative disc disease, degenerative spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis and slip disc are the conditions named on his profile. Fusion and disc replacement sitting side by side means both the fusing and the motion-preserving approach are available in his practice.

He holds MBBS, the DNB in orthopaedics and an MCh in orthopaedics, so his specialist qualification was taken twice over through two separate routes.

His fellowship training is unusually concentrated in one city. Three of his four further qualifications were taken at Seoul: a fellowship in cervical spine surgery at Samsung Medical Centre, an international fellowship in spine surgery at Yonsei University of Medical Sciences and Severance Hospital, and an endoscopic spine surgery fellowship at Nanoori Hospital. The fourth is an advanced certificate in spine surgery from Innsbruck Medical University.

Three separate Seoul hospitals, one for the cervical spine, one for general spine surgery and one for endoscopy, account for most of the technique on his list, and the Innsbruck certificate adds a fourth centre to the same period of training. He practises at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in New Delhi.

dr-prashant-saxena.bio:
Dr. Prashant Saxena is Principal Director and Head of Pulmonology at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, where his remit covers pulmonology, critical care and sleep medicine. He has more than 27 years of experience.

His procedural list is diagnostic and interventional airway work: bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and medical thoracoscopy.

His qualifications were examined in four systems. After MBBS and an MD he took the FRCP at Edinburgh, the European Diploma in Intensive Care, the FCCP of the American College of Chest Physicians and the European Diploma in Advanced Respiratory Medicine. He is also a Fellow of the Indian College of Critical Care Medicine and holds an Executive Management Programme in Health from Virginia University.

Each strand of his list has its own training. Interventional pulmonology was taken in Greece, thoracoscopy in France, paediatric bronchoscopy in Italy, and his ICU fellowship at Westmead and Liverpool Hospitals in Sydney.

The recognition on his record runs over more than a decade. It begins with Best Doctor of the Year at Fortis Vasant Kunj in 2011 and includes Asian Patient Safety Awards in 2014 for reducing restricted antibiotics consumption and in 2015 for the "BREATH EASY" community-based initiative, a BMJ South Asia Awards finalist place for best pulmonology team, the Times of India Healthcare Achievers Award in 2018, Pulmonary and Critical Care Specialist of the Year in 2019, two Corona Warrior felicitations in 2020, and the Clinical Excellence Award at VISICON in 2023. He also practises at Fortis Hospital in Vasant Kunj.

dr-viswesvaran-balasubramanian.bio:
Dr. Viswesvaran Balasubramanian is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 13 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list spans three areas. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical respiratory work covers interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection and drug-resistant tuberculosis, and he is part of lung transplantation care. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea with CPAP titration and management.

He read MBBS at Government Medical College and Hospital in Coimbatore under Dr. MGR Medical University in 2013, took his MD in pulmonary medicine at the Vallabhbhai Patel Chest Institute, University of Delhi, and the DNB in pulmonary medicine in 2016, then his DM in pulmonary, critical care and sleep medicine at Vardhman Mahavir Medical College and Safdarjung Hospital in 2019 as a gold medallist. His fellowship in sleep medicine also carried a gold medal, and his fellowship in interventional pulmonology was taken in Malaysia.

His awards follow the same two tracks. He won the Prof K.L. Nagarajan Award in the sleep medicine fellowship examination in 2019 and was best student of the year for it, and he took best image, best video and best overall innovation at the World Congress of Bronchology and Interventional Pulmonology in Bali.

He belongs to the National College of Chest Physicians, the Indian Chest Society, the Indian Society for Study of Lung Cancer, the European Thoracic Oncology Platform, the European Respiratory Society, the Indian Sleep Disorder Association and the Chest Club of India.

dr-ravindra-m-mehta.bio:
Dr. Ravindra M Mehta is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, in Bengaluru, with more than 28 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list separates cleanly into three. The interventional work is diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures. The medical respiratory work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis and complex pulmonary infection. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at Seth G.S. Medical College and KEM Hospital, University of Mumbai, and took an MD in internal medicine at Lokmanya Tilak Municipal Medical College in the same city. A second MD in internal medicine followed at the State University of New York at Brooklyn, and then three fellowships: pulmonary medicine at New York Methodist Hospital and the SUNY Health Science Center, and critical care medicine and sleep disorders medicine at New York Methodist Hospital.

That training is reflected in four American board certifications, in internal medicine, pulmonary disease, critical care medicine and sleep medicine. He is a Diplomate of the American Board of Sleep Medicine, a Fellow of the American College of Chest Physicians and a Fellow of the American Association of Sleep Medicine.

Two items on his record stand apart from the clinical list. He has published over 150 professional papers, abstracts and book chapters in leading medical journals, and he established India's first interventional pulmonary program. He practises at Apollo Hospitals on Bannerghatta Road in Bangalore.

dr-latha-sharma.bio:
Dr. Latha Sharma is Head of Department and Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 31 years of experience in pulmonology.

Her list is broad. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical work covers interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, complex pulmonary infection and post-tuberculosis lung disease, and the sleep work obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

She read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad between 1989 and 1994, with an internship across Osmania General Hospital, Niloufer Children's Hospital, the Government Maternity Hospital and the Government ENT Hospital, and took her MD in TB and respiratory diseases at the Government General and Chest Hospital, Osmania, between 1997 and 2000. She holds the FCCP, the FNCCP of the National College of Chest Physicians, a Diploma in Allergy and Asthma, MNAMS, and the B.N.Y.S. Her EBUS training was at KMIO in Hyderabad and her interventional pulmonology fellowship at KIMS.

Her recognition ranges wider than the clinic. She won a gold medal in the postgraduate quiz contest and a second for outstanding contribution to IAPS, received awards from the Governor of Telangana on National Pharmacy Day in 2007, and was recognised for coordinating the COVID pandemic response at KIMS Hospital.

She has published in the Indian Journal of Respiratory Care, the Indian Journal of Sleep Medicine, Lung India, the CHEST Journal and American Thoracic Society journals, and also practises at Apollo Hospitals, Jubilee Hills.

dr-apar-jindal.bio:
Dr. Apar Jindal is Director of Pulmonology and Transplant Medicine at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 21 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with lung transplant surgery.

His list is among the fullest in the specialty. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical work covers interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, cystic fibrosis, pulmonary hypertension, drug-resistant tuberculosis, post-tuberculosis lung disease and complex pulmonary infection, and the sleep work obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration. Lung transplantation sits at the end of that range, and cystic fibrosis and pulmonary hypertension are among the conditions that lead to it.

He read MBBS at Sri Devaraj Urs Medical College, Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, in 2005 and took his MD in respiratory medicine at Chettinad Hospital and Research Institute in 2015, winning the gold medal. In 2023 he took fellowships from the National College of Chest Physicians at the University of Delhi and from the United Academy of Pulmonary Medicine.

His hospital record follows the transplant programmes. It includes the Institute of Heart and Lung Transplant at Gleneagles Global Health City, MGM Healthcare and Apollo Hospitals in Chennai, Yashoda Hospital in Secunderabad, the Metro Centre for Respiratory Diseases in Noida, and the University of California Davis Medical Centre in Sacramento.

He was named Pulmonologist of the Year at the Economic Times Healthcare Awards in 2023 and gave the Dr. SK Jain and Dr. SK Katiyar Oration at NAPCON in 2025.

dr-manoj-kumar-goel.bio:
Dr. Manoj Kumar Goel is Principal Director and Unit Head for Pulmonology and Sleep Medicine at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 34 years of experience.

His list covers three areas. The interventional work is diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, complex pulmonary infection and living with chronic lung disease. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at King George Medical College in Lucknow in 1988 and took his MD there in 1992. His later qualifications were taken in four countries. He holds the FRCP of Glasgow, a Diploma in Interventional Pulmonology from the University of Lille, a fellowship in intensive care medicine at Erasme University Hospital in Brussels, and a fellowship in sleep medicine at the Prince Royal Alfred Hospital in Sydney. His EBUS bronchoscopy training was at the Royal Brisbane Women Hospital.

In India he is a Fellow of the National College of Chest Physicians, of the Indian Association of Bronchology and of the Indian Sleep Disorders Association, and a fellow in critical care medicine. He is also a certified Advanced Cardiac Life Support provider of the American Heart Association.

The National College of Chest Physicians gave him a national award for research in pulmonary interventions, and he has twice been given oration awards at national conferences and received the Times Life Time Legend Award. He has over 50 publications in national and international journals, and also practises at Fortis Hospital in Gurgaon.

dr-sindhura-koganti.bio:
Dr. Sindhura Koganti is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 13 years of experience. Her profile records pulmonology together with interventional pulmonology and sleep medicine.

Her list reflects all three. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, medical thoracoscopy and airway stenting. The medical work covers chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, post-tuberculosis lung disease and complex pulmonary infection, and she is part of lung transplantation care. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea with CPAP titration and management.

She read MBBS and took her MD in pulmonary medicine at Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences in Andhra Pradesh, finishing as state second topper in the MD. Her lung transplant observership was at St. Vincent's Hospital in Sydney from April to July 2018.

Her record from the pandemic is specific. She was lead consultant managing COVID ICU, ECMO and inpatient and outpatient care, and her profile counts more than 1,000 ICU patients treated alongside extensive outpatient consultations.

She has published nationally and internationally in pulmonary medicine, including case reports and clinical studies in the Indian Chest Journal, the Saudi Journal of Medical and Pharmaceutical Sciences and Cureus, with research contributions on COPD, asthma, pulmonary infections and biomarkers. She won first prize in the quiz competition at BRONCHOCON 2013 and is an active speaker and faculty at national and international conferences.

She is a member of ISHLT, the European Respiratory Society and the Indian Chest Society, and has also been affiliated with Fortis Hospital at Vadapalani and Sri Ramachandra Medical College in Chennai.

dr-vimi-varghese.bio:
Dr. Vimi Varghese is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 12 years of experience. Her profile records pulmonology together with lung transplant surgery.

Her list is narrow and matches that pairing: lung transplantation, bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound and transbronchial needle aspiration.

Her training is almost entirely transplant medicine. She took her MD in pulmonary medicine at MGMCRI in Puducherry in 2018 and a post-doctoral fellowship in pulmonology at Christian Medical College, Vellore, in 2020. Her fellowship in adult lung transplantation was at University Hospital Leuven in 2022, and her fellowship in pediatric lung transplantation at the Alfred Hospital in Melbourne in 2025. Separate fellowships in adult and paediatric transplantation, taken in two countries, cover both ends of the age range in a field where few centres do either.

The same year at the Alfred Hospital gave her specialist training in pulmonary hypertension, with exposure to pulmonary hypertension clinics and advanced PAH therapies under Prof. Trevor Williams. Pulmonary hypertension is one of the conditions that leads to transplantation, so that attachment sits directly alongside the rest of her training.

She also holds the Fellowship of the Asia Pacific Society of Respirology and the European Diploma in Adult Respiratory Medicine, both taken in 2020.

Alongside Gleneagles Healthcity at Perumbakkam she has been affiliated with Yashoda Hospitals in Hyderabad, Naruvi Super Speciality Hospital and Christian Medical College in Vellore. She is faculty and a contributor at national and international conferences on lung transplantation and interventional pulmonology.

dr-j-v-s-aswith-chowdary.bio:
Dr. J V S Aswith Chowdary is a Consultant Clinical and Interventional Pulmonologist and Allergy and Immunology Specialist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 11 years of experience.

His list covers interventional, medical and sleep respiratory work. The interventional side is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical side covers interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, complex pulmonary infection and drug-resistant tuberculosis. The sleep side covers obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at Andhra Medical College in Vishakapatnam between 2008 and 2013, took the DNB in respiratory diseases at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi from 2016 to 2019, and his DM in pulmonary medicine at Christian Medical College, Vellore, from 2020 to 2023.

Both his awards come from that training. Sir Ganga Ram Hospital gave him the Late Shri Ajay Kumar Basu Award for the best DNB trainee in pulmonology, and the Indian Chest Society placed him third for the Dr. J C Kothari Young Scientist Award at NAPCON 2022 in Udaipur.

His published work is interventional. He has written on the evolving role of rapid on-site evaluation in pulmonary interventions and co-authored a report on the feasibility and safety of transbronchial lung cryobiopsy in a patient with ARDS on veno-venous ECMO, both in Ann Interv Pulmonol. He also co-authored a three-case series on unilateral pulmonary artery agenesis in Respirology Case Reports, a case report in BMJ Case Reports, and earlier work on shorter regimens for latent tuberculosis.

dr-mahesh-gudelli.bio:
Dr. Mahesh Gudelli is Course Director and Mentor of the Interventional Fellowship Programme at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list is weighted toward interventional work. He performs bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, cryo-lung biopsy and airway stenting. The medical side covers interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, complex pulmonary infection, drug-resistant tuberculosis and obstructive sleep apnea.

He read MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College and Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Hospital in Warangal and took the DNB in pulmonary medicine at Yashoda Hospital in Hyderabad. He holds the European Diploma in Adult Respiratory Medicine from the European Respiratory Society, completed a comprehensive sleep medicine course with APCSM, and took a certificate course in health care management at ISB in Hyderabad.

The fellowship programme he directs is the part of his record that sets it apart. A surgeon or physician who mentors an interventional fellowship is responsible for other doctors' procedural training as well as his own list, and his own award record includes appreciation as faculty at the South India Post-Graduate Pulmonary Medicine Conference in 2021 and at RESPCARE-2022, a continuing education meeting for respiratory therapists. He also received an award of appreciation for COVID services from the Osmania Medical College Alumni Association.

His memberships run across the field: the Indian Chest Society, the European Respiratory Society, the American College of Chest Physicians, the Asian Pacific Society of Respirology, the Indian Association for Bronchology, and the World Association for Bronchology and Interventional Pulmonology.

dr-gonuguntla-hari-kishan.bio:
Dr. Gonuguntla Hari Kishan is a Consultant Interventional Pulmonologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with diagnostic and interventional support for lung cancer.

His list covers bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound and transbronchial needle aspiration alongside interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, drug-resistant tuberculosis, post-tuberculosis lung disease, pulmonary hypertension and complex pulmonary infection. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at Katuri Medical College and Hospital in Guntur in 2009 and took his MD in pulmonology medicine at the same college in 2013, followed by the DM at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences in Kochi in 2016. His interventional training was taken abroad in 2017 and 2018: a clinical fellowship in advanced interventional pulmonology at Siriraj Hospital, Mahidol University, in Bangkok, a fellowship in respiratory endoscopy at the Respiratory Endoscopy National Cancer Centre in Tokyo, and ERS certification in endobronchial ultrasound in the Netherlands.

A cancer centre fellowship sits directly behind the lung cancer support recorded on his profile, and he organised the first international conference and live workshop on EBUS and advanced lung cancer treatments at Yashoda Hospitals. He also won the best abstract award at the 32nd Andhra Pradesh TB and Chest Diseases Conference in September 2010.

He is a member of the American Thoracic Society, ISHLT, the Asian Pacific Society of Respirology, the European Respiratory Society and the International Association for Study of Lung Cancer, and a life member of APSA and MABIP.

dr-bharat-gopal.bio:
Dr. Bharat Gopal is Senior Director of Respiratory and Sleep Medicine at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 27 years of experience across pulmonology and sleep medicine.

His list covers all three parts of his title. The interventional work is diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, cryo-lung biopsy, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, complex pulmonary infection and post-tuberculosis lung disease. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He holds MBBS, an MD in respiratory medicine and TB, the DNB in pulmonary medicine, MNAMS, and a fellowship in interventional pulmonology.

Two entries on his record are firsts rather than qualifications. He is described as a pioneer of endobronchial ultrasound guided procedures and lung cryobiopsies in India, and of home-based polysomnography in Delhi. Both techniques appear on his own list, so the pioneering work and the current practice are the same procedures.

His teaching extends past his hospital. He founded the "Pulmo-Pathshala" series for training doctors in interventional pulmonology across India, and he has been a key contributor to national guidelines on asthma, COPD, bronchoscopy and community-acquired pneumonia. He has authored over 30 scientific publications and textbook chapters.

The National College of Chest Physicians gave him its Young Scientist Award and the Delhi State branch of the IMA the Vashisht Chikatsak Award. He also practises at Medanta Gurugram and Medanta Mediclinic in Defence Colony.

dr-manas-mengar.bio:
Dr. Manas Mengar is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Thane, in Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list covers three areas. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, complex pulmonary infection and post-tuberculosis lung disease. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

His qualifications were examined in three systems. He holds a DM in pulmonary critical care and sleep medicine, the DNB, the MRCP Respiratory specialty certificate examination taken in the United Kingdom, and the European Diploma in Adult Respiratory Medicine from Switzerland. Two further fellowships cover the other parts of his list: one in interventional pulmonology, and one in sleep medicine from the ISDA, which he took with a gold medal.

His record is unusually full of examination and quiz results, which is what a decade of competitive postgraduate training looks like when it is written down. He took first prize in the state level postgraduate quiz at KEM Hospital in Mumbai and the zonal level quiz at B.J. Medical in Ahmedabad, both at NAPCON 2015, second prize at the DY Patil University quiz in Pimpri in 2016, and first prize in the DM postgraduate quiz at PACS 2019 in Delhi. In 2020 he was selected in the top five in the American College of Chest Physicians examination.

He was faculty on the advisory board at Medsicon 2019 and has several publications in national and international medical journals. He practises at KIMS Hospital in Thane.

dr-priya-sharma.bio:
Dr. Priya Sharma is a Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 13 years of experience in pulmonology.

Her list is weighted toward chronic and infective lung disease. She performs bronchoscopy and airway stenting, and manages chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, cystic fibrosis, obstructive sleep apnea and complex pulmonary infection. Drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease both appear on her list, which is the pattern of a practice that sees the disease and its long-term damage.

She read MBBS, then took the DNB in TB and chest medicine at NITRD in Delhi as a gold medallist, and her DM in pulmonary, critical care and sleep medicine at AIIMS. She also holds the European Diploma in Respiratory Medicine and a postgraduate diploma in hospital management.

That management diploma is worth noting alongside the clinical qualifications. It sits on a record that already includes a national board gold medal and a super-specialty degree from AIIMS, and it points to responsibility for how a service runs rather than only for the patients within it.

Her research record runs to more than 30 research papers and publications in peer-reviewed, PubMed-indexed journals, and she won the Dr. J. C. Kothari Young Scientist Award at NAPCON 2022.

She is a member of the European Respiratory Society, the Indian Chest Society and the National Academy of Medical Sciences. Alongside Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad, she has been affiliated with Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi and Kalpana Chawla Government Medical College in Karnal.

dr-lakshminarayana-jasti.bio:
