Dr. Lakshminarayana Jasti is Lead Consultant and Course Director of the Interventional Pulmonology Fellowship Program at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience.

His list covers interventional, medical and sleep respiratory work. The interventional side is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical side covers chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension and complex pulmonary infection, and the sleep side obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at Guntur Medical College between 2006 and 2012 and took his MD in pulmonary medicine at G.S.L. Medical College in Rajahmundry from 2016 to 2019. He then secured all India 16th rank in NEET SS-2019 and took his DM in pulmonary medicine at Christian Medical College, Vellore, from 2019 to 2022. His fellowship in bronchoscopy and interventional pulmonology was at Serdang Hospital in Malaysia in February 2024.

Between the DM and the fellowship he was an assistant professor at Christian Medical College in Vellore, so he has taught in a teaching hospital as well as directing the fellowship programme he now runs at KIMS.

His prizes are all for presented work and recall. He took first prize in poster presentation at NAPCON 2018 in Ahmadabad and again at NAPCON 2021 in Varanasi, and first prize at the national APACI respiratory disease quiz in 2022 conducted by Cipla Med.

He is a life member of the Indian Chest Society and a member of the European Respiratory Society.

dr-nandani-gulati.bio:
Dr. Nandani Gulati is a Senior Consultant at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 10 years of experience in pulmonology.

Her list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, medical thoracoscopy and medical pleural procedures alongside severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection and drug-resistant tuberculosis. The sleep side covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

She read MBBS at Goa Medical College and Hospital, Goa University, and took her MD in pulmonology at the same college as a gold medallist, receiving the Dr. A.S. Bagga Award for academic excellence in pulmonary medicine. She also holds the European Diploma in Adult Respiratory Medicine taken in Switzerland. Her earliest recorded prize is a first in the forensic medicine examination in her second MBBS year, which places the academic record well before the specialty.

Her published work is on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and the imaging of it. She has publications in national and international journals on volumetric CT findings in COPD, on tobacco and biomass smoke associated pulmonary disease, and on emphysema quantification. Biomass smoke exposure is a distinct cause of the same disease, and her work covers both it and tobacco.

Her presentations run from 2014 onward: the Asia Pacific Society of Respirology Congress and NAPCON in November 2014, the Indian Radiology and Imaging Association conference in January 2015, and IPF Medicon in 2019. She won a best paper award at ICONIC in Pune in February 2014 and third prize for a poster on non-resolving pneumonia at the 17th Critical Care Symposium in 2022. She practises at Fortis Hospital in Vasant Kunj.

dr-v-pratibh-prasad.bio:
Dr. V Pratibh Prasad is a Consultant Clinical and Interventional Pulmonologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with interventional pulmonology and paediatric pulmonology.

His list covers bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting alongside severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, obstructive sleep apnea, complex pulmonary infection and drug-resistant tuberculosis.

He read MBBS at SVS Medical College in Mahabubnagar and took the DNB in pulmonary medicine at P. D. Hinduja National Hospital and Medical Research Centre in Mumbai. He then passed the specialty certificate examination in respiratory medicine of the Royal College of Physicians in the UK, and took his fellowship in interventional pulmonology at Yashoda Hospitals, the hospital where he now practises.

That sequence, a national board qualification in Mumbai, a UK examination and then an interventional fellowship at his current hospital, is what puts bronchoscopy and airway stenting on a list that also includes the paediatric side of the specialty.

He won the Prof. Dr. S. N. Gaur's Young Scientist Award in 2021, presented at NAPCON in Varanasi, and held an ERS silver sponsorship at the European Respiratory Society Congress in London in 2016.

His memberships cover the field in India and abroad: the Indian Chest Society, the National College of Chest Physicians, the Indian Association of Bronchology, the European Respiratory Society, the American College of Chest Physicians and the Asia Pacific Society of Respirology.

dr-sridhar-r.bio:
Dr. Sridhar R is an Interventional Pulmonologist at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with lung cancer diagnosis and staging.

His list is interventional and medical. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting, which are also the procedures used to diagnose and stage lung cancer. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, complex pulmonary infection and post-tuberculosis lung disease, and the sleep work obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at Mahatma Gandhi Medical College in Puducherry and took his fellowship in interventional pulmonology at Apollo Hospitals in Chennai.

Much of his record is academic rather than clinical. He is a faculty member on DNB and fellowship programmes, so he teaches both general respiratory trainees and those specialising further. He is associate editor of the Journal of Association of Pulmonary Technologists and a reviewer for the European Respiratory Society, which places him on both sides of the publication process, and he has published over 20 articles in indexed journals.

He is also a national speaker and an organiser of pulmonology conferences, and an active leader and mentor in national medical workshops. Teaching, editing, reviewing and organising, taken together with an interventional list, describe a pulmonologist whose work reaches other clinicians as well as patients.

He practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, having trained at Apollo Hospitals in the same city.

dr-s-suresh-sagadevan.bio:
Dr. S Suresh Sagadevan is Clinical Lead and Consultant at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with interventional pulmonology, sleep medicine and pre- and post-transplant care for lung transplantation.

His list follows those four headings. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension and complex pulmonary infection. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea and CPAP titration, and lung transplantation sits at the end of the range.

He holds MBBS and an MD in respiratory medicine, in which he was university topper. Two international fellowships follow: the FCCP of the American College of Chest Physicians and the FAPSR of the Asian Pacific Society of Respirology. He also holds a GCP-NIDA Clinical Trials Network certificate, a research qualification rather than a clinical one, which sits apart from the rest of his record.

His award record includes first prize in the thoracoscopy quiz at RESPICON India 2018 in New Delhi, and two recent listings: Outlook Best Doctors South 2023 as best pulmonologist, and Best Eminent Doctors South 2024 in the same category.

Pre- and post-transplant care being named on his profile alongside interventional pulmonology means his involvement in transplantation covers the assessment and follow-up around the operation rather than the surgery itself. He practises at Gleneagles Global Health City in Chennai.

dr-jayaraman-s.bio:
Dr. Jayaraman S is a Senior Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list is medical respiratory work with two procedures alongside it. He performs bronchoscopy and medical thoracoscopy, and manages chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea and complex pulmonary infection. Drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease both appear, so the active disease and the scarring it leaves behind are treated in the same practice.

He read MBBS at Tirunelveli Medical College in 1992 and took the DTCD, the diploma in tuberculosis and chest diseases, at Madras Medical College in 2000. In 2005 he became a Fellow of the American College of Chest Physicians.

His memberships run wider than most and cover each part of his list. He belongs to the Indian Chest Society and the Indian Association of Bronchology and Interventional Pulmonology for the respiratory and procedural work, the Indian Sleep Disorder Association and the World Sleep Society for the sleep work, and the American Thoracic Society and the Indian Medical Association more generally. Two separate sleep bodies, one national and one international, sit behind the obstructive sleep apnea on his list.

A diploma in tuberculosis and chest diseases taken in Chennai, an American fellowship five years later, and two decades of practice since describe a physician whose training began with tuberculosis at a time when it dominated the specialty, and whose list still carries both its resistant and its late forms. He practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai.

dr-gargi-maitra.bio:
Dr. Gargi Maitra is a Senior Consultant at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience in pulmonology.

Her list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures, alongside severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection, drug-resistant tuberculosis, obstructive sleep apnea evaluation and living with chronic lung disease.

She read MBBS at North Bengal Medical College as a gold medallist and took her MD in respiratory medicine at Government Medical College, Amritsar, in 2011. Her critical care training followed: the IDCCM taken as super-speciality training at PGI in Rohtak, and ELSO certification as an ECMO trained specialist. Her training in interventional pulmonology and rigid bronchoscopy was at Mahidol University in Thailand.

ECMO certification and a critical care diploma alongside rigid bronchoscopy describe a practice that reaches into the intensive care unit rather than stopping at the outpatient clinic, and her editorial work confirms it: she is co-editor of a book on bronchoscopy in the ICU, the point where those two parts of her training meet.

She has also co-authored several book chapters and has multiple publications in national and international journals. Her record notes that she actively conducts and organises continuing medical education, workshops and conferences at national level, so the teaching runs alongside the clinical work rather than after it.

She practises at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurugram.

dr-chandrakanth-tarke.bio:
Dr. Chandrakant Tarke is a Consultant at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad, with more than 11 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures, alongside interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection, obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease.

His qualifications were taken in sequence rather than in parallel. After MBBS he took an MD in general medicine, then moved into the specialty with the DNB in respiratory medicine and the DM in pulmonary medicine, adding MNAMS and an EBUS fellowship. He began in general medicine before the respiratory training, and that is what puts a broad medical base under a list that is now entirely chest work.

His award record is concentrated in a single year and then extends past it. In 2016 he took third prize for the NCCP (I) Prof. S.N. Gaur Young Scientist Award, given for the best clinical research paper presentation at NAPCON in Mumbai that November, and first prize in the NAPCON national quiz at the same meeting. Earlier that year he had won first prize in the regional quiz scholarship competition in respiratory diseases for Delhi NCR. In November 2020 he received the Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial Excellence Award.

Taking both a research paper prize and a national quiz at the same conference is unusual, since the two test very different things. He practises at Apollo Health City in Jubilee Hills.

dr-deepika-ramachandran.bio:
Dr. Deepika Ramachandran is a Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 7 years of experience in pulmonology.

Her list is broader than her years suggest. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, medical thoracoscopy, cryo-lung biopsy and airway stenting. The medical work covers interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension, complex pulmonary infection, drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease, and she is part of lung transplantation care. Cryo-lung biopsy alongside interstitial lung disease is the pairing that matters there, since it is the tissue diagnosis those cases often need.

She read MBBS at Saveetha Medical College in Chennai and took her MD in pulmonary medicine at Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research, also in Chennai, as a gold medallist. She added the DNB in pulmonary medicine from the National Board of Examinations and the European Diploma in Respiratory Medicine from the European Respiratory Society.

Her awards begin in training and continue into practice. She took third place at TAPCON 2018 for a paper on APACHE II in acute respiratory failure and best case report presentation at the Clinical Society Meet in Chennai the same year, and MGM Healthcare named her Young Achiever of the Year in 2022.

She has research presentations and publications at national and international forums, and serves as faculty, presenter, panelist and workshop moderator at major pulmonology conferences. She practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai.

dr-sreenivasan-v.bio:
Dr. Sreenivasan V is a Consultant in the Department of Pulmonary Critical Care and Lung Transplantation at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with interventional pulmonology and sleep medicine.

His list runs across all three. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical work covers interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection and drug-resistant tuberculosis, and he is part of lung transplantation care. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at Siddhartha Medical College in Vijayawada between 1993 and 1999, took the DTCD at Kurnool from 2001 to 2003, and the DNB in respiratory medicine at Bhilai Steel Plant Hospital in Chattisgarh from 2004 to 2006. A fellowship in HIV medicine with GHTM and the CDC followed in 2006 and 2007, and he added the IDCCM in critical care medicine in 2017 and a diploma in diabetology.

That HIV fellowship is the unusual entry, and it sits with a list that includes drug-resistant tuberculosis and complex pulmonary infection. He won first prize for a poster presentation at the National HIV Conference in 2009.

His hospital record traces the same path: Hindu Mission Hospital from 2007 to 2009, the Hyderabad Erragadda Chest Hospital from 2009 to 2011, and now Gleneagles Global Health City in Chennai, where the department covers critical care and transplantation alongside general respiratory work.

dr-aishwarya-rajkumar.bio:
Dr. Aishwarya Rajkumar is a Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 15 years of experience in pulmonology.

Her list covers bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, medical thoracoscopy and airway stenting, alongside interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, pulmonary hypertension, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection and post-tuberculosis lung disease. Lung transplantation sits at the end of that range, and interstitial lung disease and pulmonary hypertension are among the conditions that lead to it.

She read MBBS and took her MD in pulmonary medicine at SRM Medical College and Research Centre in Chennai. Her transplant training was taken twice over, in two programmes: a fellowship at the Vienna Lung Transplant Program, and a fellowship at the Toronto Lung Transplant Program, where she also took the DRCPSC of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada. Her advanced EBUS training was with the American College of Chest Physicians.

Two lung transplant programmes on two continents, with a diplomate qualification of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada taken alongside one of them, is a concentration of transplant training that few respiratory physicians hold, and it explains a list that runs from routine bronchoscopy through to transplantation.

Her recognition has come from outside the specialty as well as within it. She received the Times of India Power Women Award in 2021 for excellence in pulmonology and a Women Achiever Award from SRM University, the institution where she trained, in 2023.

Alongside MGM Healthcare she has been affiliated with Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre in Chennai.

dr-sandeep-garg.bio:
Dr. Sandeep Garg is Principal Consultant and Unit Head of Pulmonology at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with sleep medicine and critical care.

His list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting, alongside severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, complex pulmonary infection, drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He took his MD in pulmonary medicine at Dr. D Y Patil University in Pune, and his advanced training in interventional bronchoscopy on a European Respiratory Society course at Athens in 2012.

His research record dates from the same period as that training. He presented a poster at the European Respiratory Congress in Barcelona in 2010 and a research paper at NAPCON in 2011 covering intrapleural fibrinolysis in patients with synpneumonic effusions and the impact of quinolone use in tuberculosis cases. Both of those topics sit directly on his current list, the first with pleural infection and the second with drug-resistant tuberculosis. He also took first position in an inter-college quiz competition organised by the Chest Research Foundation at B J Medical College in Pune in 2010, and has made multiple research presentations at national and international conferences.

Alongside Fortis Hospital at Shalimar Bagh he has been affiliated with Max Super Specialty Hospital in the same area and Shri Aggarsain International Hospital in Rohini.

dr-l-harish-rao.bio:
Dr. L. Harish Rao is a Consultant Clinical and Interventional Pulmonologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with interventional pulmonology.

His list covers bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, medical thoracoscopy and airway stenting, alongside severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis and complex pulmonary infection. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea with CPAP titration and management.

He read MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal in 2013 and took his MD in pulmonary medicine at Gandhi Medical College in Hyderabad in 2018.

His presented work runs through those training years and covers both common and rare disease. He carried out a study assessing exercise-induced desaturation in adult patients with COPD on the six-minute walk test, a bedside measure used in the condition that heads his list. He presented a research paper on Kartagener's syndrome at NAPCON 2016 in Mumbai, a case report on post varicella pneumonia at NAPCON 2017 in Kolkata, and a case report on primary thoracic Ewing's sarcoma at KCS TS RESPICON 2018, where he also received a certificate of appreciation for taking first prize in poster presentation.

Three national or state conference presentations in three consecutive years, each on a different condition, is a steady record for a physician at this stage.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals at Hitec City he has been affiliated with Archana Hospital in Miyapur and Sri Harsha Hospital in Kukatpally.

dr-amit-kumar.bio:
Dr. Amit Kumar is a Consultant at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in Delhi NCR, with more than 7 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with sleep medicine.

His list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures, alongside chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, interstitial lung disease, complex pulmonary infection, drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at KMC Mangalore, Manipal University, and took the DNB in respiratory medicine at the Rajan Babu Institute for Pulmonary Medicine and Tuberculosis in Delhi. His critical care qualification, the DRNB, was taken at Fortis Escorts Hospital in Faridabad, a hospital he remains affiliated with.

A respiratory national board qualification followed by a second one in critical care is the training behind a list that includes both outpatient chronic disease and the procedures used on acutely unwell patients. He has also completed certified workshops in bronchoscopy, thoracoscopy, critical care ultrasonography, lung ultrasound and sleep medicine, which between them cover each strand of that list: the airway work, the pleural work, the bedside imaging and the sleep studies.

Training at a dedicated tuberculosis and pulmonary medicine institute is reflected in a list that carries both drug-resistant tuberculosis and the lung disease left behind after it.

He is a member of the American College of Chest Physicians and the Chest Council of India, and is registered with the Delhi Medical Council and the Medical Council of India. He practises at Fortis Hospital in Shalimar Bagh.

dr-manisha-mendiratta.bio:
Dr. Manisha Mendiratta is Director and Head of Pulmonology at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience. Her profile records pulmonology together with interventional pulmonology, sleep medicine, and tuberculosis and respiratory diseases.

Her list follows those four headings. The interventional work is bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration and airway stenting. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary hypertension and complex pulmonary infection. The tuberculosis work covers the drug-resistant form and the lung disease that follows it, and the sleep work obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

She read MBBS at Government Medical College, Patiala, between June 1998 and December 2002, and took her MD in tuberculosis and respiratory diseases at the same college under Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot, from May 2005 to May 2008. A postgraduate degree named for tuberculosis rather than for pulmonology is what places the disease as a subspecialty on her profile rather than as one item on a list.

Her hospital record runs through several Delhi institutions. She has previously been at Max Hospital in Shalimar Bagh, at Saroj Hospital, at MAH, and at the Patel Chest Institute, before her current directorship at Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad.

She is a member of the Indian Chest Society and of the European Respiratory Society.

dr-tapaswi-krishna-kattragada.bio:
Dr. Tapaswi Krishna Kattragada is a Consultant Transplant Pulmonologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 19 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with lung transplant work.

His list reflects that title. Alongside bronchoscopy and airway stenting he manages interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, pulmonary hypertension, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection and post-tuberculosis lung disease, and he is part of lung transplantation care. Interstitial lung disease and pulmonary hypertension are two of the conditions that bring patients to transplant assessment, and both sit on the same list.

He read MBBS at Kasturba Medical College in Mangalore between 1999 and 2005 and took his MD at Narayana Medical College in Nellore from 2007 to 2010. His critical care fellowship, the FICCM, was taken at Apollo Hospitals, and his postgraduate certificate in lung transplant under the EHEA framework at the Medical University of Vienna.

A transplant certificate taken at the Medical University of Vienna, added to a critical care fellowship, is the combination behind a consultant post defined by transplantation rather than by general respiratory medicine.

His hospital record spans both states in which he trained and practises. Alongside Yashoda Hospitals at Somajiguda he has been affiliated with Fortis Hospitals and Kamineni Hospitals at King Koti in Hyderabad, with Narayana Medical College in Nellore where he took his MD, and with Apollo Hospitals where he took his fellowship.

dr-kapil-iyer.bio:
Dr. Kapil Iyer is a Transplant Consultant and Pulmonologist at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 16 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures, alongside severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary arterial hypertension and complex pulmonary infection. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation and CPAP titration.

His qualifications are the longest part of his record and were examined in three countries. After MBBS he took an MD in pulmonary medicine and the DNB in the same subject, so his specialist training was examined twice in India, and he holds MNAMS as a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences. The MRCP followed from the Royal College of Physicians in the United Kingdom and the FCCP from the American College of Chest Physicians.

Two further qualifications cover the sleep side of his practice: the FAPSR, a fellowship in advanced pulmonary and sleep medicine and respiratory care, and the DSMRE, a diploma in sleep medicine and respiratory education. Sleep medicine being examined separately, twice, sits behind the obstructive sleep apnea evaluation and CPAP work on his list rather than leaving it as an extension of general respiratory practice.

Eight postgraduate qualifications across Indian, UK and American systems, on a consultant post defined by transplantation, describe a physician whose training was tested repeatedly before he took the role. He practises at Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai.

dr-pravin-taware.bio:
Dr. Pravin Taware is a Consultant Pulmonologist at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 9 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with interventional pulmonology and sleep medicine.

His list is unusually procedural. Alongside flexible bronchoscopy he performs rigid bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound, transbronchial needle aspiration, medical thoracoscopy and airway stenting. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, complex pulmonary infection, drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease, and the sleep work obstructive sleep apnea, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS at Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital in Sion, Mumbai, and took his MD in respiratory medicine at KEM Hospital in the same city. His fellowship in interventional pulmonology, recorded as the EDRM, was taken at Coimbatore.

The fourth qualification on his record is the unusual one. His diploma in pediatric sleep medicine was taken at the Shishuka Institute in Bangalore in collaboration with the University of Colorado. Sleep medicine in children is a separate field from the adult form, and holding a diploma in it alongside an interventional fellowship gives his practice two distinct specialist strands rather than one.

His memberships follow the procedural side: the Indian Association for Bronchology, the World Association for Bronchology and Interventional Pulmonology, the Chest Council of India and the European Respiratory Society. Two bronchology bodies, one national and one worldwide, sit behind the rigid bronchoscopy and thoracoscopy on his list. He practises at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel, Mumbai.

dr-vivek-singh.bio:
Dr. Vivek Singh is Director of Pulmonology and Transplant Pulmonology at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list is built around the transplant service. Alongside lung transplant surgery and lung transplantation he performs diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy and airway stenting, and manages interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, bronchiectasis, pulmonary arterial hypertension, complex pulmonary infection, post-tuberculosis lung disease and living with chronic lung disease.

That last item is worth reading alongside the rest. A transplant service sees patients for years before an operation and for years afterward, and living with chronic lung disease is the part of the work that covers the time between.

He took his MD in respiratory medicine at S.N. Medical College in Agra, and his fellowship in lung transplant at the University of Toronto.

His hospital record is broad and spans two cities. Alongside Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram he has been affiliated with FMRI and Columbia Asia Hospital in Gurgaon, with Max Healthcare in New Delhi, and with KIMS in Hyderabad.

Interstitial lung disease, pulmonary arterial hypertension and bronchiectasis all appear on his list as conditions in their own right, and all three are among the reasons a patient is referred for transplant assessment, so the general respiratory work and the transplant work on his profile describe one practice rather than two.

dr-prasanna-kumar-thomas.bio:
Dr. Prasanna Kumar Thomas is a Senior Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 40 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list is medical respiratory work. He manages chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, bronchiectasis, interstitial lung disease and complex pulmonary infection, together with drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease, and he performs airway stenting.

His three degrees were all taken at Madras Medical College in Chennai over eight years. He read MBBS in 1978, took the DTCD, the diploma in tuberculosis and chest diseases, in 1982, and his MD in tuberculosis and chest diseases in 1986. Both postgraduate qualifications are named for tuberculosis, which was how the specialty was organised at the time he entered it, and his list still carries both the drug-resistant form of the disease and the damage it leaves in the lungs afterward.

More than four decades of practice since that MD places him among the longest-serving physicians in the specialty on this platform.

His memberships cover the field at three levels. He belongs to the Tamilnadu Association of Pulmonologists at state level, the Indian Medical Association nationally, and the European Respiratory Society and the American Thoracic Society internationally. Two international respiratory societies alongside a state association describe a practice that has kept contact with the wider field while staying in one city.

He practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai.

dr-rajesh-k-chawla.bio:
Dr. Rajesh K Chawla is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience. His profile records pulmonology together with critical care medicine and sleep medicine.

His list covers all three. The procedural work is diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, airway stenting and medical pleural procedures. The medical work covers severe asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, interstitial lung disease, bronchiectasis, complex pulmonary infection and drug-resistant tuberculosis, and the sleep work obstructive sleep apnea evaluation and CPAP titration.

He holds MBBS and an MD in pulmonology, and three further qualifications that sit on the critical care side: the FCCM of the American College of Critical Care Medicine, the FCCP of the American College of Chest Physicians, and the European Diploma in Intensive Care. Two American fellowships and a European diploma, two of them in intensive care rather than respiratory medicine, explain why critical care is named on his profile as a specialty in its own right.

His standing in that field is recorded directly. He was President of the Indian Society of Critical Care Medicine from 2010 to 2012, and he received the President Citation Award of the Society of Critical Care Medicine in the USA.

Holding the presidency of the national critical care society for a two-year term, and being cited by its American counterpart, places his work beyond his own unit. He practises at Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals in Delhi.

dr-abhishek-singh-chauhan.bio:
Dr. Abhishek Singh Chauhan is an Associate Consultant at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience in pulmonology.

His list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, endobronchial ultrasound and medical pleural procedures, alongside interstitial lung disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, complex pulmonary infection and living with chronic lung disease. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

He read MBBS and took his MD in pulmonary medicine at JIPMER in Puducherry, then his DM in pulmonary, critical care and sleep medicine at AIIMS in New Delhi. A super-specialty degree that names all three fields is what puts bronchoscopy, chronic disease management and sleep studies on the same list.

Two entries on his record are written work rather than clinical. He contributed to the Indian EBUS guidelines during his tenure at AIIMS, and endobronchial ultrasound remains on his own list of procedures, so he helped set the national standard for a technique he performs. He also contributed a book chapter on COVID-19 to the second edition of Pulmonary Update, published by Peepee Publishers.

Living with chronic lung disease appearing among his listed areas is worth noting alongside the procedures. It covers the long-term care of patients whose disease will not resolve, which is a different kind of work from the diagnostic bronchoscopy at the other end of his list.

He practises at Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram and at Medanta Mediclinic in Defence Colony and on Golf Course.

dr-shubhi-singhal.bio:
Dr. Shubhi Singhal is an Attending Consultant at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 8 years of experience. Her profile records pulmonology together with sleep medicine.

Her list covers diagnostic and therapeutic bronchoscopy, medical pleural procedures and airway stenting, alongside the management of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, severe asthma, interstitial lung disease, complex pulmonary infection, drug-resistant tuberculosis and post-tuberculosis lung disease. The sleep work covers obstructive sleep apnea evaluation, polysomnography and CPAP titration.

She took her MD in pulmonary medicine at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi and the DNB in respiratory medicine, so her specialist training was examined twice, and she was awarded MNAMS as a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences in 2023.

Her written work sits on the pleural side of her list. She authored a chapter on the approach to pleural effusion in a postgraduate textbook on pleural diseases, and medical pleural procedures are among the procedures she performs, so the chapter covers ground she works in. She also has multiple publications in national and international peer-reviewed journals.

An AIIMS postgraduate degree, a national board qualification in the same subject and academy membership within eight years of practice describe a physician whose training has been examined at each stage rather than assumed.

She practises at Medanta — The Medicity in Gurugram.

dr-penmetsa-vijay-varma.bio:
Dr. Penmetsa Vijay Varma is a Consultant Nephrologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with paediatric nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and nephrotic syndrome, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and the full arc of transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through post-transplant follow-up and graft dysfunction. Paediatric chronic kidney disease and paediatric dialysis sit alongside the adult work.

He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College in Hyderabad between 2002 and 2008, took his MD in general medicine at Kamineni Institute of Medical Sciences in Narketpally from 2009 to 2012, and his DM in nephrology at M S Ramaiah Medical College in Bangalore from 2012 to 2015. He also completed the ISN-ANIO clinical nephropathology certificate programme between March 2014 and January 2015, which is training in reading the biopsy rather than only taking it.

His published work follows from that. He has co-authored papers on steroid therapy in immunoglobulin A-dominant poststaphylococcal glomerulonephritis, on unusual fungal infections and abrupt anuria in renal transplant recipients, on leishmaniasis in a transplant patient, on hypertension in chronic kidney disease, and on histologic patterns of primary adult onset nephrotic syndrome. Two of his larger studies are case series on kidney injury in pregnancy: a review of 99 cases of postpartum acute kidney injury, and an analysis of 165 pregnancy-related cases.

He won a gold medal from Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences in his final MBBS year and paper prizes at the annual NAK conferences in 2014 and 2015.

dr-d-k-agarwal.bio:
Dr. D.K. Agarwal is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers the medical kidney and the transplant. The general nephrology work is chronic kidney disease management, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, along with haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and percutaneous renal biopsy. The transplant work is pre-transplant evaluation, post-transplant follow-up and immunosuppression management.

Several further areas are named separately on his record: acute nephrology emergencies, renal clearance evaluations, kidney stones assessed from the nephrology side, proteinuria and aggressive nephritis, pre- and post-dialysis management, resistant hypertension, and renal diet counselling. That last item is worth noting, since diet is a large part of how chronic kidney disease is managed between clinic visits.

His qualifications run from MBBS through an MD in medicine to two separate specialist qualifications in nephrology, the DM and the DNB, followed by a fellowship in transplant nephrology. Holding both the DM and the DNB in the same subject means the specialty was examined twice before the transplant training began.

His record notes recognition for his contributions to nephrology by national and international medical bodies, awards for excellence in transplant nephrology and patient care, peritoneal dialysis related academic awards, and recognition by professional societies in the field including the Indian Society of Nephrology. He has also received multiple awards for research publications and best paper or presentation awards at national nephrology conferences.

dr-p-s-vali.bio:
Dr. P.S. Vali is a Senior Consultant Nephrologist and Transplant Physician at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 23 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplantation.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

He read MBBS at Siddhartha Medical College in Vijayawada in 2003, took his MD in general medicine at Kurnool Medical College in 2007, and his DM in nephrology at Osmania Medical Hospital in Hyderabad in 2010.

His student record is one of the strongest on this platform. He won ten gold medals in MBBS, including the Dr. K.N. Rao Gold Medal as university topper in the final year, the Raja Ratna Gold Medal and cash award as best outgoing student of NTR University of Health Sciences, and the Dr. C. Sita Devi and C.R.R.M Reddy Endowment Award as best outgoing student of his college in 2003. He was university topper again in his MD in 2007 and took a best paper award at APICON 2006. Later recognition includes a Best Doctor Award from the Lions Club in 2018 and an Indywood Medical Excellence Award the same year.

He is a regional board member for the South East Asia region of the International Society of Nephrology and a member of its education social media group, and belongs to the Indian Society of Nephrology. He has also worked at Osmania Hospital and Medical College and the Asian Institute of Nephrology and Urology.

dr-rajasekara-chakravarthi-madarasu.bio:
Dr. Rajasekara Chakravarthi Madarasu is Senior Consultant, Clinical Director and Head of the Department of Nephrology and Transplant Services at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 30 years of experience.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

He read MBBS at JSSMC, University of Mysore, in 1992 and completed his internship at the same hospital, took his MD in internal medicine there in 1997, and his DNB in nephrology at Apollo Hospitals, Chennai, in 1999.

His research record is concentrated in dialysis and critical care nephrology. He won the Oreopoulos Award for the best paper at II PDSI in Hyderabad in August 1998 and the Tanker Award for the best paper at the ISN annual conference in Delhi in December 2007, and held travel grants to the 47th annual conference of JSDT in July 2002 and the 5th Prevention of Renal Disease Conference in Toronto in September 2006.

He has published in Kidney International, Contributions to Nephrology, Blood Purification, the Indian Heart Journal and the ADQI Consensus series, and holds memberships and research collaborations with international nephrology bodies including the Acute Dialysis Quality Initiative consortium. Consensus work of that kind is how dialysis practice is standardised across centres, which is a different contribution from a single-centre study.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals he has worked at Star Hospitals and Care Hospitals in Hyderabad and at Apollo Hospitals in Chennai.

dr-shruti-tapiawala.bio:
Dr. Shruti Tapiawala is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 25 years of experience in nephrology.

Her list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, lupus nephritis, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

She took her MD in internal medicine at B.Y.L. Nair Hospital and T.N. Medical College in Mumbai and the DNB in nephrology. Three fellowships follow, and all three are transplant or dialysis focused. Her two-year adult nephrology fellowship at the University Health Network in Toronto centred on home haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and lupus nephritis, all three of which remain on her list. She then held a multi-organ transplant fellowship of the American Society of Transplantation, and a fellowship in HLA medicine and advanced transplant diagnostics at Toronto Medical Labs.

That last fellowship is the unusual one. HLA medicine is the tissue-matching science that decides whether a donor and recipient are compatible, and a nephrologist trained in it brings the laboratory side of transplantation into the clinic.

Her paper prizes span a decade of Indian Society of Nephrology meetings: first place for best oral presentation at the 32nd annual conference in December 2001, first place for best oral paper at the annual conference in 2011, and two second places at west zone chapter conferences. She has published on systemic sclerosis with lung involvement, on electrocardiographic diagnosis and on ophthalmic manifestations in HIV infection, and previously worked at Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital.

dr-e-ravi.bio:
Dr. E. Ravi is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 22 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad between January 1999 and October 2004, took his MD in general medicine at Gandhi Hospital and Gandhi Medical College from 2005 to 2008, and worked as a medical registrar in general medicine and acute medical care at Yashoda Hospital in Malakpet before his DM in nephrology at Osmania General Hospital from August 2009 to July 2012.

His examination record is unusually consistent. He placed second statewide in his postgraduate degree examinations in 2008, took first rank out of seventy candidates in the super-speciality entrance examination for DM nephrology in 2009, and scored highest statewide in the super-speciality examinations in 2012.

His research covers three distinct areas. He presented a paper on C4d staining in allograft biopsies at ISOT, a marker used in reading transplant rejection; his postgraduate research was on neurological involvement in chronic kidney disease; and he has also worked on kidney involvement in patients with skeletal fluorosis, a condition tied to the regions his practice serves.

Alongside KIMS Hospitals he has worked at Apollo Hospitals and Kamineni Hospitals at L.B. Nagar in Hyderabad and in the department of nephrology at DCMS.

dr-tanmay-pandya.bio:
Dr. Tanmay Pandya is Head of Department and Director of Nephrology and Renal Transplantation at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplantation and vascular access.

That third item shapes his list. Vascular access is the surgical route through which dialysis is delivered, and it sits alongside haemodialysis, chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, percutaneous renal biopsy and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

He read MBBS at Medical College, The M S University, Baroda, as a gold medallist and took his MD in general medicine at the same college. His DM in nephrology was at IKDRC-ITS under Gujarat University, where he was again a gold medallist. Two gold medals, one at the start of his training and one at the end of it, book-end a decade of study.

He was also named a Distinguished Research Fellow by the American Society of Transplantation.

His hospital record traces a career across Delhi. He has worked at Batra Hospital and Medical Research Centre, at Fortis Escorts Heart Institute in Okhla and Fortis Flt. Lt. Rajan Dhall Hospital in Vasant Kunj, and with DaVita Care India at Primus Super Specialty Hospital, before his current directorship at Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad.

He is a member of the Indian Society of Nephrology, the International Society of Nephrology and the Indian Society of Organ Transplant.

dr-dilip-m-babu.bio:
Dr. Dilip M Babu is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 24 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and nephrotic syndrome, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through post-transplant follow-up. Paediatric chronic kidney disease and paediatric dialysis sit alongside the adult work.

All three of his degrees were taken in Mumbai. He read MBBS at Seth G.S. Medical College and K.E.M. Hospital in 2000, took his MD in internal medicine at Grant Medical College and J.J. Hospital in 2004, and returned to K.E.M. for his DM in nephrology in 2008. He placed third in the MD examinations of the University of Mumbai and twelfth in India in the DM entrance examination.

His research from those years is transplant work, presented in successive conference seasons. He gave podium presentations at the West Zone Nephrology Meet in 2006 on transplant renal vein thrombosis and in 2008 on determinants of coronary calcification in end-stage renal disease, the latter winning the Burjis Khurshedji Award for best paper. Between them he presented posters on post-transplant urinary tract infection at ISOT in Bangalore in October 2007 and, extended to its effect on graft function at one year, at ISNCON in Delhi that December.

Taking the same question from a poster to a one-year outcome study is how a clinical observation becomes evidence. He is a member of the Indian Society of Nephrology and the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation.

dr-gandhe-sridhar.bio:
Dr. Gandhe Sridhar is Director of Nephrology and Transplantation at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplantation.

His list is transplant-heavy. Alongside chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, continuous renal replacement therapy and percutaneous renal biopsy, he performs living donor, deceased donor and ABO-incompatible kidney transplantation, and covers pre-transplant evaluation, post-transplant follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

The volumes on his record are specific. He has been involved in more than 600 renal transplants, which his profile places in the top tier of practising transplant nephrologists in south India, and more than 90 of those were ABO-incompatible, a category that requires the recipient's antibodies to be removed before an otherwise mismatched donor can be used. He was also the first to establish the SWAP kidney transplantation registry in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, the mechanism by which incompatible pairs are matched with each other.

His research record includes nine indexed publications, among them a randomised controlled trial in the Clinical Journal of the American Society of Nephrology, and work on focal segmental glomerulosclerosis in renal allografts in the Indian Journal of Nephrology and on the clinical and histological correlation of diabetic nephropathy. He has given more than 20 international conference presentations across five countries, including the World Congress of Nephrology at Milan in 2009 and Vancouver in 2011, the ISN Asian Chapter Meeting at Beijing in 2009 and the ISPD World Congress in Mexico in 2010.

He has also worked at Star Hospitals in Banjara Hills and Nanakramguda.

dr-shyam-bihari-bansal.bio:
Dr. Shyam Bihari Bansal is Vice Chairman of the Institute of Nephrology and Kidney Transplant at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in nephrology.

His list is built around transplantation and dialysis. It covers ABO-incompatible kidney transplantation, pre-transplant evaluation, post-transplant follow-up, immunosuppression management and graft dysfunction, alongside haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, continuous renal replacement therapy, dialysis catheter placement and management, chronic kidney disease management, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis and percutaneous renal biopsy.

He holds MBBS, an MD in general medicine and a DM in nephrology, and trained in nephrology at SGPGIMS Lucknow. He is a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of London, a Fellow of the American Society of Nephrology since 2020, and a Fellow of the Indian Society of Nephrology since 2016.

Two figures on his record describe the scale of the work. He has managed over 3,000 kidney transplant recipients, and has more than 140 published papers carrying over 17,600 citations. A citation count of that size means his work is being built on by other groups rather than only added to the literature.

He has been invited faculty at WCN, ADA, ERA and TTS, four of the meetings where transplant and kidney practice is set internationally, and has served as Honorary Secretary of the Delhi Nephrology Society since 2017. His Best Oral Paper Award at the Indian Society of Nephrology conference in 2005 was for work on treating hepatitis C infection in kidney transplant recipients.

dr-senthil-kumar-s.bio:
Dr. Senthil Kumar S is a Consultant Nephrologist at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 16 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, dialysis catheter placement, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

His training crossed three states. He read MBBS at Grant Medical College in Mumbai under Maharashtra University of Health Science between 2004 and 2010, took his MD in general medicine at Rajah Muthiah Medical College, Annamalai University, in Chidambaram from 2014 to 2017, and the DNB in nephrology at Meenakshi Mission Hospital and Research Centre in Madurai from 2018 to 2021. In February 2022 he passed the European Specialty Examination in Nephrology, conducted jointly by the Royal College of Physicians in the UK and ERA-EDTA.

Three further items on his record are courses rather than degrees, and each adds a distinct skill: the ISN-ANIO clinical nephropathology course run through 2019, a research methodology workshop of the Indian Society of Nephrology in late 2020, and the AVATAR interventional nephrology conference in September 2020. Nephropathology, research method and interventional technique cover the reading, the writing and the procedural sides of the specialty.

He secured multiple awards in paper presentations at clinical society meetings held at MMHRC, and has worked at Dr. Kamakshi Memorial Hospital and Bharath Medical College in Chennai, at Meenakshi Mission Hospital in Madurai, and at Jupiter Hospital in Thane and Jeevanti Hospital in Ambernath.

dr-aswini-dutt-t.bio:
Dr. Aswini Dutt T is a Senior Consultant Nephrologist and Transplant Physician at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with transplant-related urology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, ABO-incompatible kidney transplantation, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

He read MBBS at Katuri Medical College under NTR Health University, took his MD in internal medicine at Kasturba Medical College under MAHE University in Manipal, and his DM in nephrology at Osmania Medical College under KNR Health University. He also holds a fellowship in glomerular diseases from the World Kidney Academy, which is the part of his training that matches the glomerulonephritis and nephrotic syndrome on his list.

His student record is exceptional. He was best outgoing student of Katuri Medical College in 2012 and best outgoing student for that year from the Andhra Pradesh Medical Council, and won gold medals in anatomy, biochemistry, pharmacology, medicine and general surgery, along with a gold medal from the department of medicine at K.M.C. Manipal.

He also has a long run of quiz results across different fields: first prize at the zonal fourth haematology quiz, at the infectious diseases CME quiz and at the ISN quiz, second prize at the ASI postgraduate quiz, and first prize in the peritoneal dialysis quiz at PDSICON in Aurangabad in 2018. That last one sits directly on his own list of procedures.

dr-deepak-kumar-panigrahi.bio:
Dr. Deepak Kumar Panigrahi is a Senior Consultant at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplantation.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and nephrotic syndrome, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, living donor kidney transplantation, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

He read MBBS at SCB Medical College in Cuttack, took his MD in internal medicine at Lady Hardinge Medical College in New Delhi, and his DM in nephrology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences. His fellowship in renal transplantation was at Max Hospital, Saket, the hospital where he now practises.

His published work divides into two subjects. The first is diabetic kidney disease: he showed in the Indian Journal of Nephrology in 2021 that the spot urine albumin creatinine ratio can predict cognitive function in type 2 diabetes mellitus, linking a routine kidney measurement to something outside the kidney. The second is COVID-19 in transplant recipients, where he published two retrospective studies from a tertiary care centre in 2022, one on the clinical profile and outcome of the disease and one on its pattern and outcome during the second wave of the pandemic in India.

Transplant recipients on immunosuppression were among the most exposed patients of that period, and two papers tracking them across successive waves come from a service that was managing them throughout.

He is a member of the Indian Society of Nephrology, the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation and the Association of Physicians of India, and previously worked at Narayana Super Speciality Hospital in Gurugram.

dr-gaurav-singhal.bio:
Dr. Gaurav Singhal is an Associate Consultant at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 8 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplant work.

His list is broad for the length of his career. The dialysis work covers haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, continuous renal replacement therapy, dialysis catheter placement and management, dialysis access management and the complications that follow it. The medical work covers chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and percutaneous renal biopsy. The transplant work covers pre-transplant evaluation, post-transplant follow-up, immunosuppression management, ABO-incompatible transplantation and paired kidney exchange, the swap arrangement that matches two incompatible pairs with each other.

He read MBBS at the University College of Medical Sciences under Delhi University, took his MD in internal medicine at Lady Hardinge Medical College, and the DrNB in nephrology at Army Hospital R & R in New Delhi. His record notes him as one of the youngest nephrologists in the country to pass all his entrance examinations consecutively.

His published work is on the rarer end of transplant and kidney medicine. He has co-authored articles in the Armed Forces Medical Journal and with Elsevier on renal limited thrombotic microangiopathy, isolated renal sarcoidosis, and vascular blowout secondary to mucormycosis in a renal transplant recipient, and a paper on parvovirus B19 infection in renal transplant patients in the journal of the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation.

He is a member of the Indian Society of Nephrology, the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation and the Delhi Nephrology Society, and has also worked at Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurugram.

dr-bharat-shah.bio:
Dr. Bharat Shah is Director and Head of the Nephrology Department at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 46 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplant work.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

He read MBBS and took his MD at KEM Hospital in Mumbai, and holds the DNB. Two fellowships in the United States follow, one clinical and one research: a clinical fellowship in nephrology at the University of Cincinnati Medical Centre, and a clinical research fellowship at the New England Medical Center in Boston. In 1997 a French Government Scholarship took him for training in a cadaver kidney transplant program, the deceased-donor side of transplantation that depends on a national organ retrieval system rather than on living donors.

His award-winning papers span nearly a quarter of a century of annual conferences of the Indian Society of Nephrology and the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation, from 1996 to 2020. He has delivered the Dr. V.N. Acharya Oration, the J M Patel Oration and the Khullar Award Oration, three of the named lectures by which the specialty recognises senior figures.

He received the Dronacharya Award from AVATAR in 2018, a name given for teaching rather than for clinical work, and an Olympian Honours Award from Cadila Healthcare-Zydus Group in 1997, the same year as his French scholarship. He practises at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel.

dr-tarun-kumar-saha.bio:
Dr. Tarun Kumar Saha is a Senior Consultant Nephrologist and Transplant Physician at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 32 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplantation.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy and glomerulonephritis, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, ABO-incompatible kidney transplantation, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management. ABO-incompatible transplantation is the part of that list that widens the donor pool, since it allows a transplant to proceed across a blood group barrier that would otherwise rule the donor out.

He holds MBBS, an MD and an MS.

His memberships are unusually complete and each maps to part of his practice. He is a life member of the International Society of Nephrology and the Association of Physicians of India, of the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation for the transplant work, of the Peritoneal Dialysis Society India and the International Society for Hemodialysis for the two forms of dialysis on his list, and of the Indian Medical Association. Holding separate life memberships of a peritoneal dialysis society and a haemodialysis society is a distinction few nephrologists make, and it matches a list that carries both.

His papers have won best paper awards at meetings of the International Society of Nephrology and of The Transplantation Society, and in 2021 the IHW Council gave him its Dronacharya Award. He practises at Yashoda Hospital in Somajiguda, Hyderabad.

dr-col-akhil-mishra-v-s-m.bio:
Dr. Col Akhil Mishra V S M is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplant work.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, kidney transplant surgery and living donor transplantation, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through post-transplant follow-up.

His training was entirely within the military medical system. He read MBBS and took his MD in internal medicine at the Armed Forces Medical College in Pune, and his DM in nephrology at Army Hospital Research and Referral in Delhi. He also holds the DNB in nephrology, MNAMS and FIAMS, so his specialty was examined twice and recognised by two academies.

The letters after his name include one that is not a qualification. The Vishisht Seva Medal was awarded to him by the President of India for distinguished service, a decoration given for the conduct of duty rather than for clinical results.

His research has been recognised on both sides of that career. He received a best research paper award from the Indian Society of Nephrology and a gold medal for research presentation at Army Hospital Research and Referral, and his record notes further awards for academic contributions and clinical excellence from national medical forums and military medical conferences.

He now practises at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Sarita Vihar, New Delhi.

dr-disha-saxena.bio:
Dr. Disha Saxena is a Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 11 years of experience in nephrology.

Her list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and lupus nephritis, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

She read MBBS at Government Medical College in Surat, took her MD in internal medicine at Pt. BDS PGIMS in Rohtak, and her DM in nephrology at SMS Medical College in Jaipur.

Her research is wider than her clinical list, and the two kidney papers in it are the ones that matter most for her practice. In 2024 she published on pregnancy-related acute kidney injury as a cause of chronic kidney disease in developing countries in the Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology of India, and on acute kidney injury in chronic liver disease in northwest India in the Indian Journal of Nephrology. Both describe kidney failure arising from a condition outside the kidney, which is where much of the acute work in the specialty comes from.

Her earlier papers were written from general medicine. They cover gender-specific risk factors and outcomes in amoebic liver abscess in the Indian Journal of Gastroenterology in 2023, late onset seronegative systemic sclerosis in Reumatismo in 2019, the spectrum of macrocytic anaemia in adults in 2018, and a rare association of malaria with cardiomyopathy and thrombotic microangiopathy in the Erciyes Medical Journal the same year.

She is a member of the Indian Society of Nephrology and the Indian Society of Organ Transplantation.

dr-manju-aggarwal.bio:
Dr. Manju Aggarwal is Chief of Medical Services and Chairperson of the Department of Nephrology at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 35 years of experience. Her profile records nephrology together with kidney transplant work.

Her list is concentrated on dialysis and access. It covers haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, dialysis catheter placement and management, dialysis access management and the complications that arise from it, alongside chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, kidney transplantation and graft dysfunction management.

She read MBBS at Lady Hardinge Medical College, University of Delhi, in 1974 and took her MD in internal medicine at Maulana Azad Medical College in 1990. Her fellowship in nephrology was at the University of Minnesota Hospitals and Clinics in Minneapolis in 1992, and she took the Diplomate of National Board in nephrology in 1995. In 2008 she added an MBA in healthcare administration from the Faculty of Management Studies at Delhi University, which is the qualification behind her role as Chief of Medical Services rather than a purely clinical one.

Teaching is the other constant on her record. She has been a designated teacher and thesis guide for the DNB in nephrology at Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals from 2005 to 2012 and at Artemis Health Institute since February 2012, so she has supervised national board trainees continuously for two decades. She is also faculty and a speaker at CMS and postgraduate courses, and chairs and sits on hospital administrative committees at Artemis Health Institute in Sector 51, Gurugram.

dr-parmod-mittal.bio:
Dr. Parmod Mittal is Principal Consultant for Nephrology and Renal Care at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience.

His list covers the medical kidney, the dialysis circuit and the transplant. The medical work is chronic kidney disease management, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and percutaneous renal biopsy. The dialysis work is haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, continuous renal replacement therapy, dialysis catheter placement and management, AV fistula creation and AV fistula surveillance. The transplant work is pre-transplant evaluation, post-transplant follow-up and immunosuppression management.

Making and then watching an AV fistula is the part of that list patients live with longest, since it is the access through which years of dialysis are delivered, and surveillance is what keeps it working.

He read MBBS and took his MD in medicine at PGIMS in Rohtak, the PDCDM at R and R Hospital in Delhi, and his DM in nephrology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi.

One entry on his record is about access to care rather than clinical practice. He was instrumental in establishing two dialysis centres in Delhi through public-private partnership, which his profile describes as enhancing affordable renal care access, and he has received a Health Care Excellence Award for his contributions to kidney care services.

He is a life member of the Indian Society of Nephrology, of its North Zone chapter and of the Delhi Nephrology Society, and practises at Medanta — The Medicity in Gurugram.

dr-dinesh-bansal.bio:
Dr. Dinesh Bansal is Chief of Nephrology for Unit III at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplant work.

His list is almost entirely transplant and access work. The transplant side covers kidney transplant surgery, living donor and ABO-incompatible transplantation, pre-transplant evaluation, post-transplant follow-up and immunosuppression management. The access and dialysis side covers haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, continuous renal replacement therapy, dialysis catheter placement and management, AV fistula creation and AV fistula surveillance.

He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in Delhi, took his MD in internal medicine at the University College of Medical Sciences, and his DM in nephrology at the Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research in Chandigarh. His advanced training in interventional nephrology was taken in London and Chicago.

Interventional nephrology is the sub-field that covers catheters and fistulas, the procedures by which dialysis is actually delivered, and training in it abroad is what puts fistula creation and surveillance on a nephrologist's own list rather than referring them to a surgeon.

His memberships are evenly split between Indian and international bodies: the Indian Society of Nephrology and the Indian Society of Transplantation at home, and the American Society of Nephrology, the International Society of Nephrology and The Transplantation Society abroad. Two transplant societies, one Indian and one international, sit behind a list on which ABO-incompatible transplantation appears.

He practises at Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram.

dr-amit-prakash-nagarik.bio:
Dr. Amit Prakash Nagarik is a Senior Consultant at Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 22 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, dialysis catheter placement and management, AV fistula creation and surveillance, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and immunosuppression management.

He holds an MD in medicine and the DNB in nephrology, and four further periods of training abroad and in India shape the rest of his record. Two are ISPD fellowships in peritoneal dialysis, one at SGPGI in Lucknow and one at Tung Wah Hospital in Hong Kong. The third is an ISN fellowship at Leicester General Hospital in the United Kingdom, and the fourth a visiting fellowship at UCSD Medical Centre in San Diego.

Taking the peritoneal dialysis fellowship twice, in two countries, is the clearest signal on his record. Peritoneal dialysis is the home-based alternative to hospital haemodialysis, and it depends on training patients as much as on treating them.

His awards come from the same field. He received the B. Braun Medical Trust Foundation Scholar Award for outstanding achievement in nephrology, and a development award at the Asia Pacific Congress of Nephrology.

Four international attachments across three continents, on a list that runs from acute kidney injury through dialysis access to transplant follow-up, describe a nephrologist whose training was gathered in several systems. He practises at Medicover Hospitals in Navi Mumbai.

dr-shri-ram-kabra.bio:
Dr. Shri Ram Kabra is Director of the Department of Nephrology and Kidney Transplant Medicine at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with kidney transplant work.

His list covers chronic kidney disease and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, ABO-incompatible kidney transplantation, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through post-transplant follow-up and graft dysfunction management. Graft dysfunction is the part of that list that decides how long a transplant lasts, and it sits at the centre of a practice defined as transplant medicine rather than transplant surgery.

He read MBBS, took his MD in general medicine at Safdurjang Hospital in New Delhi in 2001, and the DNB at the Pushpawati Singhania Research Institute in New Delhi in 2008. Seven years between those two qualifications, with the second taken at a dedicated institute, is the path of a physician who moved into the specialty after establishing himself in general medicine.

His hospital record runs through Faridabad and Delhi. He has previously worked at Sarvodaya Hospital and Research Centre and Asia Central Hospital in Faridabad, at Shanti Mukund Hospital, and at the Pushpawati Singhania Research Institute where he trained. He now directs the department at Marengo Asia Hospital in Faridabad and also practises at Marengo Asia Hospitals in Gurugram.

ABO-incompatible transplantation on his list means his service takes on donor and recipient pairs whose blood groups do not match, which requires the recipient to be prepared before the operation can go ahead.

dr-v-suresh-babu.bio:
Dr. V. Suresh Babu is a Consultant Nephrologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 21 years of experience.

His list is weighted toward dialysis in its several forms. Alongside haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis he provides continuous renal replacement therapy and sustained low-efficiency dialysis, two methods used when a patient is too unstable for a standard session. The medical work covers chronic kidney disease, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and polycystic kidney disease, with percutaneous renal biopsy for diagnosis, and the transplant work covers pre-transplant evaluation and post-transplant follow-up.

He holds an MD and a DM in nephrology.

His research covers three separate areas of the specialty. One is an analysis of 1720 biomixer, a dialysis-side study of the kind that only a high-volume unit can produce. The second is acute renal failure in HELLP syndrome, a complication of pregnancy in which the kidneys fail alongside the liver and the blood count, and the third is renal rickets, the bone disease that follows chronic kidney disease in children.

Taken together, those three subjects span the dialysis circuit, obstetric emergency and paediatric bone disease, which is a wider range than most single-centre research records cover.

He is a member of the Indian Society of Nephrology, the International Society of Nephrology and the ISN Southern Chapter, and practises at Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad.

dr-vairakkani-r.bio:
Dr. Vairakkani R is a Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and nephrotic syndrome, haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and continuous renal replacement therapy, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through post-transplant follow-up.
