Two access procedures are named separately: CAPD catheter insertion for peritoneal dialysis, and central venous permcath insertion for haemodialysis.

He read MBBS and took his MD in general medicine at Madurai Medical College, then his DM in nephrology at Government Stanley Medical College, and also holds the DrNB in nephrology, so his specialty was examined through both routes.

His research has been recognised three times over. He won the best paper award at the 50th annual conference of the Indian Society of Nephrology in 2019 for work on the frusemide stress test, a bedside measure used to judge whether failing kidneys will recover, and took first prize in the quiz competition at the 39th annual conference of the society's southern chapter the same year. He also received the 3rd SVIMS University Gold Medal for an essay on the metabolome and microbiome in kidney disease.

An essay prize on the microbiome sits at the research end of the specialty, while the frusemide stress test belongs at the bedside, and his record carries both.

He has published original articles, review articles and case reports in the Indian Journal of Nephrology and the Brazilian Journal of Nephrology, and practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai.

dr-amit-langote.bio:
Dr. Amit Langote is a Senior Consultant Nephrologist, Kidney Transplant Physician and Hypertension Specialist at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience.

His list covers chronic kidney disease management, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, dialysis catheter placement and management, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and immunosuppression management.

He read MBBS at Government Medical College and Hospital in Miraj under Shivaji University, took the DNB in general medicine at Sir HN Reliance Foundation Hospital in Mumbai, and both the DNB and the DrNB in nephrology at Muljibhai Patel Urological Hospital in Nadiad.

Two further qualifications cover the dialysis side of his practice, and each is unusual. His fellowship in peritoneal dialysis was with the ISPD and APCPD, and his masters in dialysis vascular access, the EU DAVA programme, was taken at the University of Brescia. A formal master's degree in vascular access is rare on an Indian nephrologist's record, and it sits directly behind the catheter placement and management on his list.

His awards are both for presented research. He received a best scientific paper award for a poster at the annual nephrology conference of the Maharashtra chapter of the Indian Society of Nephrology in 2018, and a best paper presentation award at ISNCON 2019 for a nationwide multicentre study on ANCA-associated glomerulonephritis.

A multicentre national study is a different undertaking from a single-centre series, and glomerulonephritis remains on his own list of conditions treated.

dr-amar-vilas-kulkarni.bio:
Dr. Amar Vilas Kulkarni is a Consultant Nephrologist and Internal Medicine Specialist at Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai, in Mumbai, with more than 25 years of experience.

His list carries both sides of that title. The kidney work covers chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, with percutaneous renal biopsy for diagnosis. The dialysis and access work covers haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, dialysis catheter placement and management, AV fistula creation and surveillance, dialysis access management and the complications that arise from it. The transplant work covers pre-kidney transplant evaluation and transplant follow-up.

Access is the strand that stands out. Four separate entries on his list describe creating, watching and repairing the route through which dialysis is delivered, which is the part of the treatment that determines whether a patient can continue it.

He holds MBBS and two national board qualifications, the DNB in medicine and the DNB in nephrology, so he was examined in general medicine before the specialty, which is what his dual designation reflects.

His awards are all for presented work and cluster in one year and one hospital. He took a best paper presentation award at the ISN west zone chapter meeting in Indore in 2016 and a best poster award at ISNCON in Mumbai the same year, and was recognised twice at research days of P. D. Hinduja Hospital and Medical Research Centre, once for best paper of the session.

He practises at Medicover Hospitals in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai.

dr-v-s-reddy.bio:
Dr. V. S. Reddy is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 24 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through post-transplant follow-up.

He read MBBS at Andhra Medical College in Visakhapatnam in 1993, and took both his postgraduate qualifications at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad: the MD in internal medicine in 1998 and the DM in nephrology in 2003.

His two awards come from that same institute and describe two different kinds of merit. He was named best resident in 2001, which is recognition of clinical work, and received the Smt. Lakshmi Kothandaraman Memorial Gold Medal in 2002 for the best published research work, which is recognition of what he wrote while doing it. Taking both within two years is unusual, since residency rarely leaves time for publication.

His hospital record is straightforward. After his DM he worked at Bolleneni Hospitals in Nellore from May 2003 to April 2005, and has been at the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad since May 2005, so two decades of his practice have been in one department.

A single long tenure of that kind means his transplant follow-up and dialysis patients have been under the same physician for years at a time, which is how chronic kidney disease is best managed.

dr-sreedhar-reddy-1.bio:
Dr. Sreedhar Reddy is a Consultant Nephrologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 22 years of experience.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and continuous renal replacement therapy, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

His training took an unusual route into the specialty. He read MBBS at Sree Siddhartha Medical College in Tumkur under Bangalore University, then took the DNB in pediatrics at the Indira Gandhi Institute of Child Health in Bangalore between June 2001 and June 2004, and only afterward the DNB in nephrology at Manipal Hospital in Bangalore from June 2006 to June 2009. A paediatric national board qualification before a nephrology one is a different base from the general medicine route most nephrologists take.

His hospital record reflects both halves of that training. Alongside the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences on Minister Road in Secunderabad, he has worked at Narayana Hrudayalaya – Malla Reddy Hospital and Care Hospitals at Banjara Hills in Hyderabad, at Rainbow Children's Hospital in the same city, and at Vikram Hospitals in Mysore.

A children's hospital sitting among adult tertiary centres on one record is the visible trace of the paediatrics qualification, and the two together describe a nephrologist whose experience covers patients at both ends of the age range.

dr-a-anitha-1.bio:
Dr. A Anitha is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, in Bengaluru, with more than 20 years of experience in nephrology.

Her list covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

She holds MBBS and two national board qualifications, the DNB in general medicine and the DNB in nephrology, so the specialty followed a fully examined grounding in internal medicine.

Hypertension and the kidney is the thread running through her research. She won first prize at the South Zone meeting of the International Society of Nephrology for presenting her experience of the clinico-pathological correlation of malignant hypertension and renal failure, and her largest study, a ten-year prospective series from a tertiary centre on renal outcome in patients with accelerated hypertension and renal dysfunction, is recorded as being in the process of publication. A prospective study followed over a decade is a long commitment to a single question.

Her published case work covers rarer ground. She has written on collagen type III diseases in IJPM in March 2016, contributed a nephrology image of intravascular B cell lymphoma to Kidney International in June 2016, and published on fungal urinary tract infection in a neonate in IJN in March 2017.

Those three papers span a hereditary disease, a malignancy presenting through the kidney and an infection in a newborn, which is a wide span for a single record.

dr-mamidi-pranith-ram.bio:
Dr. Mamidi Pranith Ram is a Consultant Nephrologist and Renal Transplant Physician at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 20 years of experience. His profile records nephrology together with AV fistula creation.

His list is one of the most complete in the specialty. The medical work covers chronic kidney disease, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome and lupus nephritis, with percutaneous renal biopsy. The dialysis and access work covers haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, CAPD catheter insertion, central venous permcath insertion and AV fistula creation. The transplant work covers pre-transplant evaluation, post-transplant follow-up, graft dysfunction management, transplant graft biopsy, ABO-incompatible transplantation and paired kidney exchange.

A nephrologist who creates the fistula, inserts both kinds of dialysis catheter and biopsies the transplanted kidney is doing procedural work that is often split between three different services.

He read MBBS at Osmania General Hospital in Hyderabad between 2001 and 2006, and took both his postgraduate qualifications at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi: the MD in internal medicine from 2008 to 2011 and the DM in nephrology from 2014 to 2017.

His practice reaches outside the city. Alongside Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad he is associated with Vijaya Multispeciality Hospital in Siddipet, Bhavani Polyclinic, Medicare Diagnostics in Kothagudem and Medak Nursing Home in Medak, so patients in smaller towns are seen without travelling to the tertiary centre for every visit.

dr-gaurav-sagar.bio:
Dr. Gaurav Sagar is a Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience in nephrology.

His list covers chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, lupus nephritis and polycystic kidney disease, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through follow-up and immunosuppression management.

He holds MBBS, an MD and the DNB.

Most of the rest of his record is presented research, and it has been recognised at every level. He received a best oral presentation award at a national nephrology conference of the Indian Society of Nephrology in 2017, and a best oral paper award from the West Bengal Society for Nephrology. At ISNCON he has taken best poster prizes at multiple sessions and an ISN-ANIO best oral lecture award, and he has received poster awards from the Peritoneal Dialysis Society for interventional nephrology.

His work has also travelled. He was given the India-ISN Best Abstract Award at the decennial ASN Kidney Week of the American Society of Nephrology, and has presented at the Indian Society of Nephrology and at the International Conference on Dialysis.

The pattern across those awards is worth reading. The ISN-ANIO lecture, dialysis access through the interventional nephrology posters and dialysis itself through the international conference are three distinct parts of the specialty, and his presented work covers all of them alongside a clinical list that runs from acute kidney injury to transplant follow-up. He practises at Apollo Hospitals in Delhi.

dr-nikhil-bhasin.bio:
Dr. Nikhil Bhasin is a Consultant Nephrologist and Renal Transplant Physician at Wockhardt Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 5 years of experience.

His list covers chronic kidney disease and glomerulonephritis, haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, percutaneous renal biopsy, and transplant care from pre-transplant evaluation through post-transplant follow-up and graft dysfunction management.

His qualifications are unusually many for the length of his career. After MBBS he took an MD in internal medicine as a gold medallist, then both specialist qualifications in nephrology, the DM and the DNB, so the subject was examined twice. He is also a Fellow of the American Society of Nephrology.

Two further attachments extend that training beyond India. He held a clinical fellowship at the University of Toronto, and a fellowship in glomerular disease with GlomCon in the USA. Glomerular disease is the group of conditions in which the filtering units of the kidney are damaged, and it is diagnosed by biopsy and treated with immune-suppressing drugs rather than by dialysis, so a dedicated fellowship in it sits directly behind the glomerulonephritis and renal biopsy on his list.

A gold medal in internal medicine, two nephrology qualifications, an American fellowship and two international attachments within five years of practice describe a physician whose training has been front-loaded rather than accumulated gradually.

He practises at Wockhardt Hospitals in South Mumbai at Mumbai Central.

dr-ganesh-kumar-mani.bio:
Dr. Ganesh Kumar Mani is Chairman of Cardiac Sciences and Cardiac Surgery at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 47 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with paediatric cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, TAVI and TAVR, LVAD implantation and heart transplant surgery.

He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in Delhi in 1969 and took his MS in general surgery there in 1975, then his MCh in cardiothoracic surgery at Christian Medical College, Vellore, in 1979 and MNAMS in 1980. Four periods of advanced training abroad followed in the mid-1980s: coronary artery bypass surgery under Professor Douglas Baird at Royal Prince Alfred Hospital in Sydney in 1983, heart transplantation under Dr. Victor Chang and Dr. Mark Shanhan at St. Vincent's Hospital in 1984, and paediatric cardiac surgery under Professor Tim Cartmill at the Royal Alexandra Hospital for Sick Children in 1984 and under Dr. Roger Mee at the Royal Children's Hospital in Melbourne in 1985.

He is a fellow of six bodies, including the American College of Surgeons, the Indian Association of Cardiovascular-Thoracic Surgeons and the Indian College of Cardiology.

The President of India conferred the Padma Shri on him in 2013. His earlier honours include the National Citizens Award in 1992 and the National Excellence Award in 1996, and later the Delhi Medical Association Centenary Award in 2014 and an excellence award from MAMC, where he trained, in 2015.

dr-sai-krishna-cheemalapati.bio:
Dr. Sai Krishna Cheemalapati is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 29 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, aortic aneurysm repair and minimally invasive cardiac surgery.

He read MBBS at Andhra Medical College in Visakhapatnam in 1997, took his MS in general surgery at PGIMER Chandigarh in 2001 and his MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery at AIIMS New Delhi in 2004. Three consecutive advanced fellowships in adult cardiac, minimally invasive and mechanical circulatory support followed in the United States: at Virginia Commonwealth University from 2009 to 2010, at Brigham and Women's Hospital under Harvard University from 2010 to 2011, and at Emory University from 2011 to 2013.

Four years of continuous fellowship training across three American centres, all in the same three subjects, is a longer overseas period than most surgeons on this platform record.

His research runs from his MS thesis correlating lung biopsy with pulmonary artery pressure in mitral valve replacement through MCh work on coarctation repair in infancy, normal coronary artery dimensions in Indians, aortic valve repair for rheumatic disease, and extra-anatomic bypass for interrupted aortic arch in adults.

Between 2021 and 2025 he initiated the adult and congenital cardiac surgery programme at ILS Hospital in Tripura. He was inducted as a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons in Chicago in 2016, and is a member of the Society of Thoracic Surgeons.

dr-madhusudhan-m-g.bio:
Dr. Madhusudhan M G is a Consultant Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgeon at Gleneagles HealthCity Chennai, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery and paediatric cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery, and extends to heart transplant surgery, lung transplant surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation.

He read MBBS at JSS Medical College in Mysore between 2004 and 2008, took his MS in general surgery at KVG Medical College in Sullia in 2013 and his MCh in cardiothoracic surgery at the Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences and Research in Bengaluru in 2017. He passed MRCS Part A of the Royal College of Edinburgh in 2024. Between 2019 and 2020 he was an overseas fellow in cardiothoracic surgery at the Royal Melbourne Hospital.

The rest of his record is a dense run of recent courses, and they track the transplant and structural work on his list. He attended a TAVI conference and workshop in Mumbai in 2023, and in 2024 the International ECMO Summit at the Mayo Clinic, ECMO Foundations with ELSO, an EVLA certificate course and a TAVR certificate course in Chennai. In 2025 came an aortic wetlab workshop in Chennai, a heart and lung transplantation workshop in Bangalore, and lung transplantation training at Vienna General Hospital.

ECMO training twice in one year sits behind a transplant list, since extracorporeal support is what keeps those patients alive around the operation. He has also worked at SS-Sparsh Superspeciality Hospitals and Sagar Hospitals in Bengaluru.

dr-anupam-das.bio:
Dr. Anupam Das is Senior Consultant and Head of Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with paediatric cardiac surgery and vascular surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery, along with LVAD implantation and heart transplant surgery.

His qualifications were examined in four systems. After MBBS and an MS in general surgery he took both the MCh and the DNB in cardiothoracic surgery, then the MRCS and the FRCS in cardiothoracic surgery at Edinburgh, the FACS of the American College of Surgeons, and the MEBCTS in adult and congenital cardiac surgery in Europe. He also holds a fellowship in critical care echocardiography under the aegis of the Indian College of Anaesthesiologists and the Indian Association of Cardiovascular-Thoracic Surgeons, and ECMFG certification.

The MEBCTS, a board qualification covering both adult and congenital surgery, matches a profile that carries adult and paediatric cardiac surgery side by side.

His presented work spans both. He has presented papers and posters at the 62nd, 63rd and 68th annual meetings of the Indian Association of Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgeons, at the 7th World Congress of Paediatric Cardiology and Cardiac Surgery in Barcelona, at the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh international conference in Chennai, and in the award section of the 7th annual SMICTSI conference on minimally invasive paediatric cardiac surgery. He has authored over 25 peer-reviewed publications.

dr-nagaradona-sreedhar-reddy.bio:
Dr. Nagaradona Sreedhar Reddy is a Consultant Cardiothoracic Surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 32 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, TAVI and TAVR, and LVAD implantation.

His qualifications were taken in sequence over thirteen years and in two countries. He read MBBS at J.S.S. Medical College in Mysore in 1995, took his MS in general surgery at J.N. Medical College in Belgaum in 1999, the DNB in cardiothoracic surgery at LTM Medical College in Mumbai in 2001 and the MCh at the same college in 2002, then the MRCS in general surgery at Edinburgh University in 2004 and the FRCS in cardiothoracic surgery there in 2008.

His examination record is consistent from school onward. He secured the highest marks in his district at higher secondary level, took distinctions in biochemistry, physiology and surgery at medical school, was best outgoing student in his general surgery postgraduate examination, won the best postgraduate paper award at the Indian Medical Association conference in 1998, and placed first in the MCh cardiothoracic surgery university examination in Mumbai in 2002.

His hospital record follows his qualifications across both systems. He has worked at Royal Sussex County Hospital in Brighton and at UCLH and Hammersmith Hospital in London, and in India at LTM Medical College, Apollo Hospital in Bangalore and Apollo Hospital in Secunderabad, before KIMS Hospitals.

dr-vikram-reddy-aerra.bio:
Dr. Vikram Reddy Aerra is a Senior Consultant Cardiothoracic Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 24 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with interventional aortic procedures.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, and TAVI and TAVR.

He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College in Hyderabad and took his MS in general surgery at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research in Chandigarh, then his MCh in cardiothoracic surgery at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi. His UK qualifications followed: the FRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh, and the FRCS in cardiothoracic surgery from its intercollegiate board.

His published work in the Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery covers two very different problems: the prevention of atrial fibrillation after coronary artery bypass surgery, which is among the commonest complications of the operation that heads his list, and cardiac surgery in patients who have previously had a pneumonectomy, which is among the rarest situations a cardiac surgeon meets.

He has presented at the SCTS annual meeting in Edinburgh, the ATCSA congress in Manila and EACTS in Barcelona, and is a member of the Indian Association of Cardiovascular-Thoracic Surgeons.

His hospital record spans three countries. Alongside Yashoda Hospitals he has worked at Apollo Hospitals, Citizens Hospital and Care Hospital in Hyderabad, at the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital in Enugu, and at the Liverpool Heart and Chest Hospital NHS Trust.

dr-brig-sameer-kumar.bio:
Dr. (Brig) Sameer Kumar is Clinical Director and Head of Cardiothoracic Surgery at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram, in Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with heart transplantation.

His list is one of the widest in the specialty. It covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery, paediatric open heart surgery and neonatal cardiac surgery, and LVAD implantation, heart transplant surgery, lung transplant surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation.

All three of his degrees were taken at the Armed Forces Medical College in Pune: MBBS between 1985 and 1990, an MS in general surgery from 1995 to 1998, and the MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery from 2003 to 2006, where he was first rank holder. The Indian Association of Cardiovascular Thoracic Surgeons awarded him the Reev H Betts Fellowship in paediatric cardiac surgery at AIIMS in 2009, and he was a clinical fellow in heart and lung transplant at University Hospital Wythenshawe in Manchester in 2012.

In 2023 he received the Sena Medal (Distinguished), a presidential award, for establishing two heart transplant programs at Delhi and Pune.

His roles outside the operating theatre match that work. He sat on the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare committee for hospital empanelment for heart transplantation from 2015 to 2020, on a Bureau of Indian Standards technical committee, and on the DNB cardiothoracic surgery specialist board in 2019, and is a section editor of the Indian Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery for heart transplant and extracorporeal life support.

dr-surendra-nath-khanna.bio:
Dr. Surendra Nath Khanna is Chairperson of Adult Cardiac Surgery and Heart-Lung Transplant at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 34 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery, along with LVAD implantation, heart transplant surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation.

Redo bypass surgery sitting alongside transplantation and mechanical support describes a practice that takes on patients whose first operation is behind them and whose options are narrowing.

After MBBS, an MS and the MCh he took four fellowships: the FICS in the USA, the FIACS, FAMS, and the FICC of the Indian College of Cardiology.

His hospital record reaches outside Delhi. Alongside Artemis Hospital in Gurugram he has been associated with San Raffaele Hospital in Milan, with King Edward Memorial Hospital and with Christian Medical College.

His recognition has come largely from bodies concerned with public heart health. The Heart Care Foundation of India gave him a Distinguished Service Award at BSNL Dil ka Darbar in September 2010 and a National Excellence Award at the MTNL Perfect Health Mela in October 2011. He also received an Award of Excellence in Cardiology at the World Congress on Clinical, Preventive, Geriatric Cardiology and Imaging in October 2010, and is an honorary professor in the faculty of medical sciences at Indira Gandhi Technological and Medical Sciences University in Arunachal Pradesh.

dr-bhuvnesh-k-aggarwal.bio:
Dr. Bhuvnesh K Aggarwal is Principal Consultant for Cardiac Surgery at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 33 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, aortic aneurysm repair and minimally invasive cardiac surgery. Lung cancer surgery also appears, reflecting the thoracic side of a cardiothoracic and vascular training.

He holds MBBS, an MS in general surgery, the DNB in general surgery and the MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, taking a gold medal in the MCh at Kasturba Medical College, Manipal. He also held the Starr-Ahmad Fellowship in cardiac surgery of the International Association for Cardio-Thoracic and Vascular Surgery in the USA.

Holding both the MS and the DNB in general surgery before the MCh means the general surgical stage of his training was examined twice over, which is unusual even among surgeons who later specialise.

His hospital record traces a career across northern and southern India. He has worked at Medical College in Bikaner, at the Heart Institute in Patna, at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal where he took his gold medal, and in Delhi at Escorts Heart Institute and Indraprastha Apollo Hospital, before Medanta – The Medicity in Gurugram.

An aneurysm and aortic root list alongside coronary and valve work describes a surgeon whose practice covers the aorta as well as the heart itself.

dr-b-bhaskar-rao.bio:
Dr. B. Bhaskar Rao is Founder and Chairman of KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 36 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery and cardiology.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, and TAVR and TAVI.

He read MBBS at Rangaraya Medical College in Kakinada under Andhra University in 1982, took his MS at Madras Medical College in 1984, and the DNB in cardiothoracic surgery from the National Board of Examination in New Delhi in 1987.

Two entries on his record reach well beyond the operating theatre. He was the architect of the Rajiv Gandhi Aarogyasri Scheme, India's first government health insurance scheme for people below the poverty line, launched in Andhra Pradesh in 2007 and since replicated across multiple Indian states. He also established the Bollineni Krishnaiah Charitable Trust, which founded the first nursing school in its region in 2002 to provide free education and medical care to the underprivileged.

To design a state health insurance scheme is a different kind of work from cardiac surgery, and its reach extends to patients who never meet the surgeon.

In 2017 he received the Times Healthcare Achievers Award as Lifetime Achiever of the Year in Cardiology and Cardiothoracic Surgery. Alongside KIMS he has been associated with the Mahavir Cardio Vascular Center in Hyderabad, with Bollineni hospitals and centres in Nellore, Rajahmundry and Cuddapah, and with the KIMS Wardhak Diagnostic Centre in Kabul.

dr-aditya-kumar-singh.bio:
Dr. Aditya Kumar Singh is Director and Unit Head of Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, LVAD implantation, TAVI and TAVR, robotic cardiac surgery and minimally invasive cardiac surgery.

He holds an MS in general surgery and the MCh super-specialisation in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, with a further specialisation in minimal invasive cardiac surgery.

Two entries on his record are firsts rather than qualifications, and both concern that specialisation. He performed India's first combined CABG and mitral valve replacement through a single small incision, described on his profile as a landmark achievement in minimally invasive cardiac surgery, and he is the inventor of numerous instruments and technologies for cardiac and minimally invasive surgery. Taking two operations that are normally done through a full sternotomy and combining them into one small incision is the kind of step that depends on having the instruments for it, which is where the second entry meets the first.

His hospital record runs through several Delhi cardiac units. He has been senior consultant and head of adult cardiac surgery at Marengo QRG Hospital, consultant in charge and head at Metro Hospitals and Heart Institute in Meerut, and consultant at Fortis Hospital in Shalimar Bagh and Metro Hospital in Lajpat Nagar, before his current unit headship at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital.

dr-ajay-kaul.bio:
Dr. Ajay Kaul is Chairman of Cardiac Sciences at Fortis Hospital, Noida, in Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with paediatric cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, heart transplant surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation.

After MBBS, an MS in general surgery and the MCh in cardiothoracic surgery, both of his fellowships were taken in Germany: heart and lung transplant at Hannover Medical School, and minimally invasive cardiac surgery at the Leipzig Heart Centre. Those two centres correspond directly to the two ends of his list, the transplant work and the small-incision work.

His record names four areas in which he is recognised. He is acknowledged for performing one of the highest numbers of TAVR procedures in the region, aortic valve replacement carried out without open heart surgery; for expertise in total arterial coronary bypass surgery, in which the grafts are taken from arteries rather than veins; and for paediatric cardiac surgery and valve repairs. His publications related to TAVR are noted as among the highest volume contributions in that area.

Valve repair rather than replacement, and arterial rather than venous grafts, are both choices that aim at durability, and both appear on the same record as a high-volume transcatheter practice.

He is recognised as one of the top cardiac surgeons in the country and chairs cardiac sciences at Fortis Hospital in Noida.

dr-biswarup-purkayastha.bio:
Dr. Biswarup Purkayastha is Consultant for Heart and Lung Transplant and Vascular Surgery at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery.

His list covers heart transplant surgery, lung transplant surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation, LVAD implantation, coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery. The vascular side adds aortic aneurysm repair and endovascular aneurysm repair.

His qualifications are entirely transplant and support focused. He holds Membership of the European Board of Cardiothoracic Surgery by examination, and ELSO Level 1 and 101 certification as an adult ECMO practitioner. His Greenlane Fellowship in adult cardiothoracic surgery and heart-lung transplants at Auckland was a full two-year term, and he took international training at Vienna General Hospital under the Toronto–Vienna Lung Transplant Academy Program. His initial training was at Narayana Hrudayalaya.

ECMO certification alongside a transplant fellowship is the pairing that matters here, since extracorporeal support is what bridges a patient to a donor organ and carries them through the period afterward.

His memberships follow the same line: the International Society of Heart and Lung Transplantation, the European Association of Cardiothoracic Surgery, the Heart Failure Association of the European Society of Cardiology, the National Academy of Medical Sciences and the Indian Association of Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgeons. A heart failure association membership sits on the medical rather than surgical side, which is where transplant candidates are first identified.

He practises at Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram.

dr-k-v-krishna-kumar.bio:
Dr. K.V. Krishna Kumar is a Senior Consultant Cardiothoracic Surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 42 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, and TAVI and TAVR.

He read MBBS at Guntur Medical College under Nagarjuna University between 1978 and 1983 and completed a rotating internship at the Government General Hospital in Guntur in 1984. His MS in general surgery was at Kasturba Medical College and Wenlock Government Hospital in Mangalore from 1986 to 1988, and his MCh in cardiothoracic surgery at Osmania Medical College and Osmania General Hospital in Hyderabad.

Four decades of practice since that training places him among the longest-serving cardiac surgeons on this platform, and a list that now includes transcatheter valve replacement alongside conventional bypass describes a practice that has taken on the newer procedures as they arrived.

His hospital record runs across two states and both kinds of setting. He has worked at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences and Medwin Hospital in Hyderabad, at the Mahavir Cardiovascular Centre, at the Bollineni Heart Center in Rajahmundry, and at the K.N. Hari Memorial and K.N. Memorial hospitals in Cherukupalli in Guntur district, alongside his current post at KIMS Hospitals in Secunderabad. District hospitals appearing beside tertiary cardiac centres on one record describe practice that has reached beyond the metropolitan centres.

dr-kale-satya-sridhar.bio:
Dr. Kale Satya Sridhar is a Consultant Cardiothoracic Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with paediatric cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and heart transplant surgery.

He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College under NTR University of Health Sciences in Hyderabad between 1989 and 1996, took his MS in general surgery at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal from 1998 to 2002, and his MCh in cardiovascular surgery at G B Pant Hospital under Delhi University from 2002 to 2005.

His hospital record reads as a tour of the best-known cardiac units in the country. Alongside Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad he has worked at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Maxcure Medicity Hospital, Indo US Super Specialty Hospital and Apollo Hospital, at the Sri Satya Sai Institute of Higher Medical Sciences in Puttaparthi, at the Dr. K. M. Cherian Heart Foundation in Chennai, and at G B Pant Hospital in Delhi where he trained.

Two of those institutions are notable for the kind of work they do rather than their size. The Puttaparthi institute and the Cherian foundation are both associated with cardiac surgery offered without regard to a patient's ability to pay, and paediatric cardiac surgery, which appears on his profile alongside the adult work, is a large part of what such centres carry.

dr-vijay-kumar-devraj.bio:
Dr. Vijay Kumar Devraj is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 35 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with general surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, and TAVI and TAVR.

All three of his degrees were taken in Hyderabad. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College under Osmania University in 1978, took his MS in general surgery at Gandhi Medical College in 1983, and returned to Gandhi Medical College for his MCh in cardiothoracic surgery in 1997 under Andhra Pradesh University of Health Sciences.

The years between the MS and the MCh make a long interval, and general surgery remaining on his profile as a specialty alongside cardiac surgery suggests those years were spent practising it rather than waiting.

His hospital record is correspondingly broad. He has worked at Osmania Medical College and Deccan Medical College in Hyderabad and at Kakatiya Medical College, at MEDWIN and Mahavir Hospitals in Hyderabad, at the Durgabai Deshmukh Hospital of the Andhra Mahila Sabha, and at Bolleneni Hospitals in Nellore, before his current post at KIMS Hospital in Secunderabad.

Three medical colleges among those affiliations means a substantial part of his career has been spent where surgical trainees are taught, which is a different setting from a private cardiac unit alone.

dr-a-g-k-gokhale.bio:
Dr. A G K Gokhale is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, in Hyderabad, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery.

His list is genuinely split between the two. The cardiac work covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery. The vascular work covers peripheral vascular bypass surgery, endovascular aneurysm repair, AV fistula creation and deep vein thrombosis.

AV fistula creation on a cardiac surgeon's list is worth noting, since it is the access built for dialysis patients rather than a heart operation, and it comes from the vascular half of a cardiothoracic and vascular training.

He holds MBBS, an MS in general surgery and the MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, along with the FIACS as a Fellow of the Indian Association of Cardiovascular-Thoracic Surgeons, and his record notes fellowship and training in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery at premier Indian and international centres.

His profile records recognition for excellence in cardiothoracic surgical practice through multiple awards and honours over his career, awards for best scientific paper presentations at national and international conferences, and recognition for his contributions to advancing minimally invasive cardiac surgical techniques. He also has multiple publications in peer-reviewed national and international cardiothoracic and vascular surgery journals.

He practises at Apollo Health City in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad.

dr-manoj-kumar-s-p.bio:
Dr. Manoj Kumar S P is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, in Bengaluru, with more than 26 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list runs from the heart to the veins of the leg. The cardiac work covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery. The vascular work covers peripheral vascular bypass surgery, endovascular aneurysm repair, AV fistula creation, deep vein thrombosis, varicose vein surgery and laser treatment for varicose veins.

Laser treatment for varicose veins and open heart surgery on the same list is the full span of a cardiothoracic and vascular practice, from a day procedure on a superficial vein to an operation on the aortic root.

He holds MBBS, an MS in general surgery, and both the MCh and the DNB in cardiothoracic surgery, so the specialty was examined twice, along with the FAIS as a Fellow of the Association of Indian Surgeons.

His record notes national-level records established in performing international standards of cardiac, thoracic and vascular surgery, and recognises him as one of the youngest to perform such programmes in the country. He has been nominated for congenital heart defects and endovascular and extra-corporeal CABG work, and is an active member of the heart failure treatment team.

Heart failure team membership places him alongside physicians managing patients medically, which is where surgical candidates are identified. He practises at Apollo Hospitals in Seshadripuram, Bangalore.

dr-naresh-trehan.bio:
Dr. Naresh Trehan is Chairman and Managing Director of Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 52 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, heart transplant surgery, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and robotic cardiac surgery. His profile also records the comparison between traditional and minimally invasive heart surgery as one of the subjects he addresses, which is the question a patient facing either faces first.

He holds MBBS and is a Diplomate of the American Board of Cardiothoracic Surgery, the certification that governs the specialty in the United States.

His honours span more than three decades and two of the highest civilian awards in India. He received the Padma Shri in 1991 for distinguished service in medicine and the Padma Bhushan from the Government of India, along with the Dr. B. C. Roy National Award in 2005, the highest recognition Indian medicine gives its own. Earlier came the Rajiv Gandhi National Unity Award and the India International Gold Award, both in 1995.

Robotic and minimally invasive cardiac surgery sitting on the same list as transplantation and redo bypass describes a practice that covers both the newest approaches to the heart and the hardest repeat operations.

Alongside Medanta – The Medicity, where he is chairman and managing director, he practises at Medanta Gurugram and Medanta Mediclinic in Defence Colony.

dr-sathyaki-p-nambala.bio:
Dr. Sathyaki P Nambala is a Consultant Cardiac Surgeon at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, in Bengaluru, with more than 18 years of experience.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and robotic cardiac surgery.

He holds MBBS and an MS in general surgery, and took his MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery through Apollo Hospital in Bangalore and the Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Medical Sciences. His fellowship covers both minimally invasive cardiac surgery and robotic cardiac surgery, the two techniques that distinguish his list from a conventional one.

His record names one accomplishment in particular: he led the first-ever beating heart coronary artery bypass operation, off-pump CABG, at one of his affiliated institutions. Off-pump surgery is bypass performed without stopping the heart or using the heart-lung machine, and being the first to do it at an institution means introducing the technique to a whole theatre team rather than only performing it.

He has presented surgical studies at the Heart Valve Society and at international congress, which his profile records as demonstrating his academic and clinical contributions to the field.

Alongside Apollo Hospital in Seshadripuram he has worked at Narayana Health in Bangalore, at the Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Medical Sciences and at the Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences, three of the best-known cardiac centres in the city.

dr-srinath-vijayasekharan.bio:
Dr. Srinath Vijayasekharan is Director and Senior Consultant at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 26 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with paediatric cardiac surgery.

His list is among the widest in the specialty. It covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and robotic cardiac surgery, together with LVAD implantation, heart transplant surgery, lung transplant surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation.

An LVAD and three forms of transplantation on one list describe a service for patients whose own heart or lungs can no longer be repaired, and the paediatric side of his profile means that work is not confined to adults.

He holds MBBS, an MS and the DNB.

His hospital record covers the main cardiac and transplant centres of Chennai and beyond. Alongside Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre he has worked at MGM Healthcare, at Fortis Malar Hospitals and Malar Hospital, at Sri Ramachandra University, and at Kovai Medical Center and Hospital.

Robotic cardiac surgery appearing on the same list as heart-lung transplantation is unusual, since the two sit at opposite ends of the specialty: one is about operating through the smallest possible access, the other about replacing the organs entirely. A surgeon whose practice carries both is working across the full range of what cardiac surgery now offers.

dr-a-s-hariharan.bio:
Dr. A. S. Hariharan is a Visiting Consultant at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery.

His list is weighted toward the aorta. Alongside coronary artery bypass grafting, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and LVAD implantation, he performs aortic root replacement, aortic aneurysm repair and thoracic endovascular aortic repair. Holding both the open and the endovascular approach to an aneurysm on one list means the choice between them can be made on the case rather than on what the surgeon offers.

He holds MBBS, the DNB in general surgery and the DNB in cardiothoracic surgery, so both stages of his surgical training were examined through the national board.

His hospital record traces a clear progression through the grades. He was a senior resident in general surgery at VHS, then senior registrar and resident in cardiothoracic surgery at Railway Hospital, associate consultant in thoracic surgery at Apollo Hospital, and divisional medical officer at the Southern Railway Headquarters Hospital. At SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre he served first as junior and then as senior consultant, before his current visiting consultant post at Rela Hospital in Chennai.

Two railway hospitals among those posts describe part of a career spent in an employer-run health service, which serves a defined population rather than a referral catchment, and the move from resident to senior consultant across six institutions is the ordinary shape of a surgical career made visible.

dr-sanjay-kumar-sharma.bio:
Dr. Sanjay Kumar Sharma is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and robotic cardiac surgery.

Robotic and minimally invasive surgery sitting beside redo bypass is worth noting. The first two are about reaching the heart through the smallest possible opening; a redo operation means going back through a chest that has been opened before, which is among the more demanding situations in the specialty. His list carries both.

He holds MBBS, an MS in general surgery and the DNB in cardiothoracic surgery, and completed a structural cardiac transplant training programme, recorded on his profile as specialised training and certification in structural cardiac transplant procedures.

His hospital record runs through the main cardiac units of Delhi. Alongside Indraprastha Apollo Hospital and Apollo Hospitals in Delhi he has worked at Fortis Escorts Hospital and at Manipal Hospitals.

A national board qualification in cardiothoracic surgery, followed by transplant-level training and a list that now includes robotic work, describes a surgeon whose practice has kept pace with the techniques as they arrived rather than settling at the point of qualification. He practises at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi NCR.

dr-vishal-khante.bio:
Dr. Vishal Khante is a Consultant Cardiothoracic and Minimal Invasive Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 23 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with paediatric cardiac surgery and vascular surgery.

His list leads with minimally invasive cardiac surgery and goes on to coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, multiple valve surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation.

He read MBBS at Government Medical College, Nagpur, under Maharashtra University of Health Sciences in 2003, took his MS in general surgery at Government Medical College, Aurangabad, in 2009, and his MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery at G.B. Pant Hospital in New Delhi in 2013. His fellowship in heart and lung transplant was at Freeman Hospital in Newcastle upon Tyne between 2021 and 2022.

That fellowship, taken nearly a decade after his MCh, is what places transplantation at the end of a list that otherwise describes a conventional and minimally invasive cardiac practice. A surgeon already established in valve and bypass work who then trains abroad in transplantation is adding a service rather than starting one.

Alongside Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad he has worked at Kamineni Hospitals and Medical College, at Maxcure Hospitals and at Medicover Hospitals in Hyderabad, as well as at Freeman Hospital where he trained.

His designation names minimal invasive surgery directly, which matches a list on which it appears first rather than as one option among several.

dr-anto-sahayaraj-r.bio:
Dr. Anto Sahayaraj R is a Senior Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with paediatric cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, heart transplant and combined heart-lung transplantation.

All three of his degrees were taken under Dr. MGR Medical University. He read MBBS at Chengalpattu Medical College in 1995, took his MS in general surgery at Government Stanley Medical College in 2001, and his MCh in cardio-thoracic and vascular surgery at Madras Medical College in 2005. In 2011 he was a surgical fellow in pediatric cardiology at Starship Children's Hospital in Auckland.

A dedicated children's hospital fellowship is what places paediatric cardiac surgery on his profile as a specialty rather than as occasional work, and it sits alongside an adult list that runs to transplantation.

Redo bypass and multiple valve surgery on the same record describe the harder end of adult work: reoperation on a chest already opened once, and disease affecting more than one valve at a time. Taken with the paediatric training, his practice covers patients from childhood through to those whose earlier surgery needs revisiting.

He is a member of the Indian Association of Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgeons and of the Indian Medical Association, and practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai.

dr-harpreet-wasir.bio:
Dr. Harpreet Wasir is an Associate Director at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with robotic cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, aortic root replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and robotic cardiac surgery.

Robotic surgery appearing as a named specialty on his profile, and not only as one procedure among several, means it is a defining part of his practice rather than an occasional approach.

He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College and the associated Lok Narian Jaiprakash Hospital, took his MS in general surgery at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research in Chandigarh, and trained for his MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery as a senior resident in the department of CTVS at AIIMS in New Delhi.

Three of the country's best-known medical institutions in sequence, one for each stage of training, is an unusually direct path into the specialty.

His recorded awards are from his school years and describe a wide-ranging record before medicine: a merit certificate in the National Mathematics Olympiad contest, the Duke of Edinburgh's Award for all-round performance in academics and extra-curricular activities, a scholar badge for overall academic performance in 1984 and 1985, and a certificate of merit for the same in 1986.

He practises at Medanta — The Medicity in Gurugram.

dr-madhur-sahay.bio:
Dr. Madhur Sahay is an Associate Consultant at Medanta - The Medicity in Delhi NCR, with more than 13 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list is unusual for carrying adult and congenital work side by side. The adult procedures are coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, aortic root replacement and minimally invasive cardiac surgery. The congenital procedures are surgical closure of atrial and ventricular septal defects, and the treatment of congenital heart disease in children.

Closure of a septal defect is the commonest operation in congenital heart surgery, and holding it on the same list as coronary bypass means his practice covers both the child born with a hole between the chambers and the adult whose arteries have narrowed.

He read MBBS at Manipal College of Medical Sciences and took the DNB in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery at R.G. Kar Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata.

His earlier record spans three settings. He has worked at Manipal College of Medical Sciences in Nepal, at R.G. Kar Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata where he trained, and with the Urban Hat of Jharkhand Government Undertaking, before his current post at Medanta Hospital.

Two entries on his record come from outside medicine and describe a long habit of service and discipline: a President Award in Scout, recognised for exemplary service and leadership, and a state-level basketball career.

dr-rajneesh-malhotra.bio:
Dr. Rajneesh Malhotra is Chairman and Head of the Department of CTVS and Robotic Surgery at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in Delhi NCR, with more than 35 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with robotic surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting and redo CABG, heart valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement and multiple valve surgery, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, robotic cardiac surgery, LVAD implantation and heart transplant surgery.

He read MBBS and took his MS in general surgery at King George's Medical College in Lucknow, and his MCh at G.S.V.M. Medical College under Kanpur University. His fellowship in cardiac surgery was in the department of thoracic and cardiovascular surgery at University Hospital in Uppsala.

Four further periods of training, all in the United States, correspond almost exactly to the newer half of his list. He trained in minimally invasive cardiac surgery with Medtronic Inc. in Minneapolis, in port access cardiac surgery at the Heart Port Training Institute in Salt Lake City, in Da Vinci robotic cardiac surgery at the Invasive Surgery Center of Ohio State University, and in valve repair and beating heart technique at the Myocor Institute in Minneapolis.

Port access, robotic and beating heart training taken separately is what allows a surgeon to choose the approach case by case rather than defaulting to one. Valve repair training sits in the same group, since repairing a valve rather than replacing it is the harder option and the more durable one.

He practises at Max Hospital, Saket East, in New Delhi.

dr-sushant-srivastava.bio:
Dr. Sushant Srivastava is Chairperson of Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery at Paras Hospitals, Gurugram, in Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience. His profile records cardiac surgery together with vascular surgery.

His list is among the widest on this platform. The cardiac work covers coronary artery bypass grafting, including beating heart and awake techniques, redo bypass and redo valve surgery, valve repair and replacement, double valve replacement, minimally invasive and awake cardiac procedures, LVAD implantation and heart transplant surgery. The aortic and vascular work covers aortic root replacement and aneurysm surgery including hybrid and endovascular repairs, and varicose vein surgery. Surgery for congenital heart defects is also on the list.

Four entries on his record are firsts or extremes. He was part of the first heart transplant team in the country and has extensive transplant experience. He performed the first stitch-less valve implantation in India in 2015, and north India's first awake CABG surgery in 2006. He has also performed bypass surgery on the oldest recorded patient in the country, at 96 years old, and his record notes successful repair of cardiac ruptures and aortic aneurysms.

Awake cardiac surgery is the unusual thread there, since it means operating without general anaesthesia, and it appears twice on his record: once as a first and once as part of his routine list.

Both of his degrees, the MS in general surgery and the MCh in cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, were taken at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi. He was awarded Rising Star in Cardiac Surgery in 2018.

dr-vinod-kumar-manikala.bio:
Dr. Vinod Kumar Manikala is a Senior Consultant and Minimally Invasive Cardiac Surgeon at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience in cardiac surgery.

His list covers coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve repair and replacement, minimally invasive cardiac surgery, heart transplant surgery and combined heart-lung transplantation.

He holds MBBS and an MS in general surgery, and took his MCh in cardiothoracic surgery at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi.

Four further periods of advanced training define the rest of his practice, and they fit together. He trained in heart and lung transplantation, in LVAD implantation, and in ECMO support at the University of Alberta in Edmonton, along with training in intricate thoracic procedures and critical care cardiothoracic interventions.

Those three technologies belong to the same pathway. A patient in advanced heart failure may be supported on ECMO in the short term, carried on a left ventricular assist device for longer, and transplanted when an organ becomes available, and a surgeon trained in all three can follow a case through each stage rather than handing it on.

His designation names minimally invasive cardiac surgery directly, and that approach sits on the same list as transplantation, so his practice runs from operations performed through the smallest possible access to those that replace the organ altogether.

He practises at MGM Healthcare in Chennai.

dr-venkata-swamy-pasupula.bio:
Dr. Venkata Swamy Pasupula is a Consultant Neurologist and Epileptologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records neurology together with paediatric neurology.

His list covers epilepsy and drug-resistant epilepsy, stroke treatment and recovery, Parkinson's disease, dystonia and tremor disorders, multiple sclerosis, myasthenia gravis, migraine and chronic headache, and diabetic neuropathy. The procedures behind those conditions are EEG, nerve conduction studies and evoked potentials for diagnosis, and IV thrombolysis, deep brain stimulation, botulinum toxin therapy, IVIG and migraine nerve block for treatment.

He read MBBS at Kurnool Medical College between 1982 and 1987, took his MD in general medicine at S V Medical College in Tirupati from 1990 to 1993, and his DM in neurology at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad from 1996 to 1999.

The epilepsy half of his title is supported by a decade of further courses. He held an EEG and epilepsy observership at the Sri Chitra Institute in Trivandrum, trained in clinical neurophysiology, EEG and epilepsy at the Cleveland Clinic in 2012 and at the Mayo Clinic in Florida in 2011, and took four successive VIREPA courses between 2014 and 2018 in basic EEG, paediatric EEG, advanced EEG and neuroimaging. He also attended an epilepsy course in San Sebastian in 2014 and SEEG conferences in Sacacomie.

He is a Fellow of the American Clinical Neurophysiological Society and a member of the Indian Epilepsy Society, the American Epilepsy Society, the Indian Association of Neurology, the Movement Disorder Society and the Indian Stroke Association.

dr-sushma-sharma.bio:
Dr. Sushma Sharma is Programme Clinical Director for Neurology at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 19 years of experience.

Her list is broad. It covers stroke treatment and recovery, epilepsy and drug-resistant epilepsy, migraine and chronic headache, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, dystonia and tremor disorders, Alzheimer's disease and dementia, diabetic neuropathy and myasthenia gravis. The procedures include EEG, nerve conduction studies and evoked potentials, stroke thrombectomy and IV thrombolysis, deep brain stimulation, botulinum toxin therapy, IVIG and migraine nerve block.

She read MBBS at Government Medical College, Jammu, took her MD in general medicine at Government Medical College, Srinagar, and her DM in neurology at JIPMER in Puducherry, along with the DNB in neurology from the National Board of Examinations. She holds board certification in electroencephalography from the Asian Epilepsy Academy.

Two further qualifications point to a distinct strand of her work. She is certified in the assessment and management of vestibular disorders by Yenepoya University and holds an international diploma in vestibular medicine from AVISA, and she established the first fully equipped vertigo and balance disorders unit in Faridabad.

She also introduced advanced neurological therapies to the region, including ultrasound-guided botulinum toxin therapy and mechanical thrombectomy, both of which appear on her own list.

She has authored more than 25 publications, contributed chapters to neurology textbooks, guided academic theses and research projects, and mentored young neurologists and postgraduate students. Her earlier posts were at Metro Heart Institute and Fortis Escorts Hospital in Faridabad, the Asian Institute of Medical Sciences, and Apollo Hospital in New Delhi.

dr-prof-debashish-chowdhury-.bio:
Dr. (Prof) Debashish Chowdhury is Vice Chairman and Academic Head of the Department of Neurology at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 37 years of experience.

His list covers epilepsy management and drug-resistant epilepsy, seizure disorders, Parkinson's disease, dystonia and tremor disorders, neuropathic pain, and the full arc of stroke care: acute ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke management, post-stroke neurological care, and prevention and secondary care. EEG, IV thrombolysis, deep brain stimulation and botulinum toxin therapy sit behind that list.

He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in 1985, took a diploma in tuberculosis and chest diseases at the Vallabhbhai Patel Chest Institute in 1990, and both his MD in internal medicine and his DM in neurology in 1993, the latter at G. B. Pant Hospital. His later training was abroad: headache disorders at Trinity College, University of Cambridge, in 2001, good clinical practice with Harvard Medical International the same year, and a stroke medicine fellowship at Edinburgh in 2003.

Headache is where his research sits. His recent work includes the ANODYNE study in Cephalalgia, a trial of greater occipital nerve block with methylprednisolone and lignocaine against placebo for episodic cluster headache, a cluster headache consensus publication in The Journal of Headache and Pain, a population-based assessment of headache burden in Delhi-NCR, the validation of a Hindi HARDSHIP questionnaire for community headache research, and a scoping review of migraine's impact on productivity in Indian adults.

He delivered the IAN Presidential Oration in 2024, and received the Distinguished Alumnus Award of Maulana Azad Medical College in 2022 and a state award for healthcare contributions from the Government of Delhi in 2016.

dr-ritu-jha.bio:
Dr. Ritu Jha is Director and Head of Neurology at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience.

Her list covers epilepsy and drug-resistant epilepsy, stroke treatment and recovery, migraine and chronic headache, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease and dementia, multiple sclerosis, myasthenia gravis, diabetic neuropathy, motor neuron disease, and dystonia and tremor disorders. The procedures include EEG, nerve conduction studies and evoked potentials, IV thrombolysis, deep brain stimulation, botulinum toxin therapy, IVIG and migraine nerve block.

She read MBBS at GSVM Medical College in Kanpur, took her MD in medicine at King George Medical University in Lucknow, and her DM in neurology at SGPGIMS in the same city. She was a gold medallist in anatomy, took a bronze medal in biochemistry, and placed sixth in the UP CPMT examination, first among girls.

Her published research covers nerve and cognitive work. Two papers study vitamin B12 deficiency neurological syndrome, one a clinical, nerve conduction and nerve biopsy study with short-term follow-up and the other a neurobehavioral, psychometric and P3 study. Two more examine cognition after cardiac surgery, asking whether coronary artery bypass leads to cognitive impairment and evaluating cognitive function and P300 in patients undergoing the operation. She has also published on the spectrum of fungal infection in a neurology tertiary care centre, on cortical blindness after a contrast-enhanced CT scan in sarcoidosis, and on barriers to evidence-based medicine practice in South Asia.

Her earlier posts were at the Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences, Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital and UCMS, Indraprastha Apollo Hospital and B L Kapoor Hospital in New Delhi.

dr-arun-kumar-m.bio:
Dr. Arun Kumar M is a Consultant Adult and Pediatric Neurologist and Epileptologist at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records neurology together with paediatric neurology.

His list is led by epilepsy. It covers epilepsy treatment, drug-resistant epilepsy and pre-surgical evaluation and workup for epilepsy surgery, with video EEG, EEG and evoked potentials behind it. The rest covers Parkinson's disease with deep brain stimulation evaluation and programming, stroke treatment and IV thrombolysis, migraine and chronic headache with nerve block, multiple sclerosis, dystonia and botulinum toxin therapy.

His training crossed four states and two specialties. He read MBBS at Mahatma Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute in Puducherry in 2009, took his MD in paediatrics at Veer Surendra Sai Medical College in Odisha in 2015, his DM in neurology at Government Thanjavur Medical College in 2019, a fellowship in epilepsy at Gleneagles Global Health City in Chennai from 2019 to 2020, and the DrNB in neurology at St. John's Medical College in Bangalore in 2023.

A paediatric MD before a neurology DM is what places adult and paediatric neurology side by side in his designation.

He won the best platform presentation award at TANCON Erode in 2023 for work on the utility of stereo-electroencephalography for epilepsy surgery in drug-resistant epilepsy, which is the invasive recording method used in exactly the pre-surgical workup on his list. He was an ILAE VIREPA course participant with partial bursary in 2023, and has presented at EAN Budapest and at TANCON, PEDICON and IANCON.

dr-yeshwanth-paidimarri.bio:
Dr. Yeshwanth Paidimarri is a Consultant Neurologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 16 years of experience.

His list covers stroke treatment and recovery, epilepsy and drug-resistant epilepsy, migraine and chronic headache, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, motor neuron disease, diabetic neuropathy, Alzheimer's disease and dementia, dystonia, myasthenia gravis and tremor disorders. The procedures include EEG, nerve conduction studies and evoked potentials, IV thrombolysis, deep brain stimulation, botulinum toxin therapy, IVIG and migraine nerve block.

He read MBBS at Deccan College of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad between 2004 and 2010, took his MD in general medicine at Mamata Medical College in Khammam from 2011 to 2014, and his DM in neurology at the Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences in Tirupati from 2015 to 2018. In 2019 he passed the UK specialty certificate examination in neurology.

His research dates from his general medicine years and is about infection rather than the nervous system. He co-authored a study of the clinical and laboratory profile and outcome of dengue fever in 2013, presented work on the aetiology and clinical profile of patients admitted with fever and thrombocytopenia at APAPICON 2012, and presented an assessment of the risk hyperglycaemia poses to mortality in intensive care at MAMATA MEDICON the same year.

At APNEUROCON 2018 he won both the best research paper award and the neuroradiology quiz.

He is a member of the Indian Academy of Neurology, the Telangana Neurological Society and the Andhra Pradesh Neuroscientists Association, and worked at Apollo Hospitals in Jubilee Hills from 2018 to 2025.

dr-rukmini-mridula-kandadai.bio:
Dr. Rukmini Mridula Kandadai is Senior Consultant Neurologist and Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, in Hyderabad, with more than 26 years of experience.

Her list is concentrated on movement disorders. It covers Parkinson's disease and atypical parkinsonism, dystonia and tremor disorders, neuro rehabilitation for movement disorders, Alzheimer's disease and dementia, epilepsy and motor neuron disease, with EEG, deep brain stimulation and botulinum toxin therapy among the procedures.

She read MBBS at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal between 1994 and 1999, taking a gold medal in pathology in 1997 and the Late Mrs. Muktaben D. Chandrana Prize as best outgoing lady medical graduate. Her DNB in general medicine and her DM in neurology were both taken at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad, between 2001 and 2008, and she also holds the DNB in neurology.

Her committee work is the most distinctive part of her record and matches her clinical focus exactly. She is a founder member and has served on the executive committee of the Movement Disorders Society of India, is a founding member and treasurer of both the Parkinson's Research Alliance of India and the Parkinson's Society Hyderabad, sat on the newsletter committee of the International Association of Parkinson's Disease and Related Disorders across two terms, and has served the International Parkinson and Movement Disorders Society on its membership committee and its Asian Oceania section underserved committee since 2023.

Founding a patient society and a research alliance alongside clinical practice reaches patients who are not in her own clinic. She is also a member of the Indian Academy of Neurology and the Andhra Pradesh Neuroscientists Association.

dr-s-mohan-das.bio:
Dr. S. Mohan Das is Chief Consultant Neurologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 48 years of experience.

His list covers epilepsy and drug-resistant epilepsy, stroke treatment and recovery, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease and dementia, motor neuron disease, myasthenia gravis, migraine and chronic headache, diabetic neuropathy, dystonia and tremor disorders, and neuro rehabilitation for movement disorders. EEG and nerve conduction studies sit behind the diagnosis, and IV thrombolysis, deep brain stimulation, botulinum toxin therapy, IVIG and migraine nerve block behind the treatment.

He read MBBS at King George's Medical College in Lucknow between 1965 and 1969, took his MD in internal medicine at Safdarjang Hospital under Delhi University in 1974, and his DM in neurology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in 1978. He is a Fellow of the Indian Academy of Neurology and an examiner for the DM in neurology and the MCh in neurosurgery.

To examine candidates for both degrees is to be trusted to set the standard for two specialties rather than one.

His record in the specialty's organisations spans the 1990s. He was Vice President of the A.P. Neuroscientists Association in 1995 and 1996 and President in 1996 and 1997, honorary secretary of the Twin Cities Neurological Society, organising secretary of the Sixth IAN Conference at Hyderabad in 1998, and delivered the Sixth Capt. Venkaiah Oration at Vijayawada in December 1996.

He has worked at AIIMS, GB Pant Hospital and Safdarjang Hospital in New Delhi, at Kurnool Medical College, and at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad.

dr-siddharth-kharkar.bio:
Dr. Siddharth Kharkar is a Consultant Neurologist at KIMS Hospitals, Thane, in Mumbai, with more than 22 years of experience.

His list covers epilepsy and drug-resistant epilepsy, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease and dementia, migraine and chronic headache, stroke treatment and recovery, tremor disorders and dystonia, and neuro rehabilitation for both brain injury and movement disorders. The procedures include EEG and lumbar puncture, IV thrombolysis, deep brain stimulation, vagus nerve stimulation, botulinum toxin therapy and migraine nerve block.

His two fellowships correspond to the two halves of that list: epilepsy at the University of California, San Francisco, and Parkinson's disease at King's College, London. Vagus nerve stimulation and deep brain stimulation, one for epilepsy and one for movement disorders, are the implanted treatments each fellowship leads to.

He holds MBBS, an MD in neurology taken in the USA and an MHS.

His awards are from his American training years: the Humanitarian Resident of the Year Award at Drexel University in 2008, selection for the national Neurology Residents Scholar Program in 2010, and the Best Resident Research Project Award at Drexel in 2011.

He serves as an editorial board member or reviewer for Epilepsy Research, Neurosurgery, the Journal of Neurosurgery and Annals of Neurology. That spread of two surgical journals alongside two neurological ones matches a practice built around implanted stimulation, where the neurologist selects and programs and the surgeon implants.

He is a member of the American Academy of Neurology, the American Epilepsy Society, the Indian Academy of Neurology, the Maharashtra Academy of Neurology and the Movement Disorders Society of India.

dr-mohit-anand.bio:
Dr. Mohit Anand is Consultant in Neurology and Movement Disorders at Artemis Hospital in Delhi NCR, with more than 5 years of experience.
